vsm1.1:157.7.verse: ‘‘Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso tattena ayopaṭṭena ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena kāyaṃ sampaliveṭheyya,

vsm1.1:157.8.verse: yaṃ vā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ vā brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ vā gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā saddhādeyyaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuñjeyyā’’ti ca.

vsm1.1:157.9.verse: ‘‘Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso tattena ayosaṅkunā ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena mukhaṃ vivaritvā tattaṃ lohaguḷaṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ mukhe pakkhipeyya,

vsm1.1:157.10.verse: taṃ tassa oṭṭhampi ḍaheyya, mukhampi, jivhampi, kaṇṭhampi, udarampi ḍaheyya, antampi antaguṇampi ādāya adhobhāgaṃ nikkhameyya,

vsm1.1:157.11.verse: yaṃ vā khattiya… brāhmaṇa… gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā saddhādeyyaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjeyyā’’ti ca.

vsm1.1:157.12.verse: ‘‘Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso sīse vā gahetvā khandhe vā gahetvā tattaṃ ayomañcaṃ vā ayopīṭhaṃ vā ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ abhinisīdāpeyya vā abhinipajjāpeyya vā,

vsm1.1:157.13.verse: yaṃ vā khattiya… brāhmaṇa… gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā saddhādeyyaṃ mañcapīṭhaṃ paribhuñjeyyā’’ti ca.

vsm1.1:157.14.verse: ‘‘Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso uddhaṃpādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā tattāya ayokumbhiyā pakkhipeyya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya,

vsm1.1:157.15.verse: so tattha pheṇuddehakaṃ paccamāno sakimpi uddhaṃ gaccheyya, sakimpi adho gaccheyya, sakimpi tiriyaṃ gaccheyya, yaṃ vā khattiya… brāhmaṇa… gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā saddhādeyyaṃ vihāraṃ paribhuñjeyyā’’ti cāti (a. ni. 7.72).

vsm1.1:158.3.verse:
Saddhānamañjalikammasādiyane kiṃ sukhaṃ asīlassa;
Sattippahāradukkhādhimattadukkhassa yaṃhetu.

vsm1.1:158.4.verse:
Cīvaraparibhogasukhaṃ, kiṃ nāma asaṃyatassa;
Yena ciraṃ anubhavitabbo, niraye jalitaayopaṭṭasamphasso.

vsm1.1:158.5.verse:
Madhuropi piṇḍapāto, halāhalavisūpamo asīlassa;
Ādittā gilitabbā, ayoguḷā yena cirarattaṃ.

vsm1.1:158.6.verse:
Sukhasammatopi dukkho, asīlino mañcapīṭhaparibhogo;
Yaṃ bādhissanti ciraṃ, jalitaayomañcapīṭhāni.

vsm1.1:158.7.verse:
Dussīlassa vihāre, saddhādeyyamhi kā nivāsa rati;
Jalitesu nivasitabbaṃ, yena ayokumbhimajjhesu.

vsm1.1:158.8.verse:
Saṅkasarasamācāro, kasambujāto avassuto pāpo;
Antopūtīti ca yaṃ, nindanto āha lokagaru.

vsm1.1:158.9.verse:
Dhī jīvitaṃ asaññatassa, tassa samaṇajanavesadhārissa;
Assamaṇassa upahataṃ, khatamattānaṃ vahantassa.

vsm1.1:158.10.verse:
Gūthaṃ viya kuṇapaṃ viya, maṇḍanakāmā vivajjayantīdha;
Yaṃ nāma sīlavanto, santo kiṃ jīvitaṃ tassa.

vsm1.1:158.11.verse:
Sabbabhayehi amutto, mutto sabbehi adhigamasukhehi;
Supihitasaggadvāro, apāyamaggaṃ samārūḷho.

vsm1.1:158.12.verse:
Karuṇāya vatthubhūto, kāruṇikajanassa nāma ko añño;
Dussīlasamo dussī, latāya iti bahuvidhā dosāti.

vsm1.1:158.13.verse: Evamādinā paccavekkhaṇena sīlavipattiyaṃ ādīnavadassanaṃ vuttappakāraviparītato sīlasampattiyā ānisaṃsadassanañca veditabbaṃ. Apica –

vsm1.1:159.1.verse:
Tassa pāsādikaṃ hoti, pattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ;
Pabbajjā saphalā tassa, yassa sīlaṃ sunimmalaṃ.

vsm1.1:159.2.verse:
Attānuvādādibhayaṃ, suddhasīlassa bhikkhuno;
Andhakāraṃ viya raviṃ, hadayaṃ nāvagāhati.

vsm1.1:159.3.verse:
Sīlasampattiyā bhikkhu, sobhamāno tapovane;
Pabhāsampattiyā cando, gagane viya sobhati.

vsm1.1:159.4.verse:
Kāyagandhopi pāmojjaṃ, sīlavantassa bhikkhuno;
Karoti api devānaṃ, sīlagandhe kathāva kā.

vsm1.1:159.5.verse:
Sabbesaṃ gandhajātānaṃ, sampattiṃ abhibhuyyati;
Avighātī disā sabbā, sīlagandho pavāyati.

vsm1.1:159.6.verse:
Appakāpi katā kārā, sīlavante mahapphalā;
Hontīti sīlavā hoti, pūjāsakkārabhājanaṃ.

vsm1.1:159.7.verse:
Sīlavantaṃ na bādhanti, āsavā diṭṭhadhammikā;
Samparāyikadukkhānaṃ, mūlaṃ khanati sīlavā.

vsm1.1:159.8.verse:
Yā manussesu sampatti, yā ca devesu sampadā;
Na sā sampannasīlassa, icchato hoti dullabhā.

vsm1.1:159.9.verse:
Accantasantā pana yā, ayaṃ nibbānasampadā;
Mano sampannasīlassa, tameva anudhāvati.

vsm1.1:159.10.verse:
Sabbasampattimūlamhi, sīlamhi iti paṇḍito;
Anekākāravokāraṃ, ānisaṃsaṃ vibhāvayeti.

vsm1.1:160.1.verse: Evañhi vibhāvayato sīlavipattito ubbijjitvā sīlasampattininnaṃ mānasaṃ hoti.

vsm1.1:160.2.verse: Tasmā yathāvuttaṃ imaṃ sīlavipattiyā ādīnavaṃ imañca sīlasampattiyā ānisaṃsaṃ disvā sabbādarena sīlaṃ vodāpetabbanti.

vsm1.1:161.1.verse: Ettāvatā ca ‘‘sīle patiṭṭhāya naro sapañño’’ti imissā gāthāya sīlasamādhipaññāmukhena desite visuddhimagge sīlaṃ tāva paridīpitaṃ hoti.

vsm1.1:161.2.verse: Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge Sīlaniddeso nāma paṭhamo paricchedo.

vsm1.2:1.1.verse: Idāni yehi appicchatāsantuṭṭhitādīhi guṇehi vuttappakārassa sīlassa vodānaṃ hoti, te guṇe sampādetuṃ yasmā samādinnasīlena yoginā dhutaṅgasamādānaṃ kātabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:1.4.verse: Iti anavajjasīlabbataguṇaparisuddhasabbasamācāro porāṇe ariyavaṃsattaye patiṭṭhāya catutthassa bhāvanārāmatāsaṅkhātassa ariyavaṃsassa adhigamāraho bhavissati.

vsm1.2:2.1.verse: Bhagavatā hi pariccattalokāmisānaṃ kāye ca jīvite ca anapekkhānaṃ anulomapaṭipadaṃyeva ārādhetukāmānaṃ kulaputtānaṃ terasadhutaṅgāni anuññātāni.

vsm1.2:2.2.verse: Seyyathidaṃ – paṃsukūlikaṅgaṃ, tecīvarikaṅgaṃ, piṇḍapātikaṅgaṃ, sapadānacārikaṅgaṃ, ekāsanikaṅgaṃ,

vsm1.2:4.1.verse: Tattha atthatoti tāva rathikasusānasaṅkārakūṭādīnaṃ yattha katthaci paṃsūnaṃ upari ṭhitattā abbhuggataṭṭhena tesu tesu paṃsukūlamivāti paṃsukūlaṃ,

vsm1.2:4.2.verse: atha vā paṃsu viya kucchitabhāvaṃ ulatīti paṃsukūlaṃ, kucchitabhāvaṃ gacchatīti vuttaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:4.3.verse: Evaṃ laddhanibbacanassa paṃsukūlassa dhāraṇaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ, taṃ sīlamassāti paṃsukūliko. Paṃsukūlikassa aṅgaṃ paṃsukūlikaṅgaṃ.

vsm1.2:4.4.verse: Aṅganti kāraṇaṃ vuccati. Tasmā yena samādānena so paṃsukūliko hoti, tassetaṃ adhivacananti veditabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:4.5.verse: Eteneva nayena saṅghāṭiuttarāsaṅgaantaravāsakasaṅkhātaṃ ticīvaraṃ sīlamassāti tecīvariko.

vsm1.2:5.2.verse: parehi dinnānaṃ piṇḍānaṃ patte nipatananti vuttaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:5.3.verse: Taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ uñchati taṃ taṃ kulaṃ upasaṅkamanto gavesatīti piṇḍapātiko.

vsm1.2:5.4.verse: Piṇḍāya vā patituṃ vatametassāti piṇḍapātī, patitunti carituṃ, piṇḍapātī eva piṇḍapātiko. Piṇḍapātikassa aṅgaṃ piṇḍapātikaṅgaṃ.

vsm1.2:6.3.verse: Saha apadānena sapadānaṃ, avakhaṇḍanarahitaṃ anugharanti vuttaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:6.4.verse: Sapadānaṃ carituṃ idamassa sīlanti sapadānacārī, sapadānacārī eva sapadānacāriko. Tassa aṅgaṃ sapadānacārikaṅgaṃ.

vsm1.2:7.2.verse: taṃ sīlamassāti ekāsaniko. Tassa aṅgaṃ ekāsanikaṅgaṃ.

vsm1.2:7.3.verse: Dutiyabhājanassa paṭikkhittattā kevalaṃ ekasmiṃyeva patte piṇḍo pattapiṇḍo.

vsm1.2:7.4.verse: Idāni pattapiṇḍagahaṇe pattapiṇḍasaññaṃ katvā pattapiṇḍo sīlamassāti pattapiṇḍiko. Tassa aṅgaṃ pattapiṇḍikaṅgaṃ.

vsm1.2:8.2.verse: Pavāritena satā pacchā laddhaṃ bhattaṃ pacchābhattaṃ nāma, tassa pacchābhattassa bhojanaṃ pacchābhattabhojanaṃ, tasmiṃ pacchābhattabhojane pacchābhattasaññaṃ katvā pacchābhattaṃ sīlamassāti pacchābhattiko.

vsm1.2:8.3.verse: Na pacchābhattiko khalupacchābhattiko. Samādānavasena paṭikkhittātirittabhojanassetaṃ nāmaṃ.

vsm1.2:8.4.verse: Aṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana vuttaṃ khalūti eko sakuṇo. So mukhena phalaṃ gahetvā tasmiṃ patite puna aññaṃ na khādati.

vsm1.2:8.5.verse: Tādiso ayanti khalupacchābhattiko. Tassa aṅgaṃ khalupacchābhattikaṅgaṃ.

vsm1.2:9.1.verse: Araññe nivāso sīlamassāti āraññiko. Tassa aṅgaṃ āraññikaṅgaṃ.

vsm1.2:9.3.verse: taṃ sīlamassāti rukkhamūliko. Rukkhamūlikassa aṅgaṃ rukkhamūlikaṅgaṃ. Abbhokāsikasosānikaṅgesupi eseva nayo.

vsm1.2:10.2.verse: idaṃ tuyhaṃ pāpuṇātīti evaṃ paṭhamaṃ uddiṭṭhasenāsanassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ. Tasmiṃ yathāsanthate viharituṃ sīlamassāti yathāsanthatiko. Tassa aṅgaṃ yathāsanthatikaṅgaṃ.

vsm1.2:10.3.verse: Sayanaṃ paṭikkhipitvā nisajjāya viharituṃ sīlamassāti nesajjiko. Tassa aṅgaṃ nesajjikaṅgaṃ.

vsm1.2:11.1.verse: Sabbāneva panetāni tena tena samādānena dhutakilesattā dhutassa bhikkhuno aṅgāni, kilesadhunanato vā dhutanti laddhavohāraṃ ñāṇaṃ aṅgaṃ etesanti dhutaṅgāni.

vsm1.2:11.2.verse: Atha vā dhutāni ca tāni paṭipakkhaniddhunanato aṅgāni ca paṭipattiyātipi dhutaṅgāni. Evaṃ tāvettha atthato viññātabbo vinicchayo.

vsm1.2:12.2.verse: Vuttampi cetaṃ ‘‘yo samādiyati, so puggalo. Yena samādiyati, cittacetasikā ete dhammā. Yā samādānacetanā, taṃ dhutaṅgaṃ. Yaṃ paṭikkhipati, taṃ vatthū’’ti.

vsm1.2:12.4.verse: nilloluppabhāvapaccupaṭṭhānāni appicchatādiariyadhammapadaṭṭhānāni. Evamettha lakkhaṇādīhi veditabbo vinicchayo.

vsm1.2:13.1.verse: Samādānavidhānatotiādīsu pana pañcasu sabbāneva dhutaṅgāni dharamāne bhagavati bhagavatova santike samādātabbāni.

vsm1.2:13.3.verse: Tasmiṃ asati khīṇāsavassa, anāgāmissa, sakadāgāmissa, sotāpannassa,

vsm1.2:13.6.verse: tasmimpi asati cetiyaṅgaṇaṃ sammajjitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā sammāsambuddhassa santike vadantena viya samādātabbāni, apica sayampi samādātuṃ vaṭṭati eva.

vsm1.2:13.7.verse: Ettha ca cetiyapabbate dve bhātikattherānaṃ jeṭṭhakabhātu dhutaṅgappicchatāya vatthu kathetabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:14.3.verse: paṃsukūlikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesu dvīsu vacanesu aññatarena samādinnaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:15.1.verse: Evaṃ samādinnadhutaṅgena pana tena sosānikaṃ, pāpaṇikaṃ, rathiyacoḷaṃ, saṅkāracoḷaṃ, sotthiyaṃ, nhānacoḷaṃ, titthacoḷaṃ, gatapaccāgataṃ,

vsm1.2:15.2.verse: aggiḍaḍḍhaṃ, gokhāyitaṃ, upacikākhāyitaṃ, undūrakhāyitaṃ, antacchinnaṃ, dasācchinnaṃ, dhajāhaṭaṃ,

vsm1.2:15.3.verse: thūpacīvaraṃ, samaṇacīvaraṃ, ābhisekikaṃ, iddhimayaṃ, panthikaṃ, vātāhaṭaṃ, devadattiyaṃ,

vsm1.2:15.4.verse: sāmuddiyantietesu aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ gahetvā phāletvā dubbalaṭṭhānaṃ pahāya thiraṭṭhānāni dhovitvā cīvaraṃ katvā porāṇaṃ gahapaticīvaraṃ apanetvā paribhuñjitabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:16.6.verse: Tissāmaccamātā kira satagghanakena vatthena gabbhamalaṃ puñchāpetvā paṃsukūlikā gaṇhissantīti tālaveḷimagge chaḍḍāpesi.

vsm1.2:17.1.verse: Nhānacoḷanti yaṃ bhūtavejjehi sasīsaṃ nhāpitā kāḷakaṇṇicoḷanti chaḍḍetvā gacchanti.

vsm1.2:17.3.verse: Gatapaccāgatanti yaṃ manussā susānaṃ gantvā paccāgatā nhatvā chaḍḍenti.

vsm1.2:17.4.verse: Aggiḍaḍḍhanti agginā ḍaḍḍhappadesaṃ. Tañhi manussā chaḍḍenti.

vsm1.2:17.5.verse: Gokhāyitādīni pākaṭāneva. Tādisānipi hi manussā chaḍḍenti.

vsm1.2:17.6.verse: Dhajāhaṭanti nāvaṃ ārohantā dhajaṃ bandhitvā ārūhanti.

vsm1.2:17.8.verse: Yampi yuddhabhūmiyaṃ dhajaṃ bandhitvā ṭhapitaṃ, taṃ dvinnampi senānaṃ gatakāle gahetuṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:18.6.verse: Yaṃ pana sāmikānaṃ satisammosena patitaṃ, taṃ thokaṃ rakkhitvā gahetabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:18.8.verse: taṃ pana sāmike apassantena gahetuṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:19.1.verse: Yaṃ pana saṅghassa demāti dinnaṃ, coḷakabhikkhāya vā caramānehi laddhaṃ, na taṃ paṃsukūlaṃ.

vsm1.2:19.2.verse: Bhikkhudattiyepi yaṃ vassaggena gāhetvā vā dīyati,

vsm1.2:19.3.verse: senāsanacīvaraṃ vā hoti, na taṃ paṃsukūlaṃ.

vsm1.2:19.5.verse: Tatrapi yaṃ dāyakehi bhikkhussa pādamūle nikkhittaṃ,

vsm1.2:19.6.verse: tena pana bhikkhunā paṃsukūlikassa hatthe ṭhapetvā dinnaṃ, taṃ ekatosuddhikaṃ nāma.

vsm1.2:19.7.verse: Yaṃ bhikkhuno hatthe ṭhapetvā dinnaṃ, tena pana pādamūle ṭhapitaṃ, tampi ekatosuddhikaṃ.

vsm1.2:19.8.verse: Yaṃ bhikkhunopi pādamūle ṭhapitaṃ, tenāpi tatheva dinnaṃ, taṃ ubhatosuddhikaṃ.

vsm1.2:19.9.verse: Yaṃ hatthe ṭhapetvā laddhaṃ, hattheyeva ṭhapitaṃ, taṃ anukkaṭṭhacīvaraṃ nāma.

vsm1.2:19.10.verse: Iti imaṃ paṃsukūlabhedaṃ ñatvā paṃsukūlikena cīvaraṃ paribhuñjitabbanti idamettha vidhānaṃ.

vsm1.2:20.1.verse: Ayaṃ pana pabhedo, tayo paṃsukūlikā ukkaṭṭho majjhimo mudūti.

vsm1.2:20.5.verse: Tesu yassa kassaci attano ruciyā gihidinnakaṃ sāditakkhaṇe dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati.

vsm1.2:21.1.verse: Ayaṃ panānisaṃso, ‘‘paṃsukūlacīvaraṃ nissāya pabbajjā’’ti (mahāva. 128) vacanato nissayānurūpapaṭipattisabbhāvo, paṭhame ariyavaṃse patiṭṭhānaṃ, ārakkhadukkhābhāvo, aparāyattavuttitā,

vsm1.2:21.3.verse: ‘‘appāni ceva sulabhāni ca tāni ca anavajjānī’’ti (a. ni. 4.27; itivu. 101) bhagavatā saṃvaṇṇitapaccayatā, pāsādikatā,

vsm1.2:21.4.verse: appicchatādīnaṃ phalanipphatti, sammāpaṭipattiyā anubrūhanaṃ, pacchimāya janatāya diṭṭhānugatiāpādananti.

vsm1.2:22.1.verse:
Mārasenavighātāya, paṃsukūladharo yati;
Sannaddhakavaco yuddhe, khattiyo viya sobhati.

vsm1.2:22.2.verse:
Pahāya kāsikādīni, varavatthāni dhāritaṃ;
Yaṃ lokagarunā ko taṃ, paṃsukūlaṃ na dhāraye.

vsm1.2:22.3.verse:
Tasmā hi attano bhikkhu, paṭiññaṃ samanussaraṃ;
Yogācārānukūlamhi, paṃsukūle rato siyāti.

vsm1.2:23.2.verse: tecīvarikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:23.3.verse: Tena pana tecīvarikena cīvaradussaṃ labhitvā yāva aphāsukabhāvena kātuṃ vā na sakkoti,

vsm1.2:23.4.verse: vicārakaṃ vā na labhati, sūciādīsu vāssa kiñci na sampajjati, tāva nikkhipitabbaṃ. Nikkhittapaccayā doso natthi.

vsm1.2:23.5.verse: Rajitakālato pana paṭṭhāya nikkhipituṃ na vaṭṭati,

vsm1.2:24.2.verse: Tattha ukkaṭṭhena rajanakāle paṭhamaṃ antaravāsakaṃ vā uttarāsaṅgaṃ vā rajitvā taṃ nivāsetvā itaraṃ rajitabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:24.4.verse: Saṅghāṭiṃ pana nivāsetuṃ na vaṭṭati. Idamassa gāmantasenāsane vattaṃ.

vsm1.2:24.5.verse: Āraññake pana dve ekato dhovitvā rajituṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:24.6.verse: Yathā pana kañci disvā sakkoti kāsāvaṃ ākaḍḍhitvā uparikātuṃ, evaṃ āsanne ṭhāne nisīditabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:24.8.verse: taṃ nivāsetvā vā pārupitvā vā rajanakammaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:24.9.verse: Mudukassa sabhāgabhikkhūnaṃ cīvarāni nivāsetvā vā pārupitvā vā rajanakammaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:24.10.verse: Tatraṭṭhakapaccattharaṇampi tassa vaṭṭati. Pariharituṃ pana na vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:24.12.verse: Dhutaṅgatecīvarikassa pana catutthaṃ vattamānaṃ aṃsakāsāvameva vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:24.13.verse: Tañca kho vitthārato vidatthi, dīghato tihatthameva vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:24.14.verse: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi catutthakacīvaraṃ sāditakkhaṇeyeva dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati. Ayamettha bhedo.

vsm1.2:25.1.verse: Ayaṃpanānisaṃso, tecīvariko bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena.

vsm1.2:25.2.verse: Tenassa pakkhino viya samādāyeva gamanaṃ, appasamārambhatā, vatthasannidhiparivajjanaṃ,

vsm1.2:25.3.verse: sallahukavuttitā, atirekacīvaraloluppappahānaṃ, kappiye mattakāritāya sallekhavuttitā, appicchatādīnaṃ phalanipphattīti evamādayo guṇā sampajjantīti.

vsm1.2:26.1.verse:
Atirekavatthataṇhaṃ, pahāya sannidhivivajjito dhīro;
Santosasukharasaññū, ticīvaradharo bhavati yogī.

vsm1.2:26.2.verse:
Tasmā sapattacaraṇo, pakkhīva sacīvarova yogivaro;
Sukhamanuvicaritukāmo, cīvaraniyame ratiṃ kayirāti.

vsm1.2:27.2.verse: piṇḍapātikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:27.3.verse: Tena pana piṇḍapātikena ‘‘saṅghabhattaṃ, uddesabhattaṃ, nimantanabhattaṃ, salākabhattaṃ, pakkhikaṃ,

vsm1.2:27.5.verse: gilānupaṭṭhākabhattaṃ, vihārabhattaṃ, dhurabhattaṃ, vārakabhatta’’nti etāni cuddasa bhattāni na sāditabbāni.

vsm1.2:27.6.verse: Sace pana ‘‘saṅghabhattaṃ gaṇhathā’’tiādinā nayena avatvā ‘‘amhākaṃ gehe saṅgho bhikkhaṃ gaṇhātu, tumhepi bhikkhaṃ gaṇhathā’’ti vatvā dinnāni honti,

vsm1.2:27.8.verse: Saṅghato nirāmisasalākāpi vihāre pakkabhattampi vaṭṭatiyevāti idamassa vidhānaṃ.

vsm1.2:28.2.verse: Tattha ukkaṭṭho puratopi pacchatopi āhaṭabhikkhaṃ gaṇhati, pattadvāre ṭhatvā pattaṃ gaṇhantānampi deti,

vsm1.2:28.4.verse: taṃ divasaṃ pana nisīditvā bhikkhaṃ na gaṇhati.

vsm1.2:28.8.verse: Te ubhopi serivihārasukhaṃ na labhanti, ukkaṭṭhova labhati.

vsm1.2:28.9.verse: Ekasmiṃ kira gāme ariyavaṃso hoti, ukkaṭṭho itare āha – ‘‘āyāmāvuso, dhammasavanāyā’’ti.

vsm1.2:28.10.verse: Tesu eko ekenamhi, bhante, manussena nisīdāpitoti āha. Aparo mayā, bhante, svātanāya ekassa bhikkhā adhivāsitāti.

vsm1.2:28.11.verse: Evaṃ te ubho parihīnā. Itaro pātova piṇḍāya caritvā gantvā dhammarasaṃ paṭisaṃvedesi.

vsm1.2:28.12.verse: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi saṅghabhattādiatirekalābhaṃ sāditakkhaṇeva dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati.

vsm1.2:29.1.verse: Ayaṃ panānisaṃso, ‘‘piṇḍiyālopabhojanaṃ nissāya pabbajjā’’ti (a. ni. 4.27; itivu. 101) vacanato nissayānurūpapaṭipattisabbhāvo, dutiye ariyavaṃse patiṭṭhānaṃ, aparāyattavuttitā, ‘‘appāni ceva sulabhāni ca tāni ca anavajjānī’’ti bhagavatā saṃvaṇṇitapaccayatā,

vsm1.2:30.1.verse:
Piṇḍiyālopasantuṭṭho, aparāyattajīviko;
Pahīnāhāraloluppo, hoti cātuddiso yati.

vsm1.2:30.2.verse:
Vinodayati kosajjaṃ, ājīvassa visujjhati;
Tasmā hi nātimaññeyya, bhikkhācariyāya sumedhaso.

vsm1.2:30.4.verse:
‘‘Piṇḍapātikassa bhikkhuno,
Attabharassa anaññaposino;
Devāpi pihayanti tādino,
No ce lābhasilokanissito’’ti.

vsm1.2:31.2.verse: sapadānacārikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:31.3.verse: Tena pana sapadānacārikena gāmadvāre ṭhatvā parissayābhāvo sallakkhetabbo.

vsm1.2:31.4.verse: Yassā racchāya vā gāme vā parissayo hoti, taṃ pahāya aññattha carituṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:31.5.verse: Yasmiṃ gharadvāre vā racchāya vā gāme vā kiñci na labhati,

vsm1.2:31.7.verse: Yattha kiñci labhati, taṃ pahāya gantuṃ na vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:31.8.verse: Iminā ca bhikkhunā kālataraṃ pavisitabbaṃ, evañhi aphāsukaṭṭhānaṃ pahāya aññattha gantuṃ sakkhissati.

vsm1.2:31.9.verse: Sace panassa vihāre dānaṃ dentā antarāmagge vā āgacchantā manussā pattaṃ gahetvā piṇḍapātaṃ denti vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:31.10.verse: Iminā ca maggaṃ gacchantenāpi bhikkhācāravelāyaṃ sampattagāmaṃ anatikkamitvā caritabbameva.

vsm1.2:31.11.verse: Tattha alabhitvā vā thokaṃ labhitvā vā gāmapaṭipāṭiyā caritabbanti idamassa vidhānaṃ.

vsm1.2:32.2.verse: Tattha ukkaṭṭho purato āhaṭabhikkhampi pacchato āhaṭabhikkhampi paṭikkamanaṃ āharitvā diyyamānampi na gaṇhati,

vsm1.2:32.4.verse: Imasmiñhi dhutaṅge mahākassapattherena sadiso nāma natthi.

vsm1.2:32.6.verse: Majjhimo purato vā pacchato vā āhaṭampi paṭikkamanaṃ āhaṭampi gaṇhati, pattadvārepi pattaṃ vissajjeti,

vsm1.2:32.7.verse: na pana bhikkhaṃ āgamayamāno nisīdati. Evaṃ so ukkaṭṭhapiṇḍapātikassa anulometi.

vsm1.2:32.9.verse: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi loluppacāre uppannamatte dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati. Ayamettha bhedo.

vsm1.2:33.1.verse: Ayaṃ panānisaṃso, kulesu niccanavakatā, candūpamatā, kulamaccherappahānaṃ,

vsm1.2:33.2.verse: samānukampitā, kulūpakādīnavābhāvo, avhānānabhinandanā, abhihārena anatthikatā, appicchatādīnaṃ anulomavuttitāti.

vsm1.2:34.1.verse:
Candūpamo niccanavo kulesu,
Amaccharī sabbasamānukampo;
Kulūpakādīnavavippamutto,
Hotīdha bhikkhu sapadānacārī.

vsm1.2:34.2.verse:
Loluppacārañca pahāya tasmā,
Okkhittacakkhu yugamattadassī;
Ākaṅkhamāno bhuvi sericāraṃ,
Careyya dhīro sapadānacāranti.

vsm1.2:35.2.verse: ekāsanikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:35.3.verse: Tena pana ekāsanikena āsanasālāyaṃ nisīdantena therāsane anisīditvā

vsm1.2:35.4.verse: ‘‘idaṃ mayhaṃ pāpuṇissatī’’ti patirūpaṃ āsanaṃ sallakkhetvā nisīditabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:35.5.verse: Sacassa vippakate bhojane ācariyo vā upajjhāyo vā āgacchati, uṭṭhāya vattaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:35.6.verse: Tipiṭakacūḷābhayatthero panāha ‘‘āsanaṃ vā rakkheyya bhojanaṃ vā,

vsm1.2:35.7.verse: ayañca vippakatabhojano, tasmā vattaṃ karotu, bhojanaṃ pana mā bhuñjatū’’ti.

vsm1.2:36.2.verse: Tattha ukkaṭṭho appaṃ vā hotu bahu vā, yamhi bhojane hatthaṃ otāreti, tato aññaṃ gaṇhituṃ na labhati.

vsm1.2:36.3.verse: Sacepi manussā ‘‘therena na kiñci bhutta’’nti sappiādīni āharanti,

vsm1.2:36.5.verse: Majjhimo yāva patte bhattaṃ na khīyati,

vsm1.2:36.6.verse: tāva aññaṃ gaṇhituṃ labhati. Ayañhi bhojanapariyantiko nāma hoti.

vsm1.2:36.7.verse: Muduko yāva āsanā na vuṭṭhāti tāva bhuñjituṃ labhati.

vsm1.2:36.8.verse: So hi udakapariyantiko vā hoti yāva pattadhovanaṃ na gaṇhāti tāva bhuñjanato, āsanapariyantiko vā yāva na vuṭṭhāti tāva bhuñjanato.

vsm1.2:36.9.verse: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi nānāsanabhojanaṃ bhuttakkhaṇe dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati. Ayamettha bhedo.

vsm1.2:37.1.verse: Ayaṃ panānisaṃso, appābādhatā, appātaṅkatā, lahuṭṭhānaṃ, balaṃ, phāsuvihāro,

vsm1.2:38.1.verse:
Ekāsanabhojane rataṃ,
Na yatiṃ bhojanapaccayā rujā;
Visahanti rase alolupo,
Parihāpeti na kammamattano.

vsm1.2:38.2.verse:
Iti phāsuvihārakāraṇe,
Sucisallekharatūpasevite;
Janayetha visuddhamānaso,
Ratimekāsanabhojaneti.

vsm1.2:39.2.verse: pattapiṇḍikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:39.3.verse: Tena pana pattapiṇḍikena yāgupānakāle bhājane ṭhapetvā byañjane laddhe

vsm1.2:39.4.verse: byañjanaṃ vā paṭhamaṃ khāditabbaṃ, yāgu vā pātabbā.

vsm1.2:39.5.verse: Sace pana yāguyaṃ pakkhipati, pūtimacchakādimhi byañjane pakkhitte yāgu paṭikūlā hoti,

vsm1.2:39.6.verse: appaṭikūlameva ca katvā bhuñjituṃ vaṭṭati. Tasmā tathārūpaṃ byañjanaṃ sandhāya idaṃ vuttaṃ.

vsm1.2:39.8.verse: taṃ pakkhipitabbaṃ. Gaṇhantena ca pamāṇayuttameva gaṇhitabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:39.9.verse: Āmakasākaṃ hatthena gahetvā khādituṃ vaṭṭati. Tathā pana akatvā patteyeva pakkhipitabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:39.10.verse: Dutiyakabhājanassa pana paṭikkhittattā aññaṃ rukkhapaṇṇampi na vaṭṭatīti idamassa vidhānaṃ.

vsm1.2:40.2.verse: Tattha ukkaṭṭhassa aññatra ucchukhādanakālā kacavarampi chaḍḍetuṃ na vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:40.4.verse: Majjhimassa ekena hatthena bhinditvā khādituṃ vaṭṭati, hatthayogī nāmesa.

vsm1.2:40.6.verse: tassa yaṃ sakkā hoti patte pakkhipituṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ hatthena vā dantehi vā bhinditvā khādituṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:40.7.verse: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi dutiyakabhājanaṃ sāditakkhaṇe dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati. Ayamettha bhedo.

vsm1.2:41.2.verse: āhāre payojanamattadassitā, thālakādipariharaṇakhedābhāvo, avikkhittabhojitā, appicchatādīnaṃ anulomavuttitāti.

vsm1.2:42.1.verse:
Nānābhājanavikkhepaṃ, hitvā okkhittalocano;
Khaṇanto viya mūlāni, rasataṇhāya subbato.

vsm1.2:42.2.verse:
Sarūpaṃ viya santuṭṭhiṃ, dhārayanto sumānaso;
Paribhuñjeyya āhāraṃ, ko añño pattapiṇḍikoti.

vsm1.2:43.2.verse: khalupacchābhattikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:43.3.verse: Tena pana khalupacchābhattikena pavāretvā puna bhojanaṃ kappiyaṃ kāretvā na bhuñjitabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:44.2.verse: Tattha ukkaṭṭho yasmā paṭhamapiṇḍe pavāraṇā nāma natthi, tasmiṃ pana ajjhohariyamāne aññaṃ paṭikkhipato hoti,

vsm1.2:44.3.verse: tasmā evaṃ pavārito paṭhamapiṇḍaṃ ajjhoharitvā dutiyapiṇḍaṃ na bhuñjati.

vsm1.2:44.4.verse: Majjhimo yasmiṃ bhojane pavārito, tadeva bhuñjati.

vsm1.2:44.5.verse: Muduko pana yāva āsanā na vuṭṭhāti tāva bhuñjati.

vsm1.2:44.6.verse: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi pavāritānaṃ kappiyaṃ kārāpetvā bhuttakkhaṇe dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati. Ayamettha bhedo.

vsm1.2:45.2.verse: nirāmisasannidhitā, puna pariyesanāya abhāvo, appicchatādīnaṃ anulomavuttitāti.

vsm1.2:46.1.verse:
Pariyesanāya khedaṃ, na yāti na karoti sannidhiṃ dhīro;
Odarikattaṃ pajahati, khalupacchābhattiko yogī.

vsm1.2:46.2.verse:
Tasmā sugatapasatthaṃ, santosaguṇādivuḍḍhisañjananaṃ;
Dose vidhunitukāmo, bhajeyya yogī dhutaṅgamidanti.

vsm1.2:47.2.verse: āraññikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:48.1.verse: Tena pana āraññikena gāmantasenāsanaṃ pahāya araññe aruṇaṃ uṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:48.3.verse: Gāmo nāma yo koci ekakuṭiko vā anekakuṭiko vā parikkhitto vā aparikkhitto vā samanusso vā amanusso vā antamaso atirekacātumāsaniviṭṭho yo koci satthopi.

vsm1.2:48.4.verse: Gāmūpacāro nāma parikkhittassa gāmassa sace anurādhapurasseva dve indakhīlā honti, abbhantarime indakhīle ṭhitassa thāmamajjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto.

vsm1.2:48.5.verse: Tassa lakkhaṇaṃ yathā taruṇamanussā attano balaṃ dassentā bāhaṃ pasāretvā leḍḍuṃ khipanti, evaṃ khittassa leḍḍussa patanaṭṭhānabbhantaranti vinayadharā.

vsm1.2:48.7.verse: Aparikkhittagāme yaṃ sabbapaccantimassa gharassa dvāre ṭhito mātugāmo bhājanena udakaṃ chaḍḍeti, tassa patanaṭṭhānaṃ gharūpacāro.

vsm1.2:48.8.verse: Tato vuttanayena eko leḍḍupāto gāmo, dutiyo gāmūpacāro.

vsm1.2:49.1.verse: Araññaṃ pana vinayapariyāye tāva ‘‘ṭhapetvā gāmañca gāmūpacārañca sabbametaṃ arañña’’nti (pārā. 92) vuttaṃ.

vsm1.2:49.2.verse: Abhidhammapariyāye ‘‘nikkhamitvā bahi indakhīlā, sabbametaṃ arañña’’nti (vibha. 529) vuttaṃ.

vsm1.2:49.3.verse: Imasmiṃ pana suttantikapariyāye ‘‘āraññakaṃ nāma senāsanaṃ pañcadhanusatikaṃ pacchima’’nti idaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ.

vsm1.2:49.4.verse: Taṃ āropitena ācariyadhanunā parikkhittassa gāmassa indakhīlato aparikkhittassa paṭhamaleḍḍupātato paṭṭhāya yāva vihāraparikkhepā minitvā vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:50.2.verse: yaṃ sabbapaṭhamaṃ senāsanaṃ vā bhattasālā vā dhuvasannipātaṭṭhānaṃ vā bodhi vā cetiyaṃ vā dūre cepi senāsanato hoti, taṃ paricchedaṃ katvā minitabbanti vinayaṭṭhakathāsu vuttaṃ.

vsm1.2:50.3.verse: Majjhimaṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana vihārassapi gāmasseva upacāraṃ nīharitvā ubhinnaṃ leḍḍupātānaṃ antarā minitabbanti vuttaṃ.

vsm1.2:51.1.verse: Sacepi āsanne gāmo hoti, vihāre ṭhitehi mānusakānaṃ saddo suyyati, pabbatanadīādīhi pana antaritattā na sakkā ujuṃ gantuṃ.

vsm1.2:51.2.verse: Yo tassa pakatimaggo hoti, sacepi nāvāya sañcaritabbo, tena maggena pañcadhanusatikaṃ gahetabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:51.3.verse: Yo pana āsannagāmassa aṅgasampādanatthaṃ tato tato maggaṃ pidahati,

vsm1.2:52.1.verse: Sace pana āraññikassa bhikkhuno upajjhāyo vā ācariyo vā gilāno hoti,

vsm1.2:52.2.verse: tena araññe sappāyaṃ alabhantena gāmantasenāsanaṃ netvā upaṭṭhātabbo.

vsm1.2:52.3.verse: Kālasseva pana nikkhamitvā aṅgayuttaṭṭhāne aruṇaṃ uṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:52.5.verse: tesaṃyeva kiccaṃ kātabbaṃ. Na dhutaṅgasuddhikena bhavitabbanti idamassa vidhānaṃ.

vsm1.2:53.2.verse: Tattha ukkaṭṭhena sabbakālaṃ araññe aruṇaṃ uṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:53.3.verse: Majjhimo cattāro vassike māse gāmante vasituṃ labhati. Muduko hemantikepi.

vsm1.2:53.4.verse: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi yathā paricchinne kāle araññato āgantvā gāmantasenāsane dhammassavanaṃ suṇantānaṃ aruṇe uṭṭhitepi dhutaṅgaṃ na bhijjati.

vsm1.2:53.5.verse: Sutvā gacchantānaṃ antarāmagge uṭṭhitepi na bhijjati.

vsm1.2:53.6.verse: Sace pana uṭṭhitepi dhammakathike muhuttaṃ nipajjitvā gamissāmāti niddāyantānaṃ aruṇaṃ uṭṭhahati,

vsm1.2:53.7.verse: attano vā ruciyā gāmantasenāsane aruṇaṃ uṭṭhapenti, dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjatīti ayamettha bhedo.

vsm1.2:54.1.verse: Ayaṃpanānisaṃso, āraññiko bhikkhu araññasaññaṃ manasikaronto bhabbo aladdhaṃ vā samādhiṃ paṭiladdhuṃ laddhaṃ vā rakkhituṃ,

vsm1.2:54.3.verse: Yathāha – ‘‘tenāhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārenā’’ti (a. ni. 6.42; 8.86).

vsm1.2:54.4.verse: Pantasenāsanavāsino cassa asappāyarūpādayo cittaṃ na vikkhipanti, vigatasantāso hoti,

vsm1.2:54.5.verse: jīvitanikantiṃ jahati, pavivekasukharasaṃ assādeti, paṃsukūlikādibhāvopi cassa patirūpo hotīti.

vsm1.2:55.1.verse:
Pavivitto asaṃsaṭṭho, pantasenāsane rato;
Ārādhayanto nāthassa, vanavāsena mānasaṃ.

vsm1.2:55.2.verse:
Eko araññe nivasaṃ, yaṃ sukhaṃ labhate yati;
Rasaṃ tassa na vindanti, api devā saindakā.

vsm1.2:55.3.verse:
Paṃsukūlañca esova, kavacaṃ viya dhārayaṃ;
Araññasaṅgāmagato, avasesadhutāyudho.

vsm1.2:55.4.verse:
Samattho nacirasseva, jetuṃ māraṃ savāhiniṃ;
Tasmā araññavāsamhi, ratiṃ kayirātha paṇḍitoti.

vsm1.2:56.2.verse: rukkhamūlikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:56.3.verse: Tena pana rukkhamūlikena sīmantarikarukkhaṃ, cetiyarukkhaṃ, niyyāsarukkhaṃ, phalarukkhaṃ,

vsm1.2:56.4.verse: vaggulirukkhaṃ, susirarukkhaṃ, vihāramajjhe ṭhitarukkhanti ime rukkhe vivajjetvā vihārapaccante ṭhitarukkho gahetabboti idamassa vidhānaṃ.

vsm1.2:57.2.verse: Tattha ukkaṭṭho yathārucitaṃ rukkhaṃ gahetvā paṭijaggāpetuṃ na labhati.

vsm1.2:57.4.verse: Majjhimo taṃ ṭhānaṃ sampattehiyeva paṭijaggāpetuṃ labhati.

vsm1.2:57.5.verse: Mudukena ārāmikasamaṇuddese pakkositvā sodhāpetvā samaṃ kārāpetvā vālukaṃ okirāpetvā pākāraparikkhepaṃ kārāpetvā dvāraṃ yojāpetvā vasitabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:57.6.verse: Mahadivase pana rukkhamūlikena tattha anisīditvā aññattha paṭicchanne ṭhāne nisīditabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:57.7.verse: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi channe vāsaṃ kappitakkhaṇe dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati.

vsm1.2:57.8.verse: Jānitvā channe aruṇaṃ uṭṭhāpitamatteti aṅguttarabhāṇakā. Ayamettha bhedo.

vsm1.2:58.1.verse: Ayaṃ panānisaṃso, rukkhamūlasenāsanaṃ nissāya pabbajjāti (mahāva. 128) vacanato nissayānurūpapaṭipattisabbhāvo, appāni ceva sulabhāni ca tāni ca anavajjānīti (a. ni. 4.27; itivu. 101) bhagavatā saṃvaṇṇitapaccayatā,

vsm1.2:59.1.verse:
Vaṇṇito buddhaseṭṭhena, nissayoti ca bhāsito;
Nivāso pavivittassa, rukkhamūlasamo kuto.

vsm1.2:59.2.verse:
Āvāsamaccherahare, devatā paripālite;
Pavivitte vasanto hi, rukkhamūlamhi subbato.

vsm1.2:59.3.verse:
Abhirattāni nīlāni, paṇḍūni patitāni ca;
Passanto tarupaṇṇāni, niccasaññaṃ panūdati.

vsm1.2:59.4.verse:
Tasmā hi buddhadāyajjaṃ, bhāvanābhiratālayaṃ;
Vivittaṃ nātimaññeyya, rukkhamūlaṃ vicakkhaṇoti.

vsm1.2:60.2.verse: abbhokāsikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:60.3.verse: Tassa pana abbhokāsikassa dhammassavanāya vā uposathatthāya vā uposathāgāraṃ pavisituṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:60.4.verse: Sace paviṭṭhassa devo vassati, deve vassamāne anikkhamitvā vassūparame nikkhamitabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:60.5.verse: Bhojanasālaṃ vā aggisālaṃ vā pavisitvā vattaṃ kātuṃ, bhojanasālāya there bhikkhū bhattena āpucchituṃ,

vsm1.2:60.6.verse: uddisantena vā uddisāpentena vā channaṃ pavisituṃ, bahi dunnikkhittāni mañcapīṭhādīni anto pavesetuñca vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:60.7.verse: Sace maggaṃ gacchantena vuḍḍhatarānaṃ parikkhāro gahito hoti, deve vassante maggamajjhe ṭhitaṃ sālaṃ pavisituṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:60.8.verse: Sace na kiñci gahitaṃ hoti, sālāya ṭhassāmīti vegena gantuṃ na vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:60.9.verse: Pakatigatiyā gantvā paviṭṭhena pana yāva vassūparamā ṭhatvā gantabbanti idamassa vidhānaṃ. Rukkhamūlikassāpi eseva nayo.

vsm1.2:61.2.verse: Tattha ukkaṭṭhassa rukkhaṃ vā pabbataṃ vā gehaṃ vā upanissāya vasituṃ na vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:61.4.verse: Majjhimassa rukkhapabbatagehāni upanissāya anto appavisitvā vasituṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:61.5.verse: Mudukassa acchannamariyādaṃ pabbhārampi sākhāmaṇḍapopi pīṭhapaṭopi khettarakkhakādīhi chaḍḍitā tatraṭṭhakakuṭikāpi vaṭṭatīti.

vsm1.2:61.6.verse: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi vāsatthāya channaṃ vā rukkhamūlaṃ vā paviṭṭhakkhaṇe dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati.

vsm1.2:61.7.verse: Jānitvā tattha aruṇaṃ uṭṭhāpitamatteti aṅguttarabhāṇakā. Ayamettha bhedo.

vsm1.2:62.2.verse: ‘‘migā viya asaṅgacārino, aniketā viharanti bhikkhavo’’ti (saṃ. ni. 1.224) pasaṃsāya anurūpatā, nissaṅgatā, cātuddisatā, appicchatādīnaṃ anulomavuttitāti.

vsm1.2:63.2.verse:
Abbhokāse vasaṃ bhikkhu, migabhūtena cetasā;
Thinamiddhaṃ vinodetvā, bhāvanārāmataṃ sito.

vsm1.2:63.3.verse:
Pavivekarasassādaṃ, nacirasseva vindati;
Yasmā tasmā hi sappañño, abbhokāsarato siyāti.

vsm1.2:64.2.verse: sosānikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:64.3.verse: Tena pana sosānikena yaṃ manussā gāmaṃ nivesantā ‘‘idaṃ susāna’’nti vavatthapenti, na tattha vasitabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:64.4.verse: Na hi matasarīre ajjhāpite taṃ susānaṃ nāma hoti,

vsm1.2:64.5.verse: jhāpitakālato pana paṭṭhāya sacepi dvādasavassāni chaḍḍitaṃ, taṃ susānameva.

vsm1.2:65.1.verse: Tasmiṃ pana vasantena caṅkamamaṇḍapādīni kāretvā mañcapīṭhaṃ paññapetvā pānīyaparibhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā dhammaṃ vācentena na vasitabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:65.2.verse: Garukaṃ hi idaṃ dhutaṅgaṃ, tasmā uppannaparissayavighātatthāya saṅghattheraṃ vā rājayuttakaṃ vā jānāpetvā appamattena vasitabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:65.4.verse: Susānaṃ gacchantenāpi mahāpathā ukkamma uppathamaggena gantabbaṃ. Divāyeva ārammaṇaṃ vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:65.5.verse: Evañhissa taṃ rattiṃ bhayānakaṃ na bhavissati, amanussā rattiṃ viravitvā viravitvā āhiṇḍantāpi na kenaci paharitabbā.

vsm1.2:65.7.verse: Majjhimayāmaṃ susāne khepetvā pacchimayāme paṭikkamituṃ vaṭṭatīti aṅguttarabhāṇakā.

vsm1.2:66.2.verse: Tattha ukkaṭṭhena yattha dhuvaḍāhadhuvakuṇapadhuvarodanāni atthi, tattheva vasitabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:66.3.verse: Majjhimassa tīsu ekasmimpi sati vaṭṭati. Mudukassa vuttanayena susānalakkhaṇaṃ pattamatte vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:66.4.verse: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi na susānamhi vāsaṃ kappanena dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati.

vsm1.2:67.1.verse: Ayaṃ panānisaṃso maraṇassatipaṭilābho, appamādavihāritā, asubhanimittādhigamo, kāmarāgavinodanaṃ,

vsm1.2:67.2.verse: abhiṇhaṃ kāyasabhāvadassanaṃ, saṃvegabahulatā ārogyamadādippahānaṃ, bhayabheravasahanatā, amanussānaṃ garubhāvanīyatā, appicchatādīnaṃ anulomavuttitāti.

vsm1.2:68.1.verse:
Sosānikañhi maraṇānusatippabhāvā,
Niddāgatampi na phusanti pamādadosā;
Sampassato ca kuṇapāni bahūni tassa,
Kāmānubhāvavasagampi na hoti cittaṃ.

vsm1.2:68.2.verse:
Saṃvegameti vipulaṃ na madaṃ upeti,
Sammā atho ghaṭati nibbutimesamāno;
Sosānikaṅgamitinekaguṇāvahattā,
Nibbānaninnahadayena nisevitabbanti.

vsm1.2:69.2.verse: yathāsanthatikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:69.3.verse: Tena pana yathāsanthatikena yadassa senāsanaṃ ‘‘idaṃ tuyhaṃ pāpuṇātī’’ti gāhitaṃ hoti,

vsm1.2:70.2.verse: Tattha ukkaṭṭho attano pattasenāsanaṃ dūreti vā accāsanneti vā amanussadīghajātikādīhi upaddutanti vā uṇhanti vā sītalanti vā pucchituṃ na labhati.

vsm1.2:70.3.verse: Majjhimo pucchituṃ labhati. Gantvā pana oloketuṃ na labhati.

vsm1.2:70.4.verse: Muduko gantvā oloketvā sacassa taṃ na ruccati, aññaṃ gahetuṃ labhati.

vsm1.2:70.5.verse: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi senāsanaloluppe uppannamatte dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjatīti ayamettha bhedo.

vsm1.2:71.1.verse: Ayaṃ panānisaṃso, ‘‘yaṃ laddhaṃ tena tuṭṭhabba’’nti (jā. 1.1.136; pāci. 793) vuttovādakaraṇaṃ, sabrahmacārīnaṃ hitesitā,

vsm1.2:71.2.verse: hīnapaṇītavikappapariccāgo, anurodhavirodhappahānaṃ, atricchatāya dvārapidahanaṃ, appicchatādīnaṃ anulomavuttitāti.

vsm1.2:72.1.verse:
Yaṃ laddhaṃ tena santuṭṭho, yathāsanthatiko yati;
Nibbikappo sukhaṃ seti, tiṇasantharakesupi.

vsm1.2:72.2.verse:
Na so rajjati seṭṭhamhi, hīnaṃ laddhā na kuppati;
Sabrahmacārinavake, hitena anukampati.

vsm1.2:72.3.verse:
Tasmā ariyasatāciṇṇaṃ, munipuṅgavavaṇṇitaṃ;
Anuyuñjetha medhāvī, yathāsanthatarāmatanti.

vsm1.2:73.2.verse: nesajjikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:73.3.verse: Tena pana nesajjikena rattiyā tīsu yāmesu ekaṃ yāmaṃ uṭṭhāya caṅkamitabbaṃ. Iriyāpathesu hi nipajjitumeva na vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:74.2.verse: Tattha ukkaṭṭhassa neva apassenaṃ, na dussapallatthikā, na āyogapaṭṭo vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:74.4.verse: Mudukassa apassenampi dussapallatthikāpi āyogapaṭṭopi bibbohanampi pañcaṅgopi sattaṅgopi vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:74.6.verse: Sattaṅgo nāma piṭṭhiapassayena ca ubhatopassesu apassayehi ca saddhiṃ kato.

vsm1.2:74.7.verse: Taṃ kira miḷābhayattherassa akaṃsu. Thero anāgāmī hutvā parinibbāyi.

vsm1.2:74.8.verse: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi seyyaṃ kappitamatte dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati. Ayamettha bhedo.

vsm1.2:75.1.verse: Ayaṃ panānisaṃso, ‘‘seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharatī’’ti (dī. ni. 3.320; ma. ni. 1.186) vuttassa cetaso vinibandhassa upacchedanaṃ,

vsm1.2:76.1.verse:
Ābhujitvāna pallaṅkaṃ, paṇidhāya ujuṃ tanuṃ;
Nisīdanto vikampeti, mārassa hadayaṃ yati.

vsm1.2:76.2.verse:
Seyyasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ, hitvā āraddhavīriyo;
Nisajjābhirato bhikkhu, sobhayanto tapovanaṃ.

vsm1.2:76.3.verse:
Nirāmisaṃ pītisukhaṃ, yasmā samadhigacchati;
Tasmā samanuyuñjeyya, dhīro nesajjikaṃ vatanti.

vsm1.2:77.1.verse:
Idāni –
Kusalattikato ceva, dhutādīnaṃ vibhāgato;
Samāsabyāsato cāpi, viññātabbo vinicchayoti. –
Imissā gāthāya vasena vaṇṇanā hoti.

vsm1.2:78.1.verse: Tattha kusalattikatoti sabbāneva hi dhutaṅgāni sekkhaputhujjanakhīṇāsavānaṃ vasena siyā kusalāni,

vsm1.2:78.3.verse: Yo pana vadeyya ‘‘pāpiccho icchāpakato āraññiko hotīti ādivacanato (a. ni. 5.181; pari. 325) akusalampi dhutaṅga’’nti.

vsm1.2:78.4.verse: So vattabbo – na mayaṃ ‘‘akusalacittena araññe na vasatī’’ti vadāma.

vsm1.2:78.5.verse: Yassa hi araññe nivāso, so āraññiko. So ca pāpiccho vā bhaveyya appiccho vā.

vsm1.2:78.6.verse: Imāni pana tena tena samādānena dhutakilesattā dhutassa bhikkhuno aṅgāni, kilesadhunanato vā dhutanti laddhavohāraṃ ñāṇaṃ aṅgametesanti dhutaṅgāni.

vsm1.2:78.7.verse: Atha vā dhutāni ca tāni paṭipakkhaniddhunanato aṅgāni ca paṭipattiyātipi dhutaṅgānīti vuttaṃ.

vsm1.2:78.8.verse: Na ca akusalena koci dhuto nāma hoti, yassetāni aṅgāni bhaveyyuṃ, na ca akusalaṃ kiñci dhunāti, yesaṃ taṃ aṅgantikatvā dhutaṅgānīti vucceyyuṃ.

vsm1.2:78.9.verse: Nāpi akusalaṃ cīvaraloluppādīni ceva niddhunāti paṭipattiyā ca aṅgaṃ hoti.

vsm1.2:79.1.verse: ‘‘Yesampi kusalattikavinimuttaṃ dhutaṅgaṃ, tesaṃ atthato dhutaṅgameva natthi.

vsm1.2:79.2.verse: Asantaṃ kassa dhunanato dhutaṅgaṃ nāma bhavissati.

vsm1.2:79.3.verse: Dhutaguṇe samādāya vattatīti vacanavirodhopi ca nesaṃ āpajjati,

vsm1.2:79.4.verse: tasmā taṃ na gahetabba’’nti ayaṃ tāva kusalattikato vaṇṇanā.

vsm1.2:80.1.verse: Dhutādīnaṃvibhāgatoti dhuto veditabbo. Dhutavādo veditabbo. Dhutadhammā veditabbā. Dhutaṅgāni veditabbāni. Kassa dhutaṅgasevanā sappāyāti veditabbaṃ.

vsm1.2:81.1.verse: Tattha dhutoti dhutakileso vā puggalo kilesadhunano vā dhammo.

vsm1.2:81.2.verse: Dhutavādoti ettha pana atthi dhuto na dhutavādo, atthi na dhuto dhutavādo,

vsm1.2:81.3.verse: atthi neva dhuto na dhutavādo, atthi dhuto ceva dhutavādo ca.

vsm1.2:82.1.verse: Tattha yo dhutaṅgena attano kilese dhuni, paraṃ pana dhutaṅgena na ovadati, nānusāsati bākulatthero viya, ayaṃ dhuto na dhutavādo.

vsm1.2:82.2.verse: Yathāha, ‘‘tayidaṃ āyasmā bākulo dhuto na dhutavādo’’ti.

vsm1.2:82.3.verse: Yo pana na dhutaṅgena attano kilese dhuni, kevalaṃ aññe dhutaṅgena ovadati anusāsati upanandatthero viya, ayaṃ na dhuto dhutavādo.

vsm1.2:82.4.verse: Yathāha, ‘‘tayidaṃ āyasmā upanando sakyaputto na dhuto dhutavādo’’ti.

vsm1.2:82.5.verse: Yo ubhayavipanno lāḷudāyī viya, ayaṃ neva dhuto na dhutavādo.

vsm1.2:82.6.verse: Yathāha, ‘‘tayidaṃ āyasmā lāḷudāyī neva dhuto na dhutavādo’’ti.

vsm1.2:82.7.verse: Yo pana ubhayasampanno dhammasenāpati viya, ayaṃ dhuto ceva dhutavādo ca.

vsm1.2:82.8.verse: Yathāha, ‘‘tayidaṃ āyasmā sāriputto dhuto ceva dhutavādo cāti.

vsm1.2:83.1.verse: Dhutadhammā veditabbāti appicchatā, santuṭṭhitā, sallekhatā, pavivekatā, idamatthitāti

vsm1.2:83.2.verse: ime dhutaṅgacetanāya parivārakā pañca dhammā ‘‘appicchataṃyeva nissāyā’’tiādivacanato (a. ni. 5.181; pari. 325) dhutadhammā nāma.

vsm1.2:84.1.verse: Tattha appicchatā ca santuṭṭhitā ca alobho.

vsm1.2:84.2.verse: Sallekhatā ca pavivekatā ca dvīsu dhammesu anupatanti alobhe ca amohe ca. Idamatthitā ñāṇameva.

vsm1.2:84.5.verse: Alobhena ca anuññātānaṃ paṭisevanamukhena pavattaṃ kāmasukhānuyogaṃ,

vsm1.2:84.6.verse: amohena dhutaṅgesu atisallekhamukhena pavattaṃ attakilamathānuyogaṃ dhunāti. Tasmā ime dhammā dhutadhammāti veditabbā.

vsm1.2:85.1.verse: Dhutaṅgāni veditabbānīti terasa dhutaṅgāni veditabbāni paṃsukūlikaṅgaṃ…pe… nesajjikaṅganti.

vsm1.2:86.1.verse: Kassa dhutaṅgasevanā sappāyāti rāgacaritassa ceva mohacaritassa ca.

vsm1.2:86.2.verse: Kasmā? Dhutaṅgasevanā hi dukkhāpaṭipadā ceva sallekhavihāro ca.

vsm1.2:86.3.verse: Dukkhāpaṭipadañca nissāya rāgo vūpasammati. Sallekhaṃ nissāya appamattassa moho pahīyati.

vsm1.2:86.5.verse: Tattha hissa asaṅghaṭṭiyamānassa viharato dosopi vūpasammatīti ayaṃ dhutādīnaṃ vibhāgato vaṇṇanā.

vsm1.2:87.1.verse: Samāsabyāsatoti imāni pana dhutaṅgāni samāsato tīṇi sīsaṅgāni,

vsm1.2:87.7.verse: Abbhokāsikaṅgaṃ rakkhantassa kiṃ atthi rukkhamūlikaṅgayathāsanthatikaṅgesu rakkhitabbaṃ nāma.

vsm1.2:87.9.verse: āraññikaṅgaṃ, paṃsukūlikaṅgaṃ, tecīvarikaṅgaṃ, nesajjikaṅgaṃ, sosānikaṅganti imāni pañca asambhinnaṅgāni cāti aṭṭheva honti.

vsm1.2:88.1.verse: Puna dve cīvarapaṭisaṃyuttāni, pañca piṇḍapātapaṭisaṃyuttāni, pañca senāsanapaṭisaṃyuttāni, ekaṃ vīriyapaṭisaṃyuttanti evaṃ cattārova honti.

vsm1.2:88.3.verse: Puna sabbāneva nissayavasena dve honti paccayanissitāni dvādasa, vīriyanissitaṃ ekanti.

vsm1.2:88.5.verse: Yassa hi dhutaṅgaṃ sevantassa kammaṭṭhānaṃ vaḍḍhati, tena sevitabbāni. Yassa sevato hāyati, tena na sevitabbāni.

vsm1.2:88.6.verse: Yassa pana sevatopi asevatopi vaḍḍhateva, na hāyati,

vsm1.2:88.7.verse: tenāpi pacchimaṃ janataṃ anukampantena sevitabbāni. Yassāpi sevatopi asevatopi na vaḍḍhati, tenāpi sevitabbāniyeva āyatiṃ vāsanatthāyāti.

vsm1.2:89.1.verse: Evaṃ sevitabbāsevitabbavasena duvidhānipi sabbāneva cetanāvasena ekavidhāni honti.

vsm1.2:89.2.verse: Ekameva hi dhutaṅgaṃ samādānacetanāti. Aṭṭhakathāyampi vuttaṃ ‘‘yā cetanā, taṃ dhutaṅganti vadantī’’ti.

vsm1.2:90.1.verse: Byāsato pana bhikkhūnaṃ terasa, bhikkhunīnaṃ aṭṭha,

vsm1.2:90.2.verse: sāmaṇerānaṃ dvādasa, sikkhamānasāmaṇerīnaṃ satta, upāsakaupāsikānaṃ dveti dvācattālīsa honti.

vsm1.2:91.1.verse: Sace pana abbhokāse āraññikaṅgasampannaṃ susānaṃ hoti,

vsm1.2:91.2.verse: ekopi bhikkhu ekappahārena sabbadhutaṅgāni paribhuñjituṃ sakkoti.

vsm1.2:91.3.verse: Bhikkhunīnaṃ pana āraññikaṅgaṃ khalupacchābhattikaṅgañca dvepi sikkhāpadeneva paṭikkhittāni,

vsm1.2:91.4.verse: abbhokāsikaṅgaṃ, rukkhamūlikaṅgaṃ, sosānikaṅganti imāni tīṇi dupparihārāni.

vsm1.2:91.5.verse: Bhikkhuniyā hi dutiyikaṃ vinā vasituṃ na vaṭṭati.

vsm1.2:91.6.verse: Evarūpe ca ṭhāne samānacchandā dutiyikā dullabhā. Sacepi labheyya saṃsaṭṭhavihārato na mucceyya. Evaṃ sati yassatthāya dhutaṅgaṃ seveyya, svevassā attho na sampajjeyya.

vsm1.2:91.7.verse: Evaṃ paribhuñjituṃ asakkuṇeyyatāya pañca hāpetvā bhikkhunīnaṃ aṭṭheva hontīti veditabbāni.

vsm1.2:92.1.verse: Yathāvuttesu pana ṭhapetvā tecīvarikaṅgaṃ sesāni dvādasa sāmaṇerānaṃ,

vsm1.2:92.4.verse: imāni dve patirūpāni ceva sakkā ca paribhuñjitunti dve dhutaṅgānīti evaṃ byāsato dvecattālīsa hontīti ayaṃ samāsabyāsato vaṇṇanā.

vsm1.2:93.1.verse: Ettāvatā ca ‘‘sīle patiṭṭhāya naro sapañño’’ti imissā gāthāya sīlasamādhipaññāmukhena desite visuddhimagge yehi appicchatāsantuṭṭhitādīhi guṇehi vuttappakārassa sīlassa vodānaṃ hoti,

vsm1.2:93.3.verse:
Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge
Dhutaṅganiddeso nāma dutiyo paricchedo.

vsm1.3:1.1.verse: Idāni yasmā evaṃ dhutaṅgapariharaṇasampāditehi appicchatādīhi guṇehi pariyodāte imasmiṃ sīle patiṭṭhitena ‘‘sīle patiṭṭhāya naro sapañño, cittaṃ paññañca bhāvaya’’nti vacanato cittasīsena niddiṭṭho samādhi bhāvetabbo.

vsm1.3:1.2.verse: So ca atisaṅkhepadesitattā viññātumpi tāva na sukaro, pageva bhāvetuṃ,

vsm1.3:1.3.verse: tasmā tassa vitthārañca bhāvanānayañca dassetuṃ idaṃ pañhākammaṃ hoti.

vsm1.3:2.3.verse: Taṃ sabbaṃ vibhāvayituṃ ārabbhamānaṃ vissajjanaṃ adhippetañceva atthaṃ na sādheyya,

vsm1.3:2.5.verse: tasmā idhādhippetameva sandhāya vadāma, kusalacittekaggatā samādhi.

vsm1.3:3.3.verse: Ekārammaṇe cittacetasikānaṃ samaṃ sammā ca ādhānaṃ,

vsm1.3:3.5.verse: Tasmā yassa dhammassānubhāvena ekārammaṇe cittacetasikā samaṃ sammā ca avikkhipamānā avippakiṇṇā ca hutvā tiṭṭhanti,

vsm1.3:4.5.verse: ‘‘Sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyatī’’ti vacanato pana sukhamassa padaṭṭhānaṃ.

vsm1.3:6.4.verse: upasamānussatiyā āhāre paṭikūlasaññāya catudhātuvavatthānassāti imesaṃ vasena laddhacittekaggatā,

vsm1.3:6.5.verse: yā ca appanāsamādhīnaṃ pubbabhāge ekaggatā, ayaṃ upacārasamādhi.

vsm1.3:6.6.verse: ‘‘Paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa jhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo’’ti ādivacanato pana yā parikammānantarā ekaggatā, ayaṃ appanāsamādhīti

vsm1.3:7.1.verse: Dutiyaduke tīsu bhūmīsu kusalacittekaggatā lokiyo samādhi.

vsm1.3:8.2.verse: catukkanaye dvīsu pañcakanaye tīsu jhānesu ekaggatā sappītiko samādhi.

vsm1.3:8.3.verse: Avasesesu dvīsu jhānesu ekaggatā nippītiko samādhi.

vsm1.3:8.4.verse: Upacārasamādhi pana siyā sappītiko, siyā nippītikoti

vsm1.3:9.2.verse: catukkanaye tīsu pañcakanaye catūsu jhānesu ekaggatā sukhasahagato samādhi.

vsm1.3:9.4.verse: Upacārasamādhi pana siyā sukhasahagato, siyā upekkhāsahagatoti

vsm1.3:11.4.verse: Yo hi vitakkamatteyeva ādīnavaṃ disvā vicāre adisvā

vsm1.3:11.9.verse: pañcakanaye tatiyādīsu tīsu jhānesu ekaggatā avitakkāvicāro samādhīti

vsm1.3:12.3.verse: pañcakanaye ca tīsu jhānesu ekaggatā pītisahagato samādhi.

vsm1.3:12.4.verse: Tesveva tatiye ca catutthe ca jhāne ekaggatā sukhasahagato samādhi.

vsm1.3:12.6.verse: Upacārasamādhi pana pītisukhasahagato vā hoti upekkhāsahagato vāti

vsm1.3:14.1.verse: Catukkesu paṭhamacatukke atthi samādhi dukkhāpaṭipado dandhābhiñño,

vsm1.3:15.1.verse: Tattha paṭhamasamannāhārato paṭṭhāya yāva tassa tassa jhānassa upacāraṃ uppajjati,

vsm1.3:15.5.verse: Sā panesā paṭipadā ekaccassa dukkhā hoti,

vsm1.3:15.9.verse: Abhiññāpi ekaccassa dandhā hoti mandā asīghappavatti.

vsm1.3:16.4.verse: tesu yo asappāyasevī hoti, tassa dukkhā paṭipadā dandhā ca abhiññā hoti.

vsm1.3:16.5.verse: Sappāyasevino sukhā paṭipadā khippā ca abhiññā.

vsm1.3:16.6.verse: Yo pana pubbabhāge asappāyaṃ sevitvā aparabhāge sappāyasevī hoti,

vsm1.3:16.7.verse: pubbabhāge vā sappāyaṃ sevitvā aparabhāge asappāyasevī,

vsm1.3:16.12.verse: Appanākosallāni pana asampādentassa dandhā abhiññā hoti.

vsm1.3:17.7.verse: Yo ca samathe akatādhikāro, tassa dukkhā paṭipadā hoti.

vsm1.3:17.9.verse: Yo pana vipassanāya akatādhikāro hoti, tassa dandhā abhiññā hoti,

vsm1.3:18.3.verse: dukkhā paṭipadā hoti dandhā ca abhiññā,

vsm1.3:18.6.verse: sukhā paṭipadā hoti dandhā ca abhiññā.

vsm1.3:19.2.verse: yo puggalo dukkhāya paṭipadāya dandhāya ca abhiññāya samādhiṃ pāpuṇāti,

vsm1.3:19.3.verse: tassa so samādhi dukkhāpaṭipado dandhābhiññoti vuccati.

vsm1.3:20.5.verse: Tattha yo samādhi appaguṇo uparijhānassa paccayo bhavituṃ na sakkoti, ayaṃ paritto.

vsm1.3:20.6.verse: Yo pana avaḍḍhite ārammaṇe pavatto, ayaṃ parittārammaṇo.

vsm1.3:20.7.verse: Yo paguṇo subhāvito, uparijhānassa paccayo bhavituṃ sakkoti, ayaṃ appamāṇo.

vsm1.3:20.8.verse: Yo ca vaḍḍhite ārammaṇe pavatto, ayaṃ appamāṇārammaṇo.

vsm1.3:21.1.verse: Tatiyacatukke vikkhambhitanīvaraṇānaṃ vitakkavicārapītisukhasamādhīnaṃ vasena pañcaṅgikaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ,

vsm1.3:21.4.verse: tato pahīnasukhaṃ upekkhāvedanāsahitassa samādhino vasena duvaṅgikaṃ catutthaṃ.

vsm1.3:21.5.verse: Iti imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ aṅgabhūtā cattāro samādhī honti.

vsm1.3:22.18.verse: Tāya pana paññāya sampayuttā samādhīpi cattāro hontīti.

vsm1.3:24.2.verse: ‘‘chandaṃ ce bhikkhu adhipatiṃ karitvā labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassekaggataṃ, ayaṃ vuccati chandasamādhi…pe…

vsm1.3:24.5.verse: vīmaṃsaṃ ce bhikkhu adhipatiṃ karitvā labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassekaggataṃ , ayaṃ vuccati vīmaṃsāsamādhī’’ti (vibha. 432; saṃ. ni. 3.825)

vsm1.3:25.1.verse: Pañcake yaṃ catukkabhede vuttaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ,

vsm1.3:25.3.verse: vitakkavicārātikkamena tatiyanti evaṃ dvidhā bhinditvā pañca jhānāni veditabbāni.

vsm1.3:26.1.verse: Ko cassa saṃkileso kiṃ vodānanti ettha pana vissajjanaṃ vibhaṅge vuttameva.

vsm1.3:26.2.verse: Vuttañhi tattha ‘‘saṃkilesanti hānabhāgiyo dhammo. Vodānanti visesabhāgiyo dhammo’’ti (vibha. 828).

vsm1.3:26.5.verse: hānabhāginī paññā’’ti (vibha. 799) iminā nayena hānabhāgiyadhammo veditabbo.

vsm1.3:26.7.verse: visesabhāginī paññā’’ti (vibha. 799) iminā nayena visesabhāgiyadhammo veditabbo.

vsm1.3:27.2.verse: yo tāva ayaṃ lokiyalokuttaravasena duvidhotiādīsu ariyamaggasampayutto samādhi vutto,

vsm1.3:27.4.verse: Paññāya hi bhāvitāya so bhāvito hoti.

vsm1.3:27.5.verse: Tasmā taṃ sandhāya evaṃ bhāvetabboti na kiñci visuṃ vadāma.

vsm1.3:28.2.verse: so vuttanayena sīlāni visodhetvā suparisuddhe sīle patiṭṭhitena

vsm1.3:28.3.verse: yvāssa dasasu palibodhesu palibodho atthi, taṃ upacchinditvā

vsm1.3:28.5.verse: attano cariyānukūlaṃ cattālīsāya kammaṭṭhānesu aññataraṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā

vsm1.3:28.6.verse: samādhibhāvanāya ananurūpaṃ vihāraṃ pahāya anurūpe vihāre viharantena

vsm1.3:28.7.verse: khuddakapalibodhupacchedaṃ katvā sabbaṃ bhāvanāvidhānaṃ aparihāpentena bhāvetabboti ayamettha saṅkhepo.

vsm1.3:29.2.verse: yaṃ tāva vuttaṃ ‘‘yvāssa dasasu palibodhesu palibodho atthi, taṃ upacchinditvā’’ti, ettha –

vsm1.3:29.3.verse: Āvāso ca kulaṃ lābho, gaṇo kammañca pañcamaṃ;

vsm1.3:29.4.verse: Addhānaṃ ñāti ābādho, gantho iddhīti te dasāti. –

vsm1.3:29.5.verse: Ime dasa palibodhā nāma. Tattha āvāsoyeva āvāsapalibodho. Esa nayo kulādīsu.

vsm1.3:30.1.verse: Tattha āvāsoti ekopi ovarako vuccati ekampi pariveṇaṃ sakalopi saṅghārāmo.

vsm1.3:30.3.verse: Yo panettha navakammādīsu ussukkaṃ vā āpajjati,

vsm1.3:30.5.verse: yena kenaci vā kāraṇena apekkhavā paṭibaddhacitto,

vsm1.3:31.1.verse: Tatridaṃ vatthu – dve kira kulaputtā anurādhapurā nikkhamitvā anupubbena thūpārāme pabbajiṃsu.

vsm1.3:31.2.verse: Tesu eko dve mātikā paguṇā katvā

vsm1.3:31.6.verse: Pācinakhaṇḍarājigato tattha ciraṃ vasitvā thero hutvā cintesi

vsm1.3:31.9.verse: Pavisantaṃyeva ca naṃ disvā samānavassikatthero paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetvā vattaṃ akāsi.

vsm1.3:32.2.verse: ‘‘idāni me sahāyo sappiṃ vā phāṇitaṃ vā pānakaṃ vā pesessati.

vsm1.3:32.6.verse: Tampi adisvā ‘‘pahiṇantā natthi, paviṭṭhassa maññe dassatī’’ti

vsm1.3:32.8.verse: Te dve ekaṃ vīthiṃ caritvā uḷuṅkamattaṃ yāguṃ labhitvā āsanasālāyaṃ nisīditvā piviṃsu.

vsm1.3:33.3.verse: bhattakāle idāni manussā paṇītaṃ bhattaṃ dassantī’’ti,

vsm1.3:33.4.verse: tato bhattakālepi piṇḍāya caritvā laddhameva bhuñjitvā

vsm1.3:33.5.verse: itaro āha – ‘‘kiṃ, bhante, sabbakālaṃ evaṃ yāpethā’’ti?

vsm1.3:33.6.verse: Āmāvusoti. Bhante, pācinakhaṇḍarāji phāsukā, tattha gacchāmāti.

vsm1.3:33.9.verse: Itaro āha – ‘‘kiṃ pana, bhante, imaṃ maggaṃ paṭipannatthā’’ti? Nanu tvamāvuso, pācinakhaṇḍarājiyā vaṇṇaṃ abhāsīti?

vsm1.3:33.10.verse: Kiṃ pana, bhante, tumhākaṃ ettakaṃ kālaṃ vasitaṭṭhāne na koci atirekaparikkhāro atthīti?

vsm1.3:33.11.verse: Āmāvuso mañcapīṭhaṃ saṅghikaṃ, taṃ paṭisāmitameva, aññaṃ kiñci natthīti.

vsm1.3:33.12.verse: Mayhaṃ pana, bhante, kattaradaṇḍo telanāḷi upāhanatthavikā ca tatthevāti.

vsm1.3:33.13.verse: Tayāvuso, ekadivasaṃ vasitvā ettakaṃ ṭhapitanti? Āma, bhante.

vsm1.3:34.1.verse: So pasannacitto theraṃ vanditvā ‘‘tumhādisānaṃ, bhante, sabbattha araññavāsoyeva.

vsm1.3:34.7.verse: Idheva tumhe vasathā’’ti dutiyadivase pattacīvaraṃ gahetvā sayameva agamāsīti.

vsm1.3:35.3.verse: ‘‘sukhitesu sukhito’’tiādinā (vibha. 888; saṃ. ni. 4.241) nayena saṃsaṭṭhassa viharato palibodho hoti,

vsm1.3:35.4.verse: so kulamānusakehi vinā dhammassavanāya sāmantavihārampi na gacchati.

vsm1.3:36.4.verse: Therabhaginīpi upāsikā sadā theraṃ tassa pavattiṃ pucchati.

vsm1.3:36.5.verse: Thero ekadivasaṃ daharaṃ ānessāmīti rohaṇābhimukho pāyāsi.

vsm1.3:37.2.verse: upajjhāyaṃ dāni passitvā upāsikāya ca pavattiṃ ñatvā āgamissāmī’’ti

vsm1.3:37.5.verse: So aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle therassa vattaṃ katvā ‘‘kuhiṃ yāsī’’ti pucchito tamatthaṃ ārocesi.

vsm1.3:37.9.verse: gaccha tvaṃ, ahaṃ pana idheva imaṃ vassaṃ vasissāmīti taṃ uyyojesi.

vsm1.3:38.1.verse: Athassa pitā dutiyadivase āgantvā ‘‘kassa, bhante, amhākaṃ senāsanaṃ patta’’nti pucchanto

vsm1.3:38.4.verse: ‘‘bhante, amhākaṃ senāsane vassaṃ upagatassa vattaṃ atthī’’ti.

vsm1.3:38.6.verse: Temāsaṃ amhākaṃyeva ghare bhikkhaṃ gahetvā pavāretvā gamanakāle āpucchitabbanti.

vsm1.3:38.9.verse: ‘‘amhākaṃ āvāse eko āgantuko ayyo upagato sakkaccaṃ upaṭṭhātabbo’’ti āha.

vsm1.3:38.10.verse: Upāsikā ‘‘sādhū’’ti sampaṭicchitvā paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādesi.

vsm1.3:38.11.verse: Daharopi bhattakāle ñātigharaṃ agamāsi. Na naṃ koci sañjāni.

vsm1.3:39.5.verse: dutiyadivase ghareyeva bhojetvā telanāḷiṃ pūretvā ekaṃ guḷapiṇḍaṃ navahatthañca sāṭakaṃ datvā

vsm1.3:40.1.verse: Upajjhāyopissa pavāretvā paṭipathaṃ āgacchanto pubbe diṭṭhaṭṭhāneyeva taṃ addasa.

vsm1.3:40.2.verse: So aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle therassa vattaṃ akāsi.

vsm1.3:40.3.verse: Atha naṃ thero pucchi ‘‘kiṃ, bhaddamukha, diṭṭhā te upāsikā’’ti?

vsm1.3:40.5.verse: tena telena therassa pāde makkhetvā guḷena pānakaṃ katvā tampi sāṭakaṃ therasseva datvā

vsm1.3:40.6.verse: theraṃ vanditvā ‘‘mayhaṃ, bhante, rohaṇaṃyeva sappāya’’nti agamāsi.

vsm1.3:40.7.verse: Theropi vihāraṃ āgantvā dutiyadivase koraṇḍakagāmaṃ pāvisi.

vsm1.3:41.1.verse: Upāsikāpi ‘‘mayhaṃ bhātā mama puttaṃ gahetvā idāni āgacchatī’’ti sadā maggaṃ olokayamānāva tiṭṭhati.

vsm1.3:41.3.verse: ‘‘mato me maññe putto, ayaṃ thero ekakova āgacchatī’’ti

vsm1.3:41.5.verse: Thero ‘‘nūna daharo appicchatāya attānaṃ ajānāpetvāva gato’’ti

vsm1.3:42.2.verse: puttena gatadisābhimukhā urena nipajjitvā namassamānā āha –

vsm1.3:42.3.verse: ‘‘mayhaṃ puttasadisaṃ vata maññe bhikkhuṃ kāyasakkhiṃ katvā bhagavā rathavinītapaṭipadaṃ (ma. ni. 1.252 ādayo),

vsm1.3:42.6.verse: catupaccayasantosabhāvanārāmatādīpakaṃ mahāariyavaṃsapaṭipadañca (a. ni. 4.28; dī. ni. 3.309) desesi.

vsm1.3:42.10.verse: Evarūpassa mātāpitaropi palibodhā na honti, pageva aññaṃ upaṭṭhākakula’’nti.

vsm1.3:43.3.verse: Puññavantassa hi bhikkhuno gatagataṭṭhāne manussā mahāparivāre paccaye denti.

vsm1.3:43.4.verse: So tesaṃ anumodento dhammaṃ desento samaṇadhammaṃ kātuṃ na okāsaṃ labhati.

vsm1.3:43.5.verse: Aruṇuggamanato yāva paṭhamayāmo, tāva manussasaṃsaggo na upacchijjati.

vsm1.3:43.7.verse: ‘‘bhante, asuko upāsako upāsikā amacco amaccadhītā tumhākaṃ dassanakāmā’’ti vadanti,

vsm1.3:43.11.verse: Tena gaṇaṃ pahāya yattha naṃ na jānanti, tattha ekakena caritabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:44.2.verse: yo tassa uddesaṃ vā paripucchaṃ vā dento samaṇadhammassa okāsaṃ na labhati,

vsm1.3:44.5.verse: Sace tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahu gahitaṃ hoti, appaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ,

vsm1.3:44.8.verse: yojanato paraṃ agantvā antoyojanaparicchede aññaṃ gaṇavācakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā

vsm1.3:44.11.verse: ‘‘mayhamāvuso, ekaṃ kiccaṃ atthi, tumhe yathāphāsukaṭṭhānāni gacchathā’’ti gaṇaṃ pahāya

vsm1.3:45.5.verse: Sopi evaṃ upacchinditabbo, sace appaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti niṭṭhapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:45.7.verse: saṅghikañce navakammaṃ, saṅghassa vā saṅghabhārahārakabhikkhūnaṃ vā niyyādetabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:46.2.verse: Yassa hi katthaci pabbajjāpekkho vā hoti,

vsm1.3:46.4.verse: Sace taṃ alabhanto na sakkoti adhivāsetuṃ, araññaṃ pavisitvā samaṇadhammaṃ karontassapi

vsm1.3:46.6.verse: tasmā gantvā taṃ kiccaṃ tīretvāva samaṇadhamme ussukkaṃ kātabbanti.

vsm1.3:47.3.verse: Te gilānā imassa palibodhā honti, tasmā so palibodho upaṭṭhahitvā tesaṃ pākatikakaraṇena upacchinditabbo.

vsm1.3:48.1.verse: Tattha upajjhāyo tāva gilāno sace lahuṃ na vuṭṭhāti, yāvajīvampi paṭijaggitabbo.

vsm1.3:49.2.verse: Sacepi hi te rajje ṭhitā honti, puttato ca upaṭṭhānaṃ paccāsīsanti, kātabbameva.

vsm1.3:49.3.verse: Atha tesaṃ bhesajjaṃ natthi, attano santakaṃ dātabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:49.5.verse: Bhātubhaginīnaṃ pana tesaṃ santakameva yojetvā dātabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:49.6.verse: Sace natthi attano santakaṃ tāvakālikaṃ datvā pacchā labhantena gaṇhitabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:49.8.verse: Aññātakassa bhaginisāmikassa bhesajjaṃ neva kātuṃ na dātuṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.3:49.9.verse: ‘‘Tuyhaṃ sāmikassa dehī’’ti vatvā pana bhaginiyā dātabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:49.11.verse: Tesaṃ pana puttā imassa ñātakā evāti tesaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatīti.

vsm1.3:50.2.verse: So bādhayamāno palibodho hoti, tasmā bhesajjakaraṇena upacchinditabbo.

vsm1.3:50.3.verse: Sace pana katipāhaṃ bhesajjaṃ karontassapi na vūpasammati,

vsm1.3:50.5.verse: taṃyeva hi posento anamatagge saṃsāravaṭṭe dukkhaṃ pattoti attabhāvaṃ garahitvā samaṇadhammo kātabboti.

vsm1.3:51.2.verse: Taṃ sajjhāyādīhi niccabyāvaṭassa palibodho hoti, na itarassa.

vsm1.3:51.6.verse: Thero kīdisosi, āvuso, pariyattiyanti pucchi. Majjhimo me, bhante, paguṇoti.

vsm1.3:51.11.verse: Bhante, tumhākaṃ santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ labhitvā puna na olokessāmīti

vsm1.3:51.17.verse: apica kho kataparicayo ahamettha ārabhathā’’ti vatvā

vsm1.3:51.18.verse: ādito paṭṭhāya yāva pariyosānā ekabyañjanepissa kaṅkhā nāhosi.

vsm1.3:52.3.verse: Tesaṃ gāmavāsikattherehi saddhiṃ saṃsandentānaṃ ekapañhopi uppaṭipāṭiyā āgato nāhosi.

vsm1.3:53.1.verse: Mahāvihārepi tipiṭakacūḷābhayatthero nāma aṭṭhakathaṃ anuggahetvāva pañcanikāyamaṇḍale tīṇi piṭakāni parivattessāmīti suvaṇṇabheriṃ paharāpesi.

vsm1.3:53.4.verse: attano ācariyuggahaññeva vadatu, itarathā vattuṃ na demāti āha.

vsm1.3:53.5.verse: Upajjhāyopi naṃ attano upaṭṭhānamāgataṃ pucchi ‘‘tvamāvuso, bheriṃ paharāpesī’’ti?

vsm1.3:53.9.verse: Āvuso abhaya, ācariyā idaṃ padaṃ kathaṃ vadantīti?

vsm1.3:53.12.verse: Puna so aññena aññena pariyāyena evaṃ vadanti bhanteti tikkhattuṃ āha.

vsm1.3:53.15.verse: ācariyamukhato pana anuggahitattā ‘evaṃ ācariyā vadantī’ti saṇṭhātuṃ nāsakkhi.

vsm1.3:53.16.verse: Gaccha attano ācariyānaṃ santike suṇāhī’’ti. Kuhiṃ, bhante, gacchāmīti?

vsm1.3:53.21.verse: pañcahi bhikkhusatehi saddhiṃ therassa santikaṃ gantvā

vsm1.3:53.23.verse: Thero kasmā āgatosīti pucchi. Dhammaṃ sotuṃ, bhanteti.

vsm1.3:53.24.verse: Āvuso abhaya, dīghamajjhimesu maṃ kālena kālaṃ pucchanti.

vsm1.3:53.25.verse: Avasesaṃ pana me tiṃsamattāni vassāni na olokitapubbaṃ.

vsm1.3:53.26.verse: Apica tvaṃ rattiṃ mama santike parivattehi.

vsm1.3:54.1.verse: Pariveṇadvāre mahāmaṇḍapaṃ kāretvā gāmavāsino divase divase dhammassavanatthāya āgacchanti.

vsm1.3:54.2.verse: Thero rattiṃ parivatti. Taṃ divā kathayanto anupubbena desanaṃ niṭṭhapetvā

vsm1.3:54.5.verse: Bhante, kiṃ bhaṇatha, nanu mayā tumhākameva santike sutaṃ? Kimahaṃ tumhehi aññātaṃ kathessāmīti?

vsm1.3:54.6.verse: Tato naṃ thero añño esa, āvuso, gatakassa maggo nāmāti āha.

vsm1.3:55.9.verse: So attano dhammantevāsikassa santike taṭṭikāya nisīditvā

vsm1.3:56.2.verse: Sā hi uttānaseyyakadārako viya taruṇasassaṃ viya ca dupparihārā hoti. Appamattakeneva bhijjati.

vsm1.3:56.3.verse: Sā pana vipassanāya palibodho hoti, na samādhissa, samādhiṃ patvā pattabbato.

vsm1.3:57.4.verse: Tattha sabbatthakakammaṭṭhānaṃ nāma bhikkhusaṅghādīsu mettā maraṇassati ca.

vsm1.3:58.2.verse: paṭhamaṃ tāva paricchinditvā sīmaṭṭhakabhikkhusaṅghe sukhitā hontu abyāpajjāti

vsm1.3:58.7.verse: So hi bhikkhusaṅghe mettāya sahavāsīnaṃ muducittataṃ janeti.

vsm1.3:58.9.verse: Sīmaṭṭhakadevatāsu mettāya mudukatacittāhi devatāhi dhammikāya rakkhāya susaṃvihitarakkho hoti.

vsm1.3:58.11.verse: mudukatacittasantānehi issarehi dhammikāya rakkhāya surakkhitaparikkhāro hoti.

vsm1.3:58.12.verse: Tattha manussesu mettāya pasāditacittehi tehi aparibhūto hutvā vicarati.

vsm1.3:58.18.verse: Asubhasaññāparicitacittassa panassa dibbānipi ārammaṇāni lobhavasena cittaṃ na pariyādiyanti.

vsm1.3:59.1.verse: Evaṃ bahūpakārattā sabbattha atthayitabbaṃ icchitabbanti ca

vsm1.3:60.1.verse: Cattālīsāya pana kammaṭṭhānesu yaṃ yassa cariyānukūlaṃ,

vsm1.3:60.3.verse: uparimassa ca uparimassa bhāvanākammassa padaṭṭhānattā pārihāriyakammaṭṭhānanti vuccati.

vsm1.3:60.4.verse: Iti imaṃ duvidhampi kammaṭṭhānaṃ yo deti, ayaṃ kammaṭṭhānadāyako nāma. Taṃ kammaṭṭhānadāyakaṃ.

vsm1.3:61.2.verse: Piyo garu bhāvanīyo, vattā ca vacanakkhamo;

vsm1.3:61.3.verse: Gambhīrañca kathaṃ kattā, no caṭṭhāne niyojakoti. (a. ni. 7.37);

vsm1.3:61.4.verse: Evamādiguṇasamannāgataṃ ekantena hitesiṃ vuddhipakkhe ṭhitaṃ kalyāṇamittaṃ.

vsm1.3:62.1.verse: ‘‘Mamaṃ hi, ānanda, kalyāṇamittaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccantī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 1.129; 5.2) ādivacanato pana

vsm1.3:62.3.verse: Tasmā tasmiṃ sati tasseva bhagavato santike gahitakammaṭṭhānaṃ sugahitaṃ hoti.

vsm1.3:62.4.verse: Parinibbute pana tasmiṃ asītiyā mahāsāvakesu yo dharati, tassa santike gahetuṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.3:62.6.verse: yaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetukāmo hoti, tasseva vasena catukkapañcakajjhānāni nibbattetvā

vsm1.3:62.7.verse: jhānapadaṭṭhānaṃ vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā āsavakkhayappattassa khīṇāsavassa santike gahetabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:63.1.verse: Kiṃ pana khīṇāsavo ahaṃ khīṇāsavoti attānaṃ pakāsetīti?

vsm1.3:63.2.verse: Kiṃ vattabbaṃ, kārakabhāvaṃ hi jānitvā pakāseti.

vsm1.3:63.3.verse: Nanu assaguttatthero āraddhakammaṭṭhānassa bhikkhuno ‘‘kammaṭṭhānakārako aya’’nti jānitvā ākāse cammakhaṇḍaṃ paññāpetvā tattha pallaṅkena nisinno kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathesīti.

vsm1.3:64.1.verse: Tasmā sace khīṇāsavaṃ labhati, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,

vsm1.3:64.5.verse: yassa ekasaṅgītipi aṭṭhakathāya saddhiṃ paguṇā, ayañca lajjī hoti, tassa santike gahetabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:64.6.verse: Evarūpo hi tantidharo vaṃsānurakkhako paveṇīpālako ācariyo

vsm1.3:64.8.verse: Teneva porāṇakattherā ‘‘lajjī rakkhissati lajjī rakkhissatī’’ti tikkhattuṃ āhaṃsu.

vsm1.3:65.4.verse: taṃ taṃ ācariyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā uggahaparipucchānaṃ visodhitattā

vsm1.3:65.5.verse: ito cito ca suttañca kāraṇañca sallakkhetvā sappāyāsappāyaṃ yojetvā gahanaṭṭhāne gacchanto mahāhatthī viya mahāmaggaṃ dassento kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathessati.

vsm1.3:66.1.verse: Sace panetaṃ ekavihāreyeva labhati, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce labhati, yattha so vasati, tattha gantabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:66.2.verse: Gacchantena ca na dhotamakkhitehi pādehi upāhanā ārūhitvā

vsm1.3:66.7.verse: antarāmagge yaṃ yaṃ vihāraṃ pavisati sabbattha vattapaṭipattiṃ kurumānena

vsm1.3:66.11.verse: antarāmaggeyeva dantakaṭṭhaṃ kappiyaṃ kārāpetvā gahetvā pavisitabbaṃ,

vsm1.3:66.12.verse: na ca ‘‘muhuttaṃ vissametvā pādadhovanamakkhanādīni katvā ācariyassa santikaṃ gamissāmī’’ti aññaṃ pariveṇaṃ pavisitabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:67.2.verse: Sace hissa tatra ācariyassa visabhāgā bhikkhū bhaveyyuṃ,

vsm1.3:67.3.verse: te āgamanakāraṇaṃ pucchitvā ācariyassa avaṇṇaṃ pakāsetvā

vsm1.3:67.7.verse: tasmā ācariyassa vasanaṭṭhānaṃ pucchitvā ujukaṃ tattheva gantabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:68.1.verse: Sace ācariyo daharataro hoti, pattacīvarapaṭiggahaṇādīni na sāditabbāni.

vsm1.3:68.2.verse: Sace vuḍḍhataro hoti, gantvā ācariyaṃ vanditvā ṭhātabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:68.5.verse: ‘‘Pāde dhovāhī’’ti vuttena na tāva pādā dhovitabbā.

vsm1.3:68.6.verse: Sace hi ācariyena ābhataṃ udakaṃ bhaveyya, na sāruppaṃ siyā.

vsm1.3:68.7.verse: ‘‘Dhovāhāvuso, na mayā ābhataṃ, aññehi ābhata’’nti vuttena pana

vsm1.3:68.8.verse: yattha ācariyo na passati, evarūpe paṭicchanne vā okāse,

vsm1.3:68.9.verse: abbhokāse vihārassāpi vā ekamante nisīditvā pādā dhovitabbā.

vsm1.3:69.1.verse: Sace ācariyo telanāḷiṃ āharati uṭṭhahitvā ubhohi hatthehi sakkaccaṃ gahetabbā.

vsm1.3:69.2.verse: Sace hi na gaṇheyya, ‘‘ayaṃ bhikkhu ito eva paṭṭhāya sambhogaṃ kopetī’’ti ācariyassa aññathattaṃ bhaveyya.

vsm1.3:69.3.verse: Gahetvā pana na āditova pādā makkhetabbā.

vsm1.3:69.4.verse: Sace hi taṃ ācariyassa gattabbhañjanatelaṃ bhaveyya, na sāruppaṃ siyā.

vsm1.3:69.8.verse: ‘‘imaṃ telanāḷiṃ ṭhapemi, bhante’’ti vatvā ācariye gaṇhante dātabbā.

vsm1.3:70.1.verse: Āgatadivasato paṭṭhāya kammaṭṭhānaṃ me, bhante, kathetha iccevaṃ na vattabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:70.2.verse: Dutiyadivasato pana paṭṭhāya sace ācariyassa pakatiupaṭṭhāko atthi, taṃ yācitvā vattaṃ kātabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:70.3.verse: Sace yācitopi na deti, okāse laddheyeva kātabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:70.5.verse: Sītaṃ uṇhanti duvidhaṃ mukhadhovanaudakañca nhānodakañca paṭiyādetabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:70.6.verse: Tato yaṃ ācariyo tīṇi divasāni paribhuñjati, tādisameva niccaṃ upanāmetabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:70.7.verse: Niyamaṃ akatvā yaṃ vā taṃ vā paribhuñjantassa yathāladdhaṃ upanāmetabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:71.5.verse: kālasseva uṭṭhāya upāhanā omuñcitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dantakaṭṭhaṃ dātabbaṃ,

vsm1.3:71.8.verse: Sace yāgu hoti, bhājanaṃ dhovitvā yāgu upanāmetabbā’’ti (mahāva. 78) ādikaṃ khandhake sammāvattaṃ paññattaṃ, taṃ sabbampi kātabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:72.4.verse: yadā so kissāgatosīti pucchati, tadā āgamanakāraṇaṃ kathetabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:72.5.verse: Sace so neva pucchati, vattaṃ pana sādiyati,

vsm1.3:72.9.verse: Akāle vā gantvā kimatthamāgatosīti puṭṭhena ārocetabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:73.1.verse: Sace so pātova āgacchāti vadati, pātova gantabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:73.2.verse: Sace panassa tāya velāya pittābādhena vā kucchi pariḍayhati,

vsm1.3:73.8.verse: Asappāyavelāya hi vuccamānampi kammaṭṭhānaṃ na sakkā hoti manasikātunti.

vsm1.3:73.9.verse: Ayaṃ kammaṭṭhānadāyakaṃ kalyāṇamittaṃ upasaṅkamitvāti ettha vitthāro.

vsm1.3:74.5.verse: Keci pana rāgādīnaṃ saṃsaggasannipātavasena aparāpi catasso,

vsm1.3:74.6.verse: tathā saddhādīnanti imāhi aṭṭhahi saddhiṃ cuddasa icchanti.

vsm1.3:74.8.verse: rāgādīnaṃ saddhādīhipi saṃsaggaṃ katvā anekā cariyā honti,

vsm1.3:75.1.verse: Tattha yasmā rāgacaritassa kusalappavattisamaye saddhā balavatī hoti,

vsm1.3:75.3.verse: Yathā hi akusalapakkhe rāgo siniddho nātilūkho, evaṃ kusalapakkhe saddhā.

vsm1.3:75.4.verse: Yathā rāgo vatthukāme pariyesati, evaṃ saddhā sīlādiguṇe.

vsm1.3:75.5.verse: Yathā rāgo ahitaṃ na pariccajati, evaṃ saddhā hitaṃ na pariccajati, tasmā rāgacaritassa saddhācarito sabhāgo.

vsm1.3:76.1.verse: Yasmā pana dosacaritassa kusalappavattisamaye paññā balavatī hoti,

vsm1.3:76.3.verse: Yathā hi akusalapakkhe doso nissineho na ārammaṇaṃ allīyati, evaṃ kusalapakkhe paññā.

vsm1.3:76.4.verse: Yathā ca doso abhūtampi dosameva pariyesati, evaṃ paññā bhūtaṃ dosameva.

vsm1.3:76.5.verse: Yathā doso sattaparivajjanākārena pavattati, evaṃ paññā saṅkhāraparivajjanākārena, tasmā dosacaritassa buddhicarito sabhāgo.

vsm1.3:77.1.verse: Yasmā pana mohacaritassa anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya vāyamamānassa yebhuyyena antarāyakarā vitakkā uppajjanti,

vsm1.3:77.3.verse: Yathā hi moho paribyākulatāya anavaṭṭhito, evaṃ vitakko nānappakāravitakkanatāya.

vsm1.3:77.4.verse: Yathā ca moho apariyogāhaṇatāya cañcalo. Tathā vitakko lahuparikappanatāya, tasmā mohacaritassa vitakkacarito sabhāgoti.

vsm1.3:78.1.verse: Apare taṇhāmānadiṭṭhivasena aparāpi tisso cariyā vadanti.

vsm1.3:78.2.verse: Tattha taṇhā rāgoyeva, māno ca taṃsampayuttoti tadubhayaṃ rāgacariyaṃ nātivattati.

vsm1.3:78.3.verse: Mohanidānattā ca diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhicariyā mohacariyameva anupatati.

vsm1.3:80.1.verse: Tatra purimā tāva tisso cariyā pubbāciṇṇanidānā,

vsm1.3:80.7.verse: Pubbe majjapānabahulo sutaparipucchāvihīno ca mohacarito hoti,

vsm1.3:81.1.verse: Dvinnaṃ pana dhātūnaṃ ussannattā puggalo mohacarito hoti

vsm1.3:82.1.verse: Tattha yasmā pubbe iṭṭhappayogasubhakammabahulāpi saggā cavitvā idhūpapannāpi ca

vsm1.3:82.4.verse: Evaṃ dhātūnañca yathāvutteneva nayena ussadaniyamo nāma natthi.

vsm1.3:82.5.verse: Dosaniyame ca rāgamohadvayameva vuttaṃ, tampi ca pubbāparaviruddhameva.

vsm1.3:82.6.verse: Saddhācariyādīsu ca ekissāpi nidānaṃ na vuttameva.

vsm1.3:83.3.verse: ‘‘ime sattā pubbahetuniyāmena lobhussadā dosussadā mohussadā alobhussadā adosussadā amohussadā ca honti.

vsm1.3:83.4.verse: Yassa hi kammāyūhanakkhaṇe lobho balavā hoti alobho mando,

vsm1.3:83.6.verse: tassa mando alobho lobhaṃ pariyādātuṃ na sakkoti.

vsm1.3:83.7.verse: Adosāmohā pana balavanto dosamohe pariyādātuṃ sakkoti.

vsm1.3:83.8.verse: Tasmā so tena kammena dinnapaṭisandhivasena nibbatto

vsm1.3:84.1.verse: Yassa pana kammāyūhanakkhaṇe lobhadosā balavanto honti alobhādosā mandā,

vsm1.3:84.3.verse: so purimanayeneva luddho ceva hoti duṭṭho ca.

vsm1.3:84.4.verse: Paññavā pana hoti vajirūpamañāṇo dattābhayatthero viya.

vsm1.3:84.5.verse: Yassa kammāyūhanakkhaṇe lobhādosamohā balavanto honti itare mandā,

vsm1.3:84.6.verse: so purimanayeneva luddho ceva hoti dandho ca,

vsm1.3:84.8.verse: Tathā yassa kammāyūhanakkhaṇe tayopi lobhadosamohā balavanto honti alobhādayo mandā,

vsm1.3:84.9.verse: so purimanayeneva luddho ceva hoti duṭṭho ca mūḷho ca.

vsm1.3:85.1.verse: Yassa pana kammāyūhanakkhaṇe alobhadosamohā balavanto honti itare mandā,

vsm1.3:85.2.verse: so purimanayeneva aluddho appakileso hoti dibbārammaṇampi disvā niccalo,

vsm1.3:85.4.verse: Yassa pana kammāyūhanakkhaṇe alobhādosamohā balavanto honti itare mandā,

vsm1.3:85.5.verse: so purimanayeneva aluddho ceva hoti aduṭṭho sīlako ca,

vsm1.3:85.7.verse: Tathā yassa kammāyūhanakkhaṇe alobhadosāmohā balavanto honti itare mandā,

vsm1.3:85.8.verse: so purimanayeneva aluddho ceva hoti paññavā ca,

vsm1.3:85.10.verse: Yassa pana kammāyūhanakkhaṇe tayopi alobhādosāmohā balavanto honti lobhādayo mandā,

vsm1.3:85.11.verse: so purimanayeneva mahāsaṅgharakkhitatthero viya aluddho aduṭṭho paññavā ca hotī’’ti.

vsm1.3:86.1.verse: Ettha ca yo luddhoti vutto, ayaṃ rāgacarito.

vsm1.3:86.5.verse: Yathā vā amohaparivārena kammunā nibbatto buddhicarito,

vsm1.3:87.1.verse: Yaṃ pana vuttaṃ kathañca jānitabbaṃ ayaṃ puggalo rāgacaritotiādi.

vsm1.3:87.3.verse:
Iriyāpathato kiccā, bhojanā dassanādito;
Dhammappavattito ceva, cariyāyo vibhāvayeti.

vsm1.3:88.2.verse: rāgacarito hi pakatigamanena gacchanto cāturiyena gacchati,

vsm1.3:88.10.verse: chambhito viya padaṃ nikkhipati, chambhito viya uddharati,

vsm1.3:89.5.verse: Rāgacarito ca ataramāno samaṃ seyyaṃ paññapetvā

vsm1.3:89.6.verse: saṇikaṃ nipajjitvā aṅgapaccaṅgāni samodhāya pāsādikena ākārena sayati,

vsm1.3:89.9.verse: Dosacarito taramāno yathā vā tathā vā seyyaṃ paññapetvā

vsm1.3:89.11.verse: vuṭṭhāpiyamāno ca sīghaṃ vuṭṭhāya kupito viya paṭivacanaṃ deti.

vsm1.3:89.14.verse: vuṭṭhāpiyamāno ca huṅkāraṃ karonto dandhaṃ vuṭṭhāti.

vsm1.3:91.3.verse: ataramāno vālikaṃ avippakiranto sinduvārakusumasantharamiva santharanto suddhaṃ samaṃ sammajjati.

vsm1.3:91.5.verse: taramānarūpo ubhato vālikaṃ ussārento kharena saddena asuddhaṃ visamaṃ sammajjati.

vsm1.3:92.5.verse: Cīvaradhāraṇampi ca rāgacaritassa nātigāḷhaṃ nātisithilaṃ hoti pāsādikaṃ parimaṇḍalaṃ.

vsm1.3:93.2.verse: bhuñjamāno ca nātimahantaṃ parimaṇḍalaṃ ālopaṃ katvā rasapaṭisaṃvedī ataramāno bhuñjati,

vsm1.3:93.3.verse: kiñcideva ca sāduṃ labhitvā somanassaṃ āpajjati.

vsm1.3:93.5.verse: bhuñjamāno ca mukhapūrakaṃ ālopaṃ katvā arasapaṭisaṃvedī taramāno bhuñjati,

vsm1.3:93.6.verse: kiñcideva ca asāduṃ labhitvā domanassaṃ āpajjati.

vsm1.3:93.8.verse: bhuñjamāno ca aparimaṇḍalaṃ parittaṃ ālopaṃ katvā

vsm1.3:93.9.verse: bhājane chaḍḍento mukhaṃ makkhento vikkhittacitto taṃ taṃ vitakkento bhuñjati.

vsm1.3:94.1.verse: Dassanāditoti rāgacarito īsakampi manoramaṃ rūpaṃ disvā vimhayajāto viya ciraṃ oloketi,

vsm1.3:94.5.verse: Dosacarito īsakampi amanoramaṃ rūpaṃ disvā kilantarūpo viya na ciraṃ oloketi,

vsm1.3:94.9.verse: Mohacarito yaṃkiñci rūpaṃ disvā parapaccayiko hoti,

vsm1.3:95.2.verse: rāgacaritassa ca māyā, sāṭheyyaṃ, māno, pāpicchatā,

vsm1.3:95.3.verse: mahicchatā, asantuṭṭhitā, siṅgaṃ, cāpalyanti evamādayo dhammā bahulaṃ pavattanti.

vsm1.3:95.8.verse: Saddhācaritassa muttacāgatā, ariyānaṃ dassanakāmatā, saddhammaṃ sotukāmatā,

vsm1.3:95.9.verse: pāmojjabahulatā, asaṭhatā, amāyāvitā, pasādanīyesu ṭhānesu pasādoti evamādayo.

vsm1.3:95.12.verse: saṃvejanīyesu ṭhānesu saṃvego, saṃviggassa ca yoniso padhānanti evamādayo.

vsm1.3:95.16.verse: hurāhuraṃ dhāvanāti evamādayo dhammā bahulaṃ pavattantīti.

vsm1.3:96.1.verse: Yasmā pana idaṃ cariyāvibhāvanavidhānaṃ sabbākārena neva pāḷiyaṃ na aṭṭhakathāyaṃ āgataṃ,

vsm1.3:96.4.verse: Rāgacaritassa hi vuttāni iriyāpathādīni dosacaritādayopi appamādavihārino kātuṃ sakkonti.

vsm1.3:96.5.verse: Saṃsaṭṭhacaritassa ca puggalassa ekasseva bhinnalakkhaṇā iriyāpathādayo na upapajjanti.

vsm1.3:96.6.verse: Yaṃ panetaṃ aṭṭhakathāsu cariyāvibhāvanavidhānaṃ vuttaṃ, tadeva sārato paccetabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:96.8.verse: ‘‘cetopariyañāṇassa lābhī ācariyo cariyaṃ ñatvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathessati,

vsm1.3:96.10.verse: Tasmā cetopariyañāṇena vā taṃ vā puggalaṃ pucchitvā jānitabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:97.6.verse: atiuccaṃ vā atinīcaṃ vā ujjaṅgalaṃ sāsaṅkaṃ asucivisamamaggaṃ,

vsm1.3:97.8.verse: durūpaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ, yaṃ olokentasseva jigucchā uppajjati, tādisaṃ sappāyaṃ.

vsm1.3:97.13.verse: āṇigaṇṭhikāhato ayopatto vā garuko dussaṇṭhāno sīsakapālamiva jeguccho vaṭṭati.

vsm1.3:97.15.verse: Bhikkhācāragāmopi yattha manussā apassantā viya caranti,

vsm1.3:97.16.verse: yattha ekakulepi bhikkhaṃ alabhitvā nikkhamantaṃ ‘‘ehi, bhante’’ti āsanasālaṃ pavesetvā

vsm1.3:97.18.verse: gacchantā gāvī viya vaje pavesetvā anapalokentā gacchanti, tādiso vaṭṭati.

vsm1.3:97.21.verse: ye acittīkārena yāgubhattaṃ chaḍḍentā viya parivisanti, tādisā sappāyā.

vsm1.3:97.26.verse: Iriyāpathopissa ṭhānaṃ vā caṅkamo vā vaṭṭati.

vsm1.3:98.9.verse: yaṃ dassanamatteneva pītipāmojjaṃ janayati, evarūpaṃ sappāyaṃ.

vsm1.3:99.7.verse: tena tena ekapaṭṭaṃ vā dupaṭṭaṃ vā

vsm1.3:100.1.verse: Parivesakā panassa ye honti abhirūpā pāsādikā

vsm1.3:100.9.verse: Iriyāpathopissa seyyā vā nisajjā vā vaṭṭati,

vsm1.3:101.6.verse: Sambādhasmiñhi okāse cittaṃ bhiyyo sammohamāpajjati, tasmā vipulaṃ mahākasiṇaṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.3:101.7.verse: Sesaṃ dosacaritassa vuttasadisamevāti idaṃ mohacaritassa sappāyaṃ.

vsm1.3:102.3.verse: Buddhicaritassa senāsanādīsu idaṃ nāma asappāyanti natthi.

vsm1.3:102.10.verse: tasmā gambhīre darīmukhe vanappaṭicchanne hatthikucchipabbhāramahindaguhāsadise senāsane vasitabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:102.14.verse: Sesaṃ rāgacaritassa vuttasadisamevāti idaṃ vitakkacaritassa sappāyaṃ.

vsm1.3:102.15.verse: Ayaṃ attano cariyānukūlanti ettha āgatacariyānaṃ pabhedanidānavibhāvanasappāyaparicchedato vitthāro.

vsm1.3:103.1.verse: Na ca tāva cariyānukūlaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ sabbākārena āvikataṃ.

vsm1.3:103.2.verse: Tañhi anantarassa mātikāpadassa vitthāre sayameva āvibhavissati.

vsm1.3:103.4.verse: Tasmā yaṃ vuttaṃ cattālīsāya kammaṭṭhānesu aññataraṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvāti ettha

vsm1.3:103.14.verse: cariyānukūlatoti imehi tāva dasahākārehi kammaṭṭhānavinicchayo veditabbo.

vsm1.3:104.1.verse: Tattha saṅkhātaniddesatoti cattālīsāya kammaṭṭhānesūti hi vuttaṃ,

vsm1.3:105.5.verse: vikkhittakaṃ, hatavikkhittakaṃ, lohitakaṃ, puḷuvakaṃ, aṭṭhikanti ime dasa asubhā.

vsm1.3:105.8.verse: maraṇānussati, kāyagatāsati, ānāpānassati, upasamānussatīti imā dasa anussatiyo.

vsm1.3:105.9.verse: Mettā, karuṇā, muditā, upekkhāti ime cattāro brahmavihārā.

vsm1.3:105.13.verse: Catudhātuvavatthānaṃ ekaṃ vavatthānanti evaṃ saṅkhātaniddesato vinicchayo veditabbo.

vsm1.3:106.2.verse: ṭhapetvā kāyagatāsatiñca ānāpānassatiñca avasesā aṭṭha anussatiyo,

vsm1.3:107.2.verse: appanāvahesu cettha ānāpānassatiyā saddhiṃ dasa kasiṇā catukkajjhānikā honti.

vsm1.3:107.5.verse: Catutthabrahmavihāro cattāro ca āruppā catutthajjhānikāti evaṃ jhānappabhedato.

vsm1.3:108.1.verse: Samatikkamatoti dve samatikkamā aṅgasamatikkamo ca ārammaṇasamatikkamo ca.

vsm1.3:108.2.verse: Tattha sabbesupi tikacatukkajjhānikesu kammaṭṭhānesu aṅgasamatikkamo hoti

vsm1.3:108.3.verse: vitakkavicārādīni jhānaṅgāni samatikkamitvā tesvevārammaṇesu dutiyajjhānādīnaṃ pattabbato.

vsm1.3:108.5.verse: Sopi hi mettādīnaṃyeva ārammaṇe somanassaṃ samatikkamitvā pattabboti.

vsm1.3:108.7.verse: Purimesu hi navasu kasiṇesu aññataraṃ samatikkamitvā ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ pattabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:109.1.verse: Vaḍḍhanāvaḍḍhanatoti imesu cattālīsāya kammaṭṭhānesu dasa kasiṇāneva vaḍḍhetabbāni.

vsm1.3:110.1.verse: Kāyagatāsati pana asubhāni ca na vaḍḍhetabbāni.

vsm1.3:110.4.verse: Sā ca nesaṃ okāsena paricchinnatā bhāvanānaye āvibhavissati.

vsm1.3:110.5.verse: Tesu pana vaḍḍhitesu kuṇaparāsiyeva vaḍḍhati, na koci ānisaṃso atthi.

vsm1.3:110.8.verse: Tatra hi nimittavaḍḍhanavasena rūpasaññā vibhūtāti vuttā.

vsm1.3:111.1.verse: Yaṃ panetaṃ ‘‘kevalaṃ aṭṭhisaññāya, apharī pathaviṃ ima’’nti (theragā. 18) vuttaṃ,

vsm1.3:111.3.verse: Yatheva hi dhammāsokakāle karavīkasakuṇo samantā ādāsabhittīsu attano chāyaṃ disvā

vsm1.3:111.4.verse: sabbadisāsu karavīkasaññī hutvā madhuraṃ giraṃ nicchāresi,

vsm1.3:111.5.verse: evaṃ theropi aṭṭhikasaññāya lābhittā sabbadisāsu upaṭṭhitaṃ nimittaṃ passanto

vsm1.3:112.1.verse: Yadi evaṃ yā asubhajjhānānaṃ appamāṇārammaṇatā vuttā, sā virujjhatīti.

vsm1.3:112.3.verse: Ekacco hi uddhumātake vā aṭṭhike vā mahante nimittaṃ gaṇhāti. Ekacco appake.

vsm1.3:112.4.verse: Iminā pariyāyena ekaccassa parittārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ hoti. Ekaccassa appamāṇārammaṇanti.

vsm1.3:112.5.verse: Yo vā etaṃ vaḍḍhane ādīnavaṃ apassanto vaḍḍheti. Taṃ sandhāya ‘‘appamāṇārammaṇa’’nti vuttaṃ.

vsm1.3:113.1.verse: Yathā ca etāni, evaṃ sesānipi na vaḍḍhetabbāni.

vsm1.3:113.6.verse: Iti sādīnavattā okāsena ca paricchinnattā na vaḍḍhetabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:114.1.verse: Yaṃ pana vuttaṃ ‘‘mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā’’ti (dī. ni. 1.556) ādi,

vsm1.3:114.3.verse: Ekāvāsadviāvāsādinā hi anukkamena ekissā disāya satte pariggahetvā bhāvento

vsm1.3:115.3.verse: Tato paraṃ vaḍḍhayatopi na kiñci hoti.

vsm1.3:117.3.verse: dasakasiṇā, dasaasubhā, ānāpānassati, kāyagatāsatīti imāni dvāvīsatipaṭibhāganimittārammaṇāni.

vsm1.3:117.5.verse: Tathā dasasu anussatīsu ṭhapetvā ānāpānassatiñca kāyagatāsatiñca avasesā aṭṭha anussatiyo,

vsm1.3:117.16.verse: yañca ālokakasiṇe sūriyādīnaṃ obhāsamaṇḍalārammaṇanti imāni aṭṭha calitārammaṇāni, tāni ca kho pubbabhāge, paṭibhāgaṃ pana sannisinnameva hoti.

vsm1.3:118.2.verse: ettha ca dasa asubhā, kāyagatāsati, āhāre paṭikūlasaññāti

vsm1.3:118.4.verse: Tāni dvādasa, ānāpānassati cāti imāni terasa brahmaloke nappavattanti.

vsm1.3:118.5.verse: Arūpabhave pana ṭhapetvā cattāro āruppe aññaṃ nappavattati.

vsm1.3:119.2.verse: Tatra ṭhapetvā vāyokasiṇaṃ sesā nava kasiṇā, dasa asubhāti

vsm1.3:119.4.verse: Pubbabhāge cakkhunā oloketvā nimittaṃ nesaṃ gahetabbanti attho.

vsm1.3:119.11.verse: Upekkhābrahmavihāro, cattāro āruppāti imāni cettha na ādikammikena gahetabbāni.

vsm1.3:120.1.verse: Paccayatoti imesu pana kammaṭṭhānesu ṭhapetvā ākāsakasiṇaṃ sesā nava kasiṇā āruppānaṃ paccayā honti,

vsm1.3:121.3.verse: rāgacaritassa tāva ettha dasa asubhā, kāyagatāsatīti ekādasa kammaṭṭhānāni anukūlāni.

vsm1.3:121.4.verse: Dosacaritassa cattāro brahmavihārā, cattāri vaṇṇakasiṇānīti aṭṭha.

vsm1.3:121.5.verse: Mohacaritassa, vitakkacaritassa ca ekaṃ ānāpānassati kammaṭṭhānameva.

vsm1.3:121.9.verse: Sesakasiṇāni, cattāro ca āruppā sabbacaritānaṃ anukūlāni.

vsm1.3:121.10.verse: Kasiṇesu ca yaṃkiñci parittaṃ vitakkacaritassa, appamāṇaṃ mohacaritassāti.

vsm1.3:122.1.verse: Sabbañcetaṃ ujuvipaccanīkavasena ca atisappāyavasena ca vuttaṃ.

vsm1.3:122.2.verse: Rāgādīnaṃ pana avikkhambhikā saddhādīnaṃ vā anupakārā kusalabhāvanā nāma natthi.

vsm1.3:122.9.verse: Rāhulasuttepi ‘‘mettaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehī’’tiādinā (ma. ni. 2.120) nayena

vsm1.3:122.11.verse: Tasmā vacanamatte abhinivesaṃ akatvā sabbattha adhippāyo pariyesitabboti

vsm1.3:122.12.verse: ayaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvāti ettha kammaṭṭhānakathā vinicchayo.

vsm1.3:123.2.verse: ‘‘Tena yoginā kammaṭṭhānadāyakaṃ kalyāṇamittaṃ upasaṅkamitvā’’ti ettha vuttanayeneva vuttappakāraṃ kalyāṇamittaṃ upasaṅkamitvā

vsm1.3:123.3.verse: buddhassa vā bhagavato ācariyassa vā attānaṃ niyyātetvā

vsm1.3:123.4.verse: sampannajjhāsayena sampannādhimuttinā ca hutvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ yācitabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:124.1.verse: Tatra ‘‘imāhaṃ bhagavā attabhāvaṃ tumhākaṃ pariccajāmī’’ti evaṃ buddhassa bhagavato attā niyyātetabbo.

vsm1.3:124.8.verse: Niyyātitattabhāvassa panassa bheravārammaṇe āpāthamāgatepi bhayaṃ na uppajjati.

vsm1.3:124.9.verse: ‘‘Nanu tayā, paṇḍita, purimameva attā buddhānaṃ niyyātito’’ti paccavekkhato panassa somanassameva uppajjati.

vsm1.3:125.1.verse: Yathā hi purisassa uttamaṃ kāsikavatthaṃ bhaveyya, tassa tasmiṃ mūsikāya vā kīṭehi vā khādite uppajjeyya domanassaṃ.

vsm1.3:125.2.verse: Sace pana taṃ acīvarakassa bhikkhuno dadeyya,

vsm1.3:125.3.verse: athassa taṃ tena bhikkhunā khaṇḍākhaṇḍaṃ kariyamānaṃ disvāpi somanassameva uppajjeyya.

vsm1.3:126.1.verse: Ācariyassa niyyātentenāpi ‘‘imāhaṃ, bhante, attabhāvaṃ tumhākaṃ pariccajāmī’’ti vattabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:126.2.verse: Evaṃ aniyyātitattabhāvo hi atajjanīyo vā hoti,

vsm1.3:126.4.verse: yenakāmaṃgamo vā ācariyaṃ anāpucchāva yatthicchati, tattha gantā,

vsm1.3:126.5.verse: tamenaṃ ācariyo āmisena vā dhammena vā na saṅgaṇhāti,

vsm1.3:126.9.verse: nacirasseva dussīlyaṃ vā gihibhāvaṃ vā pāpuṇāti.

vsm1.3:127.1.verse: Therassa kira santikaṃ tayo bhikkhū āgamaṃsu.

vsm1.3:127.3.verse: ‘‘ahaṃ, bhante, tumhākamatthāyā’’ti vutte sataporise papāte patituṃ ussaheyyanti āha.

vsm1.3:127.5.verse: ‘‘ahaṃ, bhante, tumhākamatthāyā’’ti vutte imaṃ attabhāvaṃ paṇhito paṭṭhāya pāsāṇapiṭṭhe ghaṃsento niravasesaṃ khepetuṃ ussaheyyanti āha.

vsm1.3:127.6.verse: Tatiyo ‘‘ahaṃ, bhante, tumhākamatthāyā’’ti vutte assāsapassāse uparundhitvā kālakiriyaṃ kātuṃ ussaheyyanti āha.

vsm1.3:127.8.verse: Te tassa ovāde ṭhatvā tayopi arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsūti ayamānisaṃso attaniyyātane.

vsm1.3:127.9.verse: Tena vuttaṃ ‘‘buddhassa vā bhagavato ācariyassa vā attānaṃ niyyātetvā’’ti.

vsm1.3:128.1.verse: Sampannajjhāsayena sampannādhimuttinā ca hutvāti ettha pana

vsm1.3:128.2.verse: tena yoginā alobhādīnaṃ vasena chahākārehi sampannajjhāsayena bhavitabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:128.3.verse: Evaṃ sampannajjhāsayo hi tissannaṃ bodhīnaṃ aññataraṃ pāpuṇāti.

vsm1.3:128.13.verse: sabbe te imeheva chahākārehi attanā attanā pattabbaṃ visesaṃ pattā.

vsm1.3:129.3.verse: nibbānādhimuttena nibbānagarukena nibbānapabbhārena ca bhavitabbanti attho.

vsm1.3:130.2.verse: cetopariyañāṇalābhinā ācariyena cittācāraṃ oloketvā cariyā jānitabbā.

vsm1.3:130.5.verse: Ke vā te dhammā bahulaṃ samudācaranti?

vsm1.3:130.6.verse: Kiṃ vā te manasikaroto phāsu hoti?

vsm1.3:130.7.verse: Katarasmiṃ vā te kammaṭṭhāne cittaṃ namatīti evamādīhi nayehi pucchitvā jānitabbā.

vsm1.3:130.10.verse: Pakatiyā uggahitakammaṭṭhānassa ekaṃ dve nisajjāni sajjhāyaṃ kāretvā dātabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:131.13.verse: Evaṃ kathiyamāne pana kammaṭṭhāne tena yoginā nimittaṃ gahetvā sotabbaṃ.

vsm1.3:132.6.verse: idamopammanti evaṃ taṃ taṃ ākāraṃ upanibandhitvāti attho.

vsm1.3:132.7.verse: Evaṃ nimittaṃ gahetvā sakkaccaṃ suṇantena hi kammaṭṭhānaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti.

vsm1.3:132.8.verse: Athassa taṃ nissāya visesādhigamo sampajjati, na itarassāti

vsm1.3:133.3.verse: attano cariyānukūlaṃ cattālīsāya kammaṭṭhānesu aññataraṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvāti

vsm1.3:133.5.verse:
Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge
Samādhibhāvanādhikāre
Kammaṭṭhānaggahaṇaniddeso nāma
Tatiyo paricchedo.

vsm1.4:1.4.verse: ettha yassa tāvācariyena saddhiṃ ekavihāre vasato phāsu hoti,
