vsm1.4:1.6.verse: Sace tattha phāsu na hoti, yo añño gāvute vā aḍḍhayojane vā yojanamattepi vā sappāyo vihāro hoti, tattha vasitabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:1.7.verse: Evañhi sati kammaṭṭhānassa kismiñcideva ṭhāne sandehe vā satisammose vā jāte

vsm1.4:1.15.verse: Yo pana yojanappamāṇepi phāsukaṭṭhānaṃ na labhati,

vsm1.4:2.1.verse: Tattha ananurūpo nāma aṭṭhārasannaṃ dosānaṃ aññatarena samannāgato.

vsm1.4:2.2.verse: Tatrime aṭṭhārasa dosā – mahattaṃ, navattaṃ, jiṇṇattaṃ, panthanissitattaṃ,

vsm1.4:2.4.verse: nagarasannissitatā, dārusannissitatā, khettasannissitatā, visabhāgānaṃ puggalānaṃ atthitā,

vsm1.4:2.7.verse: imesaṃ aṭṭhārasannaṃ dosānaṃ aññatarena dosena samannāgato ananurūpo nāma.

vsm1.4:3.2.verse: te aññamaññaṃ paṭiviruddhatāya vattaṃ na karonti.

vsm1.4:3.3.verse: Bodhiyaṅgaṇādīni asammaṭṭhāneva honti. Anupaṭṭhāpitaṃ pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ.

vsm1.4:3.4.verse: Tatrāyaṃ gocaragāme piṇḍāya carissāmīti pattacīvaramādāya nikkhanto

vsm1.4:3.5.verse: sace passati vattaṃ vā akataṃ pānīyaghaṭaṃ vā rittaṃ,

vsm1.4:3.10.verse: atidivā paviṭṭho niṭṭhitāya bhikkhāya kiñci na labhati.

vsm1.4:3.14.verse: Yattha pana sabbaṃ vattaṃ katameva hoti, avasesāpi ca saṅghaṭṭanā natthi. Evarūpe mahāvihārepi vihātabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:6.2.verse: Vikāle āgatānaṃ attano senāsanaṃ datvā rukkhamūle vā pāsāṇapiṭṭhe vā vasitabbaṃ hoti.

vsm1.4:6.3.verse: Punadivasepi evamevāti kammaṭṭhānassa okāso na hoti.

vsm1.4:6.4.verse: Yattha pana evarūpo āgantukasambādho na hoti, tattha vihātabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:7.4.verse: tesaṃ bhājanadārudoṇikādīni pucchantānaṃ asuke ca asuke ca ṭhāneti dassetabbāni honti,

vsm1.4:8.1.verse: Yattha nānāvidhaṃ sākapaṇṇaṃ hoti, tatthassa kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā divāvihāraṃ nisinnassāpi

vsm1.4:8.4.verse: Yattha pana nānāvidhā mālāgacchā supupphitā honti, tatrāpi tādisoyeva upaddavo.

vsm1.4:10.2.verse: ayamarahāti sambhāvetvā vanditukāmā manussā samantā osaranti,

vsm1.4:10.4.verse: yassa pana taṃ sappāyaṃ hoti, tena divā aññatra gantvā rattiṃ vasitabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:11.2.verse: kumbhadāsiyopi ghaṭehi nighaṃsantiyo gacchanti, okkamitvā maggaṃ na denti,

vsm1.4:12.1.verse: Dārusannissaye pana yattha kaṭṭhāni ca dabbupakaraṇarukkhā ca santi,

vsm1.4:12.2.verse: tattha kaṭṭhahārikā pubbe vuttasākapupphahārikā viya aphāsuṃ karonti,

vsm1.4:12.3.verse: vihāre rukkhā santi, te chinditvā gharāni karissāmāti manussā āgantvā chindanti.

vsm1.4:13.1.verse: Yo pana khettasannissito hoti samantā khettehi parivārito,

vsm1.4:13.2.verse: tattha manussā vihāramajjheyeva khalaṃ katvā dhaññaṃ maddanti,

vsm1.4:13.8.verse: manussā vīhisīsaṃ gahetvā ‘‘passatha tumhākaṃ ārāmikānaṃ kamma’’nti saṅghassa dassenti.

vsm1.4:13.9.verse: Tena tena kāraṇena rājarājamahāmattānaṃ gharadvāraṃ gantabbaṃ hoti,

vsm1.4:14.1.verse: Visabhāgānaṃ puggalānaṃ atthitāti yattha aññamaññaṃ visabhāgaverī bhikkhū viharanti,

vsm1.4:14.4.verse: etassa paṃsukūlikassa āgatakālato paṭṭhāya naṭṭhāmhāti vattāro bhavanti.

vsm1.4:15.1.verse: Yopi udakapaṭṭanaṃ vā thalapaṭṭanaṃ vā nissito hoti,

vsm1.4:15.2.verse: tattha abhiṇhaṃ nāvāhi ca satthehi ca āgatamanussā

vsm1.4:15.3.verse: okāsaṃ detha, pānīyaṃ detha, loṇaṃ dethāti ghaṭṭayantā aphāsuṃ karonti.

vsm1.4:16.1.verse: Paccantasannissite pana manussā buddhādīsu appasannā honti.

vsm1.4:16.3.verse: Tañhi padesaṃ eko rājā na mayhaṃ vase vattatīti paharati,

vsm1.4:16.5.verse: Tatrāyaṃ bhikkhu kadāci imassa rañño vijite vicarati, kadāci etassa.

vsm1.4:16.6.verse: Atha naṃ ‘‘carapuriso aya’’nti maññamānā anayabyasanaṃ pāpenti.

vsm1.4:17.5.verse: Athassa ekā yakkhinī paṇṇasāladvāre ṭhatvā gāyi.

vsm1.4:17.11.verse: Atha naṃ sā vegenāgantvā gahetvā ‘‘mayā, bhante, na eko na dve tumhādisā khāditā’’ti āha.

vsm1.4:18.2.verse: yattha na sakkā hoti ācariyaṃ vā ācariyasamaṃ vā

vsm1.4:18.3.verse: upajjhāyaṃ vā upajjhāyasamaṃ vā kalyāṇamittaṃ laddhuṃ.

vsm1.4:18.5.verse: imesaṃ aṭṭhārasannaṃ dosānaṃ aññatarena samannāgato ananurūpoti veditabbo.

vsm1.4:18.8.verse: Soṇḍiṃ paṇṇañca pupphañca, phalaṃ patthitameva ca.

vsm1.4:18.11.verse:
Aṭṭhārasetāni ṭhānāni, iti viññāya paṇḍito;
Ārakā parivajjeyya, maggaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ yathāti.

vsm1.4:19.1.verse: Yo pana gocaragāmato nātidūranāccāsannatādīhi pañcahaṅgehi samannāgato, ayaṃ anurūpo nāma.

vsm1.4:19.2.verse: Vuttañhetaṃ bhagavatā – ‘‘kathañca, bhikkhave, senāsanaṃ pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ hoti?

vsm1.4:19.3.verse: Idha, bhikkhave, senāsanaṃ nātidūraṃ hoti nāccāsannaṃ gamanāgamanasampannaṃ,

vsm1.4:19.6.verse: tasmiṃ kho pana senāsane viharantassa appakasireneva uppajjanti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārā.

vsm1.4:19.7.verse: Tasmiṃ kho pana senāsane therā bhikkhū viharanti bahussutā āgatāgamā

vsm1.4:19.9.verse: te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paripucchati paripañhati ‘idaṃ, bhante, kathaṃ imassa ko attho’ti,

vsm1.4:19.12.verse: anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhaṭṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti.

vsm1.4:19.13.verse: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, senāsanaṃ pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ hotī’’ti (a. ni. 10.11).

vsm1.4:20.3.verse: yepissa te honti khuddakapalibodhā, tepi upacchinditabbā.

vsm1.4:20.5.verse: Jiṇṇacīvaresu daḷhīkammaṃ vā tunnakammaṃ vā kātabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:20.7.verse: Sace patte malaṃ hoti, patto pacitabbo.

vsm1.4:21.1.verse: Idāni sabbaṃ bhāvanāvidhānaṃ aparihāpentena bhāvetabboti ettha

vsm1.4:21.2.verse: ayaṃ pathavīkasiṇaṃ ādiṃ katvā sabbakammaṭṭhānavasena vitthārakathā hoti.

vsm1.4:22.5.verse: katāya vā akatāya vā pathaviyā nimittaṃ gaṇhitabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:22.7.verse: ‘‘Pathavīkasiṇaṃ uggaṇhanto pathaviyaṃ nimittaṃ gaṇhāti kate vā akate vā

vsm1.4:22.13.verse: So taṃ nimittaṃ suggahitaṃ karoti, sūpadhāritaṃ upadhāreti, suvavatthitaṃ vavatthapeti.

vsm1.4:22.14.verse: So taṃ nimittaṃ suggahitaṃ katvā sūpadhāritaṃ upadhāretvā suvavatthitaṃ vavatthapetvā

vsm1.4:22.21.verse: So vivicceva kāmehi…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatī’’ti.

vsm1.4:23.1.verse: Tattha yena atītabhavepi sāsane vā isipabbajjāya vā pabbajitvā

vsm1.4:23.4.verse: akatāya pathaviyā kasitaṭṭhāne vā khalamaṇḍale vā nimittaṃ uppajjati,

vsm1.4:23.6.verse: Tassa kirāyasmato kasitaṭṭhānaṃ olokentassa taṃṭhānappamāṇameva nimittaṃ udapādi.

vsm1.4:24.2.verse: tena ācariyasantike uggahitakammaṭṭhānavidhānaṃ avirādhetvā cattāro kasiṇadose pariharantena kasiṇaṃ kātabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:24.5.verse: gaṅgāvahe mattikāsadisāya aruṇavaṇṇāya mattikāya kasiṇaṃ kātabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:24.6.verse: Tañca kho vihāramajjhe sāmaṇerādīnaṃ sañcaraṇaṭṭhāne na kātabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:24.7.verse: Vihārapaccante pana paṭicchannaṭṭhāne pabbhāre vā paṇṇasālāya vā

vsm1.4:25.1.verse: Tatra saṃhārimaṃ catūsu daṇḍakesu pilotikaṃ vā cammaṃ vā kaṭasārakaṃ vā bandhitvā

vsm1.4:25.2.verse: tattha apanītatiṇamūlasakkharakathalikāya sumadditāya mattikāya vuttappamāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ limpetvā kātabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:25.4.verse: Tatraṭṭhakaṃ bhūmiyaṃ padumakaṇṇikākārena khāṇuke ākoṭetvā vallīhi vinandhitvā kātabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:25.7.verse: uparibhāge suparisodhitāya aruṇavaṇṇāya mattikāya vidatthicaturaṅgulavitthāraṃ vaṭṭaṃ kātabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:25.8.verse: Etadeva hi pamāṇaṃ sandhāya ‘‘suppamattaṃ vā sarāvamattaṃ vā’’ti vuttaṃ.

vsm1.4:26.2.verse: rukkhapāṇikā visabhāgavaṇṇaṃ samuṭṭhapeti. Tasmā taṃ aggahetvā pāsāṇapāṇikāya ghaṃsetvā

vsm1.4:26.5.verse: kasiṇamaṇḍalato aḍḍhateyyahatthantare padese paññatte vidatthicaturaṅgulapādake suatthate pīṭhe nisīditabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:26.6.verse: Tato dūratare nisinnassa hi kasiṇaṃ na upaṭṭhāti,

vsm1.4:26.8.verse: Uccatare nisinnena gīvaṃ onamitvā oloketabbaṃ hoti, nīcatare jaṇṇukāni rujanti.

vsm1.4:27.5.verse: ‘‘ayaṃ dāni sā sabbabuddha paccekabuddha ariyasāvakehi paṭipannā nekkhammapaṭipadā’’ti paṭipattiyā sañjātagāravena

vsm1.4:27.6.verse: ‘‘addhā imāya paṭipadāya pavivekasukharasassa bhāgī bhavissāmī’’ti ussāhaṃ janayitvā

vsm1.4:27.7.verse: samena ākārena cakkhūni ummīletvā nimittaṃ gaṇhantena bhāvetabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:28.7.verse: Tasmā ādāsatale mukhanimittadassinā viya samenākārena cakkhūni ummīletvā nimittaṃ gaṇhantena bhāvetabbaṃ,

vsm1.4:29.4.verse: nissayasavaṇṇaṃ katvā ussadavasena paṇṇattidhamme cittaṃ paṭṭhapetvā manasi kātabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:29.7.verse: yamicchati, yadassa saññānukūlaṃ hoti, taṃ vattabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:29.8.verse: Apica pathavīti etadeva nāmaṃ pākaṭaṃ, tasmā pākaṭavaseneva pathavī pathavīti bhāvetabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:29.10.verse: Yāva uggahanimittaṃ nuppajjati, tāva kālasatampi kālasahassampi tato bhiyyopi eteneva nayena bhāvetabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:30.2.verse: yadā nimīletvā āvajjantassa ummīlitakāle viya āpāthamāgacchati,

vsm1.4:30.4.verse: Tassa jātakālato paṭṭhāya na tasmiṃ ṭhāne nisīditabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:30.5.verse: Attano vasanaṭṭhānaṃ pavisitvā tattha nisinnena bhāvetabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:30.6.verse: Pādadhovanapapañcaparihāratthaṃ panassa ekapaṭalikupāhanā ca kattaradaṇḍo ca icchitabbo.

vsm1.4:30.7.verse: Athānena sace taruṇo samādhi kenacideva asappāyakāraṇena nassati,

vsm1.4:31.5.verse: Tatrāyaṃ purimassa ca uggahanimittassa imassa ca viseso,

vsm1.4:31.7.verse: paṭibhāganimittaṃ thavikato nihatādāsamaṇḍalaṃ viya sudhotasaṅkhathālaṃ viya valāhakantarā nikkhantacandamaṇḍalaṃ viya meghamukhe balākā viya uggahanimittaṃ padāletvā nikkhantamiva tato sataguṇaṃ sahassaguṇaṃ suparisuddhaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.4:31.8.verse: Tañca kho neva vaṇṇavantaṃ, na saṇṭhānavantaṃ.

vsm1.4:31.13.verse: Uppannakālato ca panassa paṭṭhāya nīvaraṇāni vikkhambhitāneva honti,

vsm1.4:32.1.verse: Duvidho hi samādhi upacārasamādhi ca appanāsamādhi ca.

vsm1.4:32.2.verse: Dvīhākārehi cittaṃ samādhiyati upacārabhūmiyaṃ vā paṭilābhabhūmiyaṃ vā.

vsm1.4:32.3.verse: Tattha upacārabhūmiyaṃ nīvaraṇappahānena cittaṃ samāhitaṃ hoti.

vsm1.4:33.3.verse: aṅgānaṃ athāmajātattā, yathā nāma daharo kumārako ukkhipitvā ṭhapiyamāno punappunaṃ bhūmiyaṃ patati, evameva upacāre uppanne cittaṃ kālena nimittamārammaṇaṃ karoti, kālena bhavaṅgamotarati.

vsm1.4:33.5.verse: tesaṃ thāmajātattā, yathā nāma balavā puriso āsanā vuṭṭhāya divasampi tiṭṭheyya, evameva appanāsamādhimhi uppanne cittaṃ sakiṃ bhavaṅgavāraṃ chinditvā kevalampi rattiṃ kevalampi divasaṃ tiṭṭhati, kusalajavanapaṭipāṭivaseneva pavattatīti.

vsm1.4:34.1.verse: Tatra yadetaṃ upacārasamādhinā saddhiṃ paṭibhāganimittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa uppādanaṃ nāma atidukkaraṃ.

vsm1.4:34.2.verse: Tasmā sace teneva pallaṅkena taṃ nimittaṃ vaḍḍhetvā appanaṃ adhigantuṃ sakkoti, sundaraṃ.

vsm1.4:34.3.verse: No ce sakkoti, athānena taṃ nimittaṃ appamattena cakkavattigabbho viya rakkhitabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:34.4.verse:
Evañhi –
Nimittaṃ rakkhato laddha-parihāni na vijjati;

vsm1.4:35.2.verse: Āvāso gocaro bhassaṃ, puggalo bhojanaṃ utu;

vsm1.4:35.4.verse:
Sappāye satta sevetha, evañhi paṭipajjato;
Nacireneva kālena, hoti kassaci appanā.

vsm1.4:36.5.verse: asamāhitañca cittaṃ na samādhiyati, ayaṃ asappāyo.

vsm1.4:36.6.verse: Yattha nimittaṃ uppajjati ceva thāvarañca hoti,

vsm1.4:36.10.verse: Tasmā yasmiṃ vihāre bahū āvāsā honti,

vsm1.4:36.11.verse: tattha ekamekasmiṃ tīṇi tīṇi divasāni vasitvā

vsm1.4:36.12.verse: yatthassa cittaṃ ekaggaṃ hoti, tattha vasitabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:36.14.verse: tambapaṇṇidīpamhi cūḷanāgaleṇe vasantā tattheva kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā pañcasatā bhikkhū arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu.

vsm1.4:36.15.verse: Sotāpannādīnaṃ pana aññattha ariyabhūmiṃ patvā tattha arahattappattānañca gaṇanā natthi.

vsm1.4:37.1.verse: Gocaragāmo pana yo senāsanato uttarena vā dakkhiṇena vā

vsm1.4:38.1.verse: Bhassanti dvattiṃsatiracchānakathāpariyāpannaṃ asappāyaṃ, tañhissa nimittantaradhānāya saṃvattati.

vsm1.4:39.2.verse: yaṃ nissāya asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samādhiyati,

vsm1.4:39.6.verse: So hi taṃ kaddamodakamiva acchaṃ udakaṃ malīnameva karoti,

vsm1.4:40.1.verse: Bhojanaṃ pana kassaci madhuraṃ, kassaci ambilaṃ sappāyaṃ hoti.

vsm1.4:40.2.verse: Utupi kassaci sīto, kassaci uṇho sappāyo hoti.

vsm1.4:40.3.verse: Tasmā yaṃ bhojanaṃ vā utuṃ vā sevantassa phāsu hoti,

vsm1.4:40.6.verse: taṃ bhojanaṃ so ca utu sappāyo.

vsm1.4:40.7.verse: Itaraṃ bhojanaṃ itaro ca utu asappāyo.

vsm1.4:41.1.verse: Iriyāpathesupi kassaci caṅkamo sappāyo hoti, kassaci sayanaṭṭhānanisajjānaṃ aññataro.

vsm1.4:41.2.verse: Tasmā taṃ āvāsaṃ viya tīṇi divasāni upaparikkhitvā

vsm1.4:41.3.verse: yasmiṃ iriyāpathe asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samādhiyati,

vsm1.4:41.4.verse: samāhitaṃ vā thirataraṃ hoti, so sappāyo.

vsm1.4:41.6.verse: Iti imaṃ sattavidhaṃ asappāyaṃ vajjetvā sappāyaṃ sevitabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:42.1.verse: Yassa pana evampi paṭipajjato na hoti,

vsm1.4:42.8.verse: yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ paggahetabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ paggaṇhāti,

vsm1.4:42.9.verse: yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ niggahetabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ niggaṇhāti,

vsm1.4:42.10.verse: yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃsitabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃseti,

vsm1.4:42.11.verse: yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ ajjhupekkhitabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ ajjhupekkhati,

vsm1.4:43.1.verse: Tattha vatthuvisadakiriyā nāma ajjhattikabāhirānaṃ vatthūnaṃ visadabhāvakaraṇaṃ.

vsm1.4:43.5.verse: Yadā panassa cīvaraṃ jiṇṇaṃ kiliṭṭhaṃ duggandhaṃ hoti, senāsanaṃ vā uklāpaṃ hoti, tadā bāhiravatthu avisadaṃ hoti aparisuddhaṃ.

vsm1.4:43.8.verse: aparisuddhāni dīpakapallikavaṭṭitelāni nissāya uppannadīpasikhāya obhāso viya.

vsm1.4:43.9.verse: Aparisuddhena ñāṇena saṅkhāre sammasato saṅkhārāpi avibhūtā honti,

vsm1.4:43.11.verse: kammaṭṭhānampi vuḍḍhiṃ viruḷhiṃ vepullaṃ na gacchati.

vsm1.4:44.2.verse: uppannesu cittacetasikesu ñāṇampi visadaṃ hoti parisuddhaṃ,

vsm1.4:44.3.verse: parisuddhāni dīpakapallikavaṭṭitelāni nissāya uppannadīpasikhāya obhāso viya.

vsm1.4:44.4.verse: Parisuddhena ca ñāṇena saṅkhāre sammasato saṅkhārāpi vibhūtā honti,

vsm1.4:45.2.verse: Sace hissa saddhindriyaṃ balavaṃ hoti itarāni mandāni,

vsm1.4:45.8.verse: yathā vā manasikaroto balavaṃ jātaṃ, tathā amanasikārena hāpetabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:46.2.verse: atha neva saddhindriyaṃ adhimokkhakiccaṃ kātuṃ sakkoti,

vsm1.4:47.1.verse: Visesato panettha saddhāpaññānaṃ samādhivīriyānañca samataṃ pasaṃsanti.

vsm1.4:47.2.verse: Balavasaddho hi mandapañño muddhappasanno hoti, avatthusmiṃ pasīdati.

vsm1.4:47.7.verse: Balavasamādhiṃ pana mandavīriyaṃ samādhissa kosajjapakkhattā kosajjaṃ abhibhavati.

vsm1.4:47.8.verse: Balavavīriyaṃ mandasamādhiṃ vīriyassa uddhaccapakkhattā uddhaccaṃ abhibhavati.

vsm1.4:47.9.verse: Samādhi pana vīriyena saṃyojito kosajje patituṃ na labhati.

vsm1.4:47.10.verse: Vīriyaṃ samādhinā saṃyojitaṃ uddhacce patituṃ na labhati,

vsm1.4:48.3.verse: Samādhipaññāsu pana samādhikammikassa ekaggatā balavatī vaṭṭati.

vsm1.4:49.2.verse: Sati hi cittaṃ uddhaccapakkhikānaṃ saddhāvīriyapaññānaṃ vasena uddhaccapātato

vsm1.4:49.4.verse: tasmā sā loṇadhūpanaṃ viya sabbabyañjanesu, sabbakammikaamacco viya ca sabbarājakiccesu sabbattha icchitabbā.

vsm1.4:49.10.verse: na vinā satiyā cittassa paggahaniggaho hotī’’ti.

vsm1.4:50.1.verse: Nimittakosallaṃ nāma pathavīkasiṇādikassa cittekaggatānimittassa akatassa karaṇakosallaṃ,

vsm1.4:51.1.verse: Kathañca yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ paggahetabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ paggaṇhāti?

vsm1.4:51.6.verse: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletukāmo assa,

vsm1.4:51.7.verse: so tattha allāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya,

vsm1.4:51.12.verse: bhabbo nu kho so, bhikkhave, puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletunti?

vsm1.4:51.14.verse: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti,

vsm1.4:51.18.verse: Taṃ kissa hetu? Līnaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ, taṃ etehi dhammehi dusamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti.

vsm1.4:51.19.verse: Yasmiṃ ca kho, bhikkhave, līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti,

vsm1.4:51.23.verse: Taṃ kissa hetu? Līnaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ, taṃ etehi dhammehi susamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti.

vsm1.4:51.24.verse: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletukāmo assa,

vsm1.4:51.25.verse: so tattha sukkhāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya,

vsm1.4:51.30.verse: bhabbo nu kho so, bhikkhave, puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletunti?

vsm1.4:52.1.verse: Ettha ca yathāsakamāhāravasena dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgādīnaṃ bhāvanā veditabbā.

vsm1.4:52.9.verse: uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.232).

vsm1.4:52.13.verse: uppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.232).

vsm1.4:52.17.verse: uppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.232).

vsm1.4:53.1.verse: Tattha sabhāvasāmaññalakkhaṇapaṭivedhavasena pavattamanasikāro kusalādīsu yoniso manasikāro nāma.

vsm1.4:53.2.verse: Ārambhadhātuādīnaṃ uppādanavasena pavattamanasikāro ārambhadhātuādīsu yoniso manasikāro nāma.

vsm1.4:53.5.verse: Parakkamadhātūti paraṃ paraṃ ṭhānaṃ akkamanato tatopi balavataraṃ.

vsm1.4:53.6.verse: Pītisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhāniyā dhammāti pana pītiyā eva etaṃ nāmaṃ.

vsm1.4:54.1.verse: Apica satta dhammā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya saṃvattanti

vsm1.4:55.4.verse: ‘‘buddhapaccekabuddhamahāsāvakehi gatamaggo mayā gantabbo, so ca na sakkā kusītena gantu’’nti evaṃ gamanavīthipaccavekkhaṇatā,

vsm1.4:55.6.verse: ‘‘vīriyārambhassa vaṇṇavādī me satthā, so ca anatikkamanīyasāsano amhākañca bahūpakāro paṭipattiyā ca pūjiyamāno pūjito hoti na itarathā’’ti evaṃ satthu mahattapaccavekkhaṇatā,

vsm1.4:55.7.verse: ‘‘saddhammasaṅkhātaṃ me mahādāyajjaṃ gahetabbaṃ, tañca na sakkā kusītena gahetu’’nti evaṃ dāyajjamahattapaccavekkhaṇatā,

vsm1.4:56.2.verse: buddhānussati, dhamma… saṅgha… sīla… cāga… devatānussati,

vsm1.4:56.7.verse: Iti imehi ākārehi ete dhamme uppādento dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgādayo bhāveti nāma.

vsm1.4:56.8.verse: Evaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ paggahetabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ paggaṇhāti.

vsm1.4:57.1.verse: Kathaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ niggahetabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ niggaṇhāti?

vsm1.4:57.6.verse: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetukāmo assa,

vsm1.4:57.7.verse: so tattha sukkhāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya…pe…

vsm1.4:57.9.verse: bhabbo nu kho so, bhikkhave, puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetunti?

vsm1.4:57.11.verse: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti,

vsm1.4:57.15.verse: Taṃ kissa hetu? Uddhataṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ, taṃ etehi dhammehi duvūpasamayaṃ hoti.

vsm1.4:57.16.verse: Yasmiṃ ca kho, bhikkhave, samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti,

vsm1.4:57.20.verse: Taṃ kissa hetu? Uddhataṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ, taṃ etehi dhammehi suvūpasamayaṃ hoti.

vsm1.4:57.21.verse: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetukāmo assa,

vsm1.4:57.22.verse: so tattha allāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya…pe…

vsm1.4:57.24.verse: bhabbo nu kho so, bhikkhave, puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetunti?

vsm1.4:58.1.verse: Etthāpi yathāsakaṃ āhāravasena passaddhisambojjhaṅgādīnaṃ bhāvanā veditabbā.

vsm1.4:58.6.verse: uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.232).

vsm1.4:58.10.verse: uppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.232).

vsm1.4:58.14.verse: uppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.232).

vsm1.4:59.1.verse: Tattha yathāssa passaddhiādayo uppannapubbā, taṃ ākāraṃ sallakkhetvā tesaṃ uppādanavasena pavattamanasikārova tīsupi padesu yoniso manasikāro nāma.

vsm1.4:60.1.verse: Apica satta dhammā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya saṃvattanti

vsm1.4:62.6.verse: Iti imehākārehi ete dhamme uppādento passaddhisambojjhaṅgādayo bhāveti nāma.

vsm1.4:62.7.verse: Evaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ niggahetabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ niggaṇhāti.

vsm1.4:63.1.verse: Kathaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃsitabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃseti?

vsm1.4:63.2.verse: Yadāssa paññāpayogamandatāya vā upasamasukhānadhigamena vā nirassādaṃ cittaṃ hoti,

vsm1.4:63.10.verse: Evaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃsitabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃseti.

vsm1.4:64.1.verse: Kathaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ ajjhupekkhitabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ ajjhupekkhati?

vsm1.4:64.2.verse: Yadāssa evaṃ paṭipajjato alīnaṃ anuddhataṃ anirassādaṃ ārammaṇe samappavattaṃ samathavīthipaṭipannaṃ cittaṃ hoti,

vsm1.4:64.5.verse: Evaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ ajjhupekkhitabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ ajjhupekkhati.

vsm1.4:65.6.verse: nekkhammapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannānaṃ samādhilābhīnaṃ puggalānaṃ kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamanaṃ.

vsm1.4:66.1.verse:
Evañhi sampādayato, appanākosallaṃ imaṃ;
Paṭiladdhe nimittasmiṃ, appanā sampavattati.

vsm1.4:66.2.verse:
Evañhi paṭipannassa, sace sā nappavattati;
Tathāpi na jahe yogaṃ, vāyametheva paṇḍito.

vsm1.4:66.3.verse:
Hitvā hi sammāvāyāmaṃ, visesaṃ nāma māṇavo;
Adhigacche parittampi, ṭhānametaṃ na vijjati.

vsm1.4:66.4.verse:
Cittappavattiākāraṃ, tasmā sallakkhayaṃ budho;
Samataṃ vīriyasseva, yojayetha punappunaṃ.

vsm1.4:66.5.verse:
Īsakampi layaṃ yantaṃ, paggaṇhetheva mānasaṃ;
Accāraddhaṃ nisedhetvā, samameva pavattaye.

vsm1.4:66.6.verse:
Reṇumhi uppaladale, sutte nāvāya nāḷiyā;
Yathā madhukarādīnaṃ, pavatti sammavaṇṇitā.

vsm1.4:66.7.verse:
Līnauddhatabhāvehi, mocayitvāna sabbaso;
Evaṃ nimittābhimukhaṃ, mānasaṃ paṭipādayeti.

vsm1.4:67.2.verse: yathā hi acheko madhukaro asukasmiṃ rukkhe pupphaṃ pupphitanti ñatvā

vsm1.4:67.6.verse: Aparo acheko mandena javena pakkhando khīṇeyeva sampāpuṇāti.

vsm1.4:68.1.verse: Yathā ca sallakattaantevāsikesu udakathālagate uppalapatte satthakammaṃ sikkhantesu

vsm1.4:68.7.verse: Cheko pana samena payogena tattha satthapahāraṃ dassetvā

vsm1.4:68.9.verse: tathārūpesu ṭhānesu kammaṃ katvā lābhaṃ labhati.

vsm1.4:69.1.verse: Yathā ca yo catubyāmappamāṇaṃ makkaṭasuttamāharati, so cattāri sahassāni labhatīti raññā vutte

vsm1.4:69.2.verse: eko achekapuriso vegena makkaṭasuttamākaḍḍhanto tahiṃ tahiṃ chindatiyeva.

vsm1.4:69.3.verse: Aparo acheko chedanabhayā hatthena phusitumpi na visahati.

vsm1.4:69.4.verse: Cheko pana koṭito paṭṭhāya samena payogena daṇḍake vedhetvā āharitvā lābhaṃ labhati.

vsm1.4:70.1.verse: Yathā ca acheko niyāmako balavavāte laṅkāraṃ pūrento nāvaṃ videsaṃ pakkhandāpeti.

vsm1.4:70.2.verse: Aparo acheko mandavāte laṅkāraṃ oropento nāvaṃ tattheva ṭhapeti.

vsm1.4:71.1.verse: Yathā ca yo telena achaḍḍento nāḷiṃ pūreti, so lābhaṃ labhatīti ācariyena antevāsikānaṃ vutte

vsm1.4:71.2.verse: eko acheko lābhaluddho vegena pūrento telaṃ chaḍḍeti.

vsm1.4:71.3.verse: Aparo acheko telachaḍḍanabhayā āsiñcitumpi na visahati.

vsm1.4:71.4.verse: Cheko pana samena payogena pūretvā lābhaṃ labhati.

vsm1.4:72.2.verse: sīghameva appanaṃ pāpuṇissāmīti gāḷhaṃ vīriyaṃ karoti,

vsm1.4:72.3.verse: tassa cittaṃ accāraddhavīriyattā uddhacce patati, so na sakkoti appanaṃ pāpuṇituṃ.

vsm1.4:72.4.verse: Eko accāraddhavīriyatāya dosaṃ disvā kiṃ dānime appanāyāti vīriyaṃ hāpeti,

vsm1.4:72.5.verse: tassa cittaṃ atilīnavīriyattā kosajje patati, sopi na sakkoti appanaṃ pāpuṇituṃ.

vsm1.4:73.2.verse:
Reṇumhi uppaladale, sutte nāvāya nāḷiyā;
Yathā madhukarādīnaṃ, pavatti sammavaṇṇitā.

vsm1.4:73.3.verse:
Līnauddhatabhāvehi, mocayitvāna sabbaso;
Evaṃ nimittābhimukhaṃ, mānasaṃ paṭipādaye

vsm1.4:74.1.verse: Iti evaṃ nimittābhimukhaṃ mānasaṃ paṭipādayato panassa

vsm1.4:74.3.verse: bhavaṅgaṃ upacchinditvā pathavī pathavīti anuyogavasena upaṭṭhitaṃ tadeva pathavīkasiṇaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā manodvārāvajjanamuppajjati.

vsm1.4:74.4.verse: Tato tasmiṃyevārammaṇe cattāri pañca vā javanāni javanti.

vsm1.4:74.5.verse: Tesu avasāne ekaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ, sesāni kāmāvacarāni.

vsm1.4:74.6.verse: Pakaticittehi balavataravitakkavicārapītisukhacittekaggatāni yāni appanāya parikammattā parikammānītipi, yathā gāmādīnaṃ āsannapadeso gāmūpacāro nagarūpacāroti vuccati, evaṃ appanāya āsannattā samīpacārattā vā upacārānītipi, ito pubbe parikammānaṃ, upari appanāya ca anulomato anulomānītipi vuccanti.

vsm1.4:76.1.verse: Ābhidhammikagodattatthero pana ‘‘purimā purimā kusalā dhammā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo’’ti (paṭṭhā. 1.1.12)

vsm1.4:76.2.verse: imaṃ suttaṃ vatvā āsevanapaccayena pacchimo pacchimo dhammo balavā hoti, tasmā chaṭṭhepi sattamepi appanā hotīti āha.

vsm1.4:77.1.verse: Taṃ aṭṭhakathāsu ‘‘attano matimattaṃ therasseta’’nti vatvā paṭikkhittaṃ.

vsm1.4:77.3.verse: Parato javanaṃ patitaṃ nāma hoti, bhavaṅgassa āsannattāti vuttaṃ.

vsm1.4:77.4.verse: Tameva vicāretvā vuttattā na sakkā paṭikkhipituṃ.

vsm1.4:77.5.verse: Yathā hi puriso chinnapapātābhimukho dhāvanto ṭhātukāmopi pariyante pādaṃ katvā ṭhātuṃ na sakkoti papāte eva patati,

vsm1.4:77.6.verse: evaṃ chaṭṭhe vā sattame vā appetuṃ na sakkoti, bhavaṅgassa āsannattā.

vsm1.4:78.2.verse: Sattasu hi ṭhānesu addhānaparicchedo nāma natthi

vsm1.4:78.10.verse: Ettha maggānantaraphalaṃ tiṇṇaṃ upari na hoti.

vsm1.4:79.1.verse: Ettāvatā ca panesa vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi

vsm1.4:79.2.verse: savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati (dha. sa. 160; dī. ni. 1.226).

vsm1.4:79.4.verse: tividhakalyāṇaṃ dasalakkhaṇasampannaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ adhigataṃ hoti pathavīkasiṇaṃ.

vsm1.4:80.4.verse: Yo panāyamettha evakāro, so niyamatthoti veditabbo.

vsm1.4:80.5.verse: Yasmā ca niyamattho, tasmā tasmiṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharaṇasamaye

vsm1.4:81.1.verse: ‘‘Vivicceva kāmehī’’ti evañhi niyame kariyamāne idaṃ paññāyati,

vsm1.4:81.2.verse: nūna jhānassa kāmā paṭipakkhabhūtā yesu sati idaṃ nappavattati,

vsm1.4:81.4.verse: Tesaṃ pariccāgeneva cassa adhigamo hoti, orimatīrapariccāgena pārimatīrasseva.

vsm1.4:82.1.verse: Tattha siyā, kasmā panesa pubbapadeyeva vutto, na uttarapade,

vsm1.4:82.2.verse: kiṃ akusalehi dhammehi aviviccāpi jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyāti?

vsm1.4:82.5.verse: Kāmadhātusamatikkamanato hi kāmarāgapaṭipakkhato ca idaṃ jhānaṃ kāmānameva nissaraṇaṃ.

vsm1.4:82.7.verse: Uttarapadepi pana yathā ‘‘idheva, bhikkhave, samaṇo, idha dutiyo samaṇo’’ti (ma. ni. 1.139; a. ni. 4.241) ettha evakāro ānetvā vuccati, evaṃ vattabbo.

vsm1.4:82.8.verse: Na hi sakkā ito aññehipi nīvaraṇasaṅkhātehi akusaladhammehi avivicca jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.

vsm1.4:82.9.verse: Tasmā ‘‘vivicceva kāmehi vivicceva akusalehi dhammehī’’ti evaṃ padadvayepi esa daṭṭhabbo.

vsm1.4:82.10.verse: Padadvayepi ca kiñcāpi viviccāti iminā sādhāraṇavacanena

vsm1.4:82.11.verse: tadaṅgavivekādayo, kāyavivekādayo ca sabbepi vivekā saṅgahaṃ gacchanti,

vsm1.4:82.12.verse: tathāpi kāyaviveko cittaviveko vikkhambhanavivekoti tayo eva idha daṭṭhabbā.

vsm1.4:83.1.verse: Kāmehīti iminā pana padena ye ca niddese ‘‘katame vatthukāmā, manāpiyā rūpā’’tiādinā (mahāni. 1) nayena vatthukāmā vuttā,

vsm1.4:83.2.verse: ye ca tattheva vibhaṅge ca ‘‘chando kāmo, rāgo kāmo, chandarāgo kāmo, saṅkappo kāmo, rāgo kāmo, saṅkapparāgo kāmo, ime vuccanti kāmā’’ti (mahāni. 1; vibha. 564) evaṃ kilesakāmā vuttā, te sabbepi saṅgahitāicceva daṭṭhabbā.

vsm1.4:83.3.verse: Evañhi sati vivicceva kāmehīti vatthukāmehipi viviccevāti attho yujjati,

vsm1.4:83.5.verse: Vivicca akusalehi dhammehīti kilesakāmehi sabbākusalehi vā viviccāti attho yujjati,

vsm1.4:83.7.verse: Purimena cettha vatthukāmehi vivekavacanato eva kāmasukhapariccāgo,

vsm1.4:83.8.verse: dutiyena kilesakāmehi vivekavacanato nekkhammasukhapariggaho vibhāvito hoti.

vsm1.4:84.1.verse: Evaṃ vatthukāmakilesakāmavivekavacanatoyeva ca etesaṃ paṭhamena saṃkilesavatthuppahānaṃ,

vsm1.4:84.5.verse: Paṭhamena ca payogasuddhi, dutiyena āsayaposanaṃ vibhāvitaṃ hotīti viññātabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:84.6.verse: Esa tāva nayo kāmehīti ettha vuttakāmesu vatthukāmapakkhe.

vsm1.4:85.1.verse: Kilesakāmapakkhe pana chandoti ca rāgoti ca evamādīhi anekabhedo

vsm1.4:85.4.verse: ‘‘tattha katamo kāmo chando kāmo’’tiādinā (vibha. 564) nayena vibhaṅge jhānapaṭipakkhato visuṃ vutto.

vsm1.4:85.7.verse: Anekabhedato cassa kāmatoti avatvā kāmehīti vuttaṃ.

vsm1.4:86.2.verse: ‘‘tattha katame akusalā dhammā, kāmacchando’’tiādinā nayena vibhaṅge upari jhānaṅgānaṃ paccanīkapaṭipakkhabhāvadassanato nīvaraṇāneva vuttāni.

vsm1.4:86.4.verse: tesaṃ jhānaṅgāneva paṭipakkhāni viddhaṃsakāni vighātakānīti vuttaṃ hoti.

vsm1.4:87.1.verse: Evamettha vivicceva kāmehīti iminā kāmacchandassa vikkhambhanaviveko vutto hoti.

vsm1.4:87.2.verse: Vivicca akusalehi dhammehīti iminā pañcannampi nīvaraṇānaṃ,

vsm1.4:87.3.verse: agahitaggahaṇena pana paṭhamena kāmacchandassa, dutiyena sesanīvaraṇānaṃ.

vsm1.4:87.4.verse: Tathā paṭhamena tīsu akusalamūlesu pañcakāmaguṇabhedavisayassa lobhassa,

vsm1.4:87.11.verse: dutiyena sesānaṃ catunnaṃ akusalacittuppādānaṃ vikkhambhanaviveko vutto hotīti veditabbo.

vsm1.4:87.12.verse: Ayaṃ tāva vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehīti ettha atthappakāsanā.

vsm1.4:88.1.verse: Ettāvatā ca paṭhamassa jhānassa pahānaṅgaṃ dassetvā

vsm1.4:88.2.verse: idāni sampayogaṅgaṃ dassetuṃ savitakkaṃ savicārantiādi vuttaṃ.

vsm1.4:88.3.verse: Tattha vitakkanaṃ vitakko, ūhananti vuttaṃ hoti.

vsm1.4:88.6.verse: Tathā hi tena yogāvacaro ārammaṇaṃ vitakkāhataṃ vitakkapariyāhataṃ karotīti vuccati.

vsm1.4:89.2.verse: oḷārikaṭṭhena pubbaṅgamaṭṭhena ca ghaṇḍābhighāto viya cetaso paṭhamābhinipāto vitakko.

vsm1.4:89.5.verse: Vipphāravā cettha vitakko paṭhamuppattikāle paripphandanabhūto cittassa

vsm1.4:89.8.verse: Santavutti vicāro nātiparipphandanabhāvo cittassa ākāse uppatitassa pakkhino

vsm1.4:89.10.verse: paribbhamanaṃ viya ca padumābhimukhapatitassa bhamarassa padumassa uparibhāge.

vsm1.4:90.1.verse: Dukanipātaṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana ‘‘ākāse gacchato mahāsakuṇassa ubhohi pakkhehi vātaṃ gahetvā

vsm1.4:90.2.verse: pakkhe sannisīdāpetvā gamanaṃ viya ārammaṇe cetaso abhiniropanabhāvena pavatto vitakko.

vsm1.4:90.3.verse: Vātaggahaṇatthaṃ pakkhe phandāpayamānassa gamanaṃ viya anumajjanabhāvena pavatto vicāro’’ti vuttaṃ,

vsm1.4:90.5.verse: So pana nesaṃ viseso paṭhamadutiyajjhānesu pākaṭo hoti.

vsm1.4:91.1.verse: Apica malaggahitaṃ kaṃsabhājanaṃ ekena hatthena daḷhaṃ gahetvā itarena hatthena cuṇṇatelavālaṇḍupakena parimajjantassa daḷhagahaṇahattho viya vitakko, parimajjanahattho viya vicāro.

vsm1.4:91.2.verse: Tathā kumbhakārassa daṇḍappahārena cakkaṃ bhamayitvā bhājanaṃ karontassa

vsm1.4:91.3.verse: uppīḷanahattho viya vitakko, ito cito ca sañcaraṇahattho viya vicāro.

vsm1.4:91.5.verse: majjhe sannirumbhitvā ṭhitakaṇṭako viya abhiniropano vitakko, bahi paribbhamanakaṇṭako viya anumajjano vicāro.

vsm1.4:92.1.verse: Iti iminā ca vitakkena iminā ca vicārena saha vattati

vsm1.4:92.2.verse: rukkho viya pupphena phalena cāti idaṃ jhānaṃ ‘‘savitakkaṃ savicāra’’nti vuccati.

vsm1.4:92.4.verse: ‘‘iminā ca vitakkena iminā ca vicārena upeto hoti samupeto’’tiādinā (vibha. 565) nayena puggalādhiṭṭhānā desanā katā.

vsm1.4:93.1.verse: Vivekajanti ettha vivitti viveko, nīvaraṇavigamoti attho.

vsm1.4:93.4.verse: Tasmā vivekā, tasmiṃ vā viveke jātanti vivekajaṃ.

vsm1.4:94.9.verse: Tattha khuddikāpīti sarīre lomahaṃsamattameva kātuṃ sakkoti.

vsm1.4:94.11.verse: Okkantikāpīti samuddatīraṃ vīci viya kāyaṃ okkamitvā okkamitvā bhijjati.

vsm1.4:95.1.verse: Ubbegāpīti balavatī hoti kāyaṃ uddhaggaṃ katvā ākāse laṅghāpanappamāṇappattā.

vsm1.4:95.2.verse: Tathā hi puṇṇavallikavāsī mahātissatthero puṇṇamadivase sāyaṃ cetiyaṅgaṇaṃ gantvā

vsm1.4:95.4.verse: ‘‘imāya vata velāya catasso parisā mahācetiyaṃ vandantī’’ti

vsm1.4:95.6.verse: sudhātale pahaṭacitrageṇḍuko viya ākāse uppatitvā mahācetiyaṅgaṇeyeva patiṭṭhāsi.

vsm1.4:96.2.verse: ekā kuladhītāpi balavabuddhārammaṇāya ubbegāpītiyā ākāse laṅghesi.

vsm1.4:96.3.verse: Tassā kira mātāpitaro sāyaṃ dhammassavanatthāya vihāraṃ gacchantā

vsm1.4:96.4.verse: ‘‘amma tvaṃ garubhārā akāle vicarituṃ na sakkosi, mayaṃ tuyhaṃ pattiṃ katvā dhammaṃ sossāmā’’ti agamaṃsu.

vsm1.4:96.5.verse: Sā gantukāmāpi tesaṃ vacanaṃ paṭibāhituṃ asakkontī ghare ohīyitvā

vsm1.4:96.6.verse: gharājire ṭhatvā candālokena girikaṇḍake ākāsacetiyaṅgaṇaṃ olokentī cetiyassa dīpapūjaṃ addasa,

vsm1.4:96.7.verse: catasso ca parisā mālāgandhādīhi cetiyapūjaṃ katvā padakkhiṇaṃ karontiyo

vsm1.4:96.9.verse: Athassā ‘‘dhaññāvatime, ye vihāraṃ gantvā evarūpe cetiyaṅgaṇe anusañcarituṃ, evarūpañca madhuradhammakathaṃ sotuṃ labhantī’’ti

vsm1.4:96.10.verse: muttarāsisadisaṃ cetiyaṃ passantiyā eva ubbegāpīti udapādi.

vsm1.4:96.12.verse: ākāsato cetiyaṅgaṇe oruyha cetiyaṃ vanditvā dhammaṃ suṇamānā aṭṭhāsi.

vsm1.4:97.1.verse: Atha naṃ mātāpitaro āgantvā ‘‘amma tvaṃ katarena maggena āgatāsī’’ti pucchiṃsu.

vsm1.4:97.3.verse: ‘‘amma ākāsena nāma khīṇāsavā sañcaranti, tvaṃ kathaṃ āgatā’’ti vuttā āha –

vsm1.4:97.4.verse: ‘‘mayhaṃ candālokena cetiyaṃ ālokentiyā ṭhitāya buddhārammaṇā balavapīti uppajji.

vsm1.4:97.5.verse: Athāhaṃ neva attano ṭhitabhāvaṃ, na nisinnabhāvaṃ aññāsiṃ, gahitanimitteneva pana ākāse laṅghitvā cetiyaṅgaṇe patiṭṭhitāmhī’’ti.

vsm1.4:98.2.verse: pūritavatthi viya mahatā udakoghena pakkhandapabbatakucchi viya ca anuparipphuṭaṃ hoti.

vsm1.4:99.1.verse: Sā panesā pañcavidhā pīti gabbhaṃ gaṇhantī paripākaṃ gacchantī duvidhaṃ passaddhiṃ paripūreti

vsm1.4:99.3.verse: Passaddhi gabbhaṃ gaṇhantī paripākaṃ gacchantī duvidhampi sukhaṃ paripūreti kāyikañca cetasikañca.

vsm1.4:99.4.verse: Sukhaṃ gabbhaṃ gaṇhantaṃ paripākaṃ gacchantaṃ tividhaṃ samādhiṃ paripūreti

vsm1.4:99.6.verse: Tāsu yā appanāsamādhissa mūlaṃ hutvā vaḍḍhamānā samādhisampayogaṃ gatā pharaṇāpīti, ayaṃ imasmiṃ atthe adhippetā pītīti.

vsm1.4:100.2.verse: suṭṭhu vā khādati, khanati ca kāyacittābādhanti sukhaṃ,

vsm1.4:100.5.verse: Satipi ca nesaṃ katthaci avippayoge iṭṭhārammaṇapaṭilābhatuṭṭhi pīti.

vsm1.4:100.8.verse: Yattha sukhaṃ, tattha na niyamato pīti.

vsm1.4:100.13.verse: Tasmiṃ tasmiṃ samaye pākaṭabhāvato cetaṃ vuttanti veditabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:101.1.verse: Iti ayañca pīti idañca sukhaṃ assa jhānassa,

vsm1.4:101.2.verse: asmiṃ vā jhāne atthīti idaṃ jhānaṃ pītisukhanti vuccati.

vsm1.4:101.3.verse: Atha vā pīti ca sukhañca pītisukhaṃ,

vsm1.4:101.6.verse: asmiṃ vā jhāne atthīti evampi vivekajaṃpītisukhaṃ.

vsm1.4:101.9.verse: tañcassa atthi, tasmā ekapadeneva ‘‘vivekajaṃpītisukha’’ntipi vattuṃ yujjati.

vsm1.4:101.10.verse: Vibhaṅge pana ‘‘idaṃ sukhaṃ imāya pītiyā sahagata’’ntiādinā (vibha. 567) nayena vuttaṃ.

vsm1.4:102.5.verse: ‘‘upasampajjāti paṭhamassa jhānassa lābho paṭilābho patti sampatti phusanā sacchikiriyā upasampadā’’ti vuttaṃ.

vsm1.4:103.2.verse: tadanurūpena iriyāpathavihārena itivuttappakārajhānasamaṅgī hutvā attabhāvassa iriyaṃ vuttiṃ pālanaṃ yapanaṃ yāpanaṃ cāraṃ vihāraṃ abhinipphādeti.

vsm1.4:103.4.verse: ‘‘viharatīti iriyati vattati pāleti yapeti yāpeti carati viharati, tena vuccati viharatī’’ti (vibha. 540).

vsm1.4:104.5.verse: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ, vicikicchāti imesaṃ pañcannaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ pahānavasena pañcaṅgavippahīnatā veditabbā.

vsm1.4:104.6.verse: Na hi etesu appahīnesu jhānaṃ uppajjati.

vsm1.4:104.8.verse: Kiñcāpi hi jhānakkhaṇe aññepi akusalā dhammā pahīyanti,

vsm1.4:105.3.verse: Kāmacchandābhibhūtaṃ vā taṃ na kāmadhātuppahānāya paṭipadaṃ paṭipajjati.

vsm1.4:105.4.verse: Byāpādena cārammaṇe paṭihaññamānaṃ na nirantaraṃ pavattati.

vsm1.4:105.8.verse: Iti visesena jhānantarāyakarattā etāneva pahānaṅgānīti vuttānīti.

vsm1.4:106.1.verse: Yasmā pana vitakko ārammaṇe cittaṃ abhiniropeti, vicāro anuppabandhati,

vsm1.4:106.2.verse: tehi avikkhepāya sampāditappayogassa cetaso payogasampattisambhavā pīti pīṇanaṃ,

vsm1.4:106.4.verse: Atha naṃ sasesasampayuttadhammaṃ etehi abhiniropanānuppabandhanapīṇanaupabrūhanehi anuggahitā ekaggatā

vsm1.4:106.6.verse: tasmā vitakko vicāro pīti sukhaṃ cittekaggatāti imesaṃ pañcannaṃ uppattivasena pañcaṅgasamannāgatatā veditabbā.

vsm1.4:107.1.verse: Uppannesu hi etesu pañcasu jhānaṃ uppannaṃ nāma hoti.

vsm1.4:107.3.verse: Tasmā na etehi samannāgataṃ aññadeva jhānaṃ nāma atthīti gahetabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:107.8.verse: pañcaṅgikanti vā pañcaṅgasamannāgatanti vā vuccatīti veditabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:108.1.verse: Etāni ca pañcaṅgāni kiñcāpi upacārakkhaṇepi atthi, atha kho upacāre pakaticittato balavatarāni.

vsm1.4:108.3.verse: Ettha hi vitakko suvisadena ākārena ārammaṇe cittaṃ abhiniropayamāno uppajjati.

vsm1.4:108.6.verse: Tenevāha – ‘‘nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hotī’’ti (dī. ni. 1.228).

vsm1.4:108.7.verse: Cittekaggatāpi heṭṭhimamhi samuggapaṭale uparimaṃ samuggapaṭalaṃ viya ārammaṇesu phusitā hutvā uppajjati,

vsm1.4:109.1.verse: Tattha cittekaggatā kiñcāpi savitakkaṃ savicāranti imasmiṃ pāṭhe

vsm1.4:109.4.verse: ‘‘jhānanti vitakko vicāro pīti sukhaṃ cittassekaggatā’’ti (vibha. 569) evaṃ vuttattā aṅgameva.

vsm1.4:109.5.verse: Yena hi adhippāyena bhagavatā uddeso kato,

vsm1.4:110.2.verse: Tesaṃyeva ca ādimajjhapariyosānānaṃ lakkhaṇavasena dasalakkhaṇasampannatā veditabbā.

vsm1.4:111.3.verse: paṭhamassa jhānassa paṭipadāvisuddhi ādi, ādissa kati lakkhaṇāni?

vsm1.4:111.4.verse: Ādissa tīṇi lakkhaṇāni, yo tassa paribandho, tato cittaṃ visujjhati,

vsm1.4:111.8.verse: yañca visuddhattā cittaṃ majjhimaṃ samathanimittaṃ paṭipajjati,

vsm1.4:111.10.verse: Paṭhamassa jhānassa paṭipadāvisuddhi ādi, ādissa imāni tīṇi lakkhaṇāni.

vsm1.4:111.11.verse: Tena vuccati paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ ādikalyāṇañceva hoti tilakkhaṇasampannañca.

vsm1.4:112.1.verse: ‘‘Paṭhamassa jhānassa upekkhānubrūhanā majjhe, majjhassa kati lakkhaṇāni?

vsm1.4:112.2.verse: Majjhassa tīṇi lakkhaṇāni, visuddhaṃ cittaṃ ajjhupekkhati,

vsm1.4:112.8.verse: Paṭhamassa jhānassa upekkhānubrūhanā majjhe, majjhassa imāni tīṇi lakkhaṇāni.

vsm1.4:112.9.verse: Tena vuccati paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ majjhekalyāṇañceva hoti tilakkhaṇasampannañca.

vsm1.4:113.1.verse: ‘‘Paṭhamassa jhānassa sampahaṃsanā pariyosānaṃ, pariyosānassa kati lakkhaṇāni?

vsm1.4:113.2.verse: Pariyosānassa cattāri lakkhaṇāni, tattha jātānaṃ dhammānaṃ anativattanaṭṭhena sampahaṃsanā,

vsm1.4:113.6.verse: Paṭhamassa jhānassa sampahaṃsanā pariyosānaṃ, pariyosānassa imāni cattāri lakkhaṇāni.

vsm1.4:113.7.verse: Tena vuccati paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇañceva hoti catulakkhaṇasampannañcā’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.158).

vsm1.4:114.5.verse: upekkhānubrūhitañca ñāṇena ca sampahaṃsita’’nti (paṭi. ma. 1.158) pāḷiyaṃ vuttaṃ,

vsm1.4:114.8.verse: dhammānaṃ anativattanādibhāvasādhanena pariyodāpakassa ñāṇassa kiccanipphattivasena sampahaṃsanā ca veditabbā.

vsm1.4:115.2.verse: tasmiṃ yo nīvaraṇasaṅkhāto kilesagaṇo tassa jhānassa paribandho, tato cittaṃ visujjhati.

vsm1.4:115.7.verse: majjhimaṃ samathanimittaṃ paṭipajjati nāma, evaṃ paṭipannattā tathattupagamanena tattha pakkhandati nāma.

vsm1.4:115.9.verse: paṭhamassa jhānassa uppādakkhaṇeyeva āgamanavasena paṭipadāvisuddhi veditabbā.

vsm1.4:116.1.verse: Evaṃ visuddhassa pana tassa puna visodhetabbābhāvato visodhane byāpāraṃ akaronto

vsm1.4:116.3.verse: Samathabhāvupagamanena samathapaṭipannassa puna samādhāne byāpāraṃ akaronto

vsm1.4:116.5.verse: Samathapaṭipannabhāvato eva cassa kilesasaṃsaggaṃ pahāya ekattena upaṭṭhitassa puna ekattupaṭṭhāne byāpāraṃ akaronto

vsm1.4:117.2.verse: tattha jātā samādhipaññāsaṅkhātā yuganaddhadhammā aññamaññaṃ anativattamānā hutvā pavattā,

vsm1.4:117.3.verse: yāni ca saddhādīni indriyāni nānākilesehi vimuttattā

vsm1.4:117.5.verse: yañcesa tadupagaṃ tesaṃ anativattanaekarasabhāvānaṃ anucchavikaṃ vīriyaṃ vāhayati,

vsm1.4:117.6.verse: yā cassa tasmiṃ khaṇe pavattā āsevanā,

vsm1.4:117.7.verse: sabbepi te ākārā yasmā ñāṇena saṃkilesavodānesu taṃ taṃ ādīnavañca ānisaṃsañca disvā

vsm1.4:117.8.verse: tathā tathā sampahaṃsitattā visodhitattā pariyodāpitattā nipphannāva,

vsm1.4:118.1.verse: Tattha yasmā upekkhāvasena ñāṇaṃ pākaṭaṃ hoti.

vsm1.4:119.1.verse: Idāni paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ adhigataṃ hoti pathavīkasiṇanti ettha

vsm1.4:119.6.verse: Tatra imasmiṃ atthe jhānaṃ pathavīkasiṇanti veditabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:119.7.verse: Taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ ‘‘paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ adhigataṃ hoti pathavīkasiṇa’’nti.

vsm1.4:120.1.verse: Evamadhigate pana etasmiṃ tena yoginā vālavedhinā viya,

vsm1.4:120.3.verse: Yathā hi sukusalo dhanuggaho vālavedhāya kammaṃ kurumāno yasmiṃ vāre vālaṃ vijjhati,

vsm1.4:120.4.verse: tasmiṃ vāre akkantapadānañca dhanudaṇḍassa ca jiyāya ca sarassa ca ākāraṃ pariggaṇheyya.

vsm1.4:120.5.verse: ‘‘Evaṃ me ṭhitena evaṃ dhanudaṇḍaṃ evaṃ jiyaṃ evaṃ saraṃ gahetvā vālo viddho’’ti.

vsm1.4:120.6.verse: So tato paṭṭhāya tatheva te ākāre sampādento avirādhetvā vālaṃ vijjheyya.

vsm1.4:120.7.verse: Evameva yogināpi ‘‘imaṃ nāma me bhojanaṃ bhuñjitvā evarūpaṃ puggalaṃ sevamānena

vsm1.4:120.9.verse: iminā nāma iriyāpathena imasmiṃ kāle idaṃ adhigata’’nti ete bhojanasappāyādayo ākārā pariggahetabbā.

vsm1.4:120.10.verse: Evañhi so naṭṭhe vā tasmiṃ te ākāre sampādetvā puna uppādetuṃ,

vsm1.4:120.11.verse: appaguṇaṃ vā paguṇaṃ karonto punappunaṃ appetuṃ sakkhissati.

vsm1.4:121.1.verse: Yathā ca kusalo sūdo bhattāraṃ parivisanto tassa yaṃ yaṃ ruciyā bhuñjati, taṃ taṃ sallakkhetvā

vsm1.4:121.2.verse: tato paṭṭhāya tādisameva upanāmento lābhassa bhāgī hoti,

vsm1.4:121.4.verse: te sampādento naṭṭhe naṭṭhe punappunaṃ appanāya lābhī hoti.

vsm1.4:121.5.verse: Tasmā tena vālavedhinā viya sūdena viya ca ākārā pariggahetabbā.

vsm1.4:122.1.verse: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, paṇḍito byatto kusalo sūdo rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattaṃ vā nānaccayehi sūpehi paccupaṭṭhito assa ambilaggehipi tittakaggehipi kaṭukaggehipi madhuraggehipi khārikehipi akhārikehipi loṇikehipi aloṇikehipi.

vsm1.4:122.2.verse: Sa kho so, bhikkhave, paṇḍito byatto kusalo sūdo sakassa bhattu nimittaṃ uggaṇhāti ‘idaṃ vā me ajja bhattu sūpeyyaṃ ruccati, imassa vā abhiharati, imassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti, imassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, ambilaggaṃ vā me ajja bhattu sūpeyyaṃ ruccati, ambilaggassa vā abhiharati, ambilaggassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti, ambilaggassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati…pe… aloṇikassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatī’ti.

vsm1.4:122.3.verse: Sa kho so, bhikkhave, paṇḍito byatto kusalo sūdo lābhī ceva hoti acchādanassa, lābhī vetanassa, lābhī abhihārānaṃ.

vsm1.4:122.4.verse: Taṃ kissa hetu? Tathā hi so, bhikkhave, paṇḍito byatto kusalo sūdo sakassa bhattu nimittaṃ uggaṇhāti.

vsm1.4:122.5.verse: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco paṇḍito byatto kusalo bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati…pe… vedanāsu vedanā… citte cittā… dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato cittaṃ samādhiyati, upakkilesā pahīyanti,

vsm1.4:122.7.verse: Sa kho so, bhikkhave, paṇḍito byatto kusalo bhikkhu lābhī ceva hoti diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ, lābhī satisampajaññassa.

vsm1.4:122.8.verse: Taṃ kissa hetu? Tathā hi so, bhikkhave, paṇḍito byatto kusalo bhikkhu sakassa cittassa nimittaṃ uggaṇhātī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.374).

vsm1.4:123.1.verse: Nimittaggahaṇena cassa puna te ākāre sampādayato appanāmattameva ijjhati, na ciraṭṭhānaṃ.

vsm1.4:123.2.verse: Ciraṭṭhānaṃ pana samādhiparibandhānaṃ dhammānaṃ suvisodhitattā hoti.

vsm1.4:124.1.verse: Yo hi bhikkhu kāmādīnavapaccavekkhaṇādīhi kāmacchandaṃ na suṭṭhu vikkhambhetvā,

vsm1.4:124.5.verse: aññepi samādhiparibandhe dhamme na suṭṭhu visodhetvā jhānaṃ samāpajjati,

vsm1.4:124.6.verse: so avisodhitaṃ āsayaṃ paviṭṭhabhamaro viya avisuddhaṃ uyyānaṃ paviṭṭharājā viya ca khippameva nikkhamati.

vsm1.4:125.1.verse: Yo pana samādhiparibandhe dhamme suṭṭhu visodhetvā jhānaṃ samāpajjati,

vsm1.4:125.2.verse: so suvisodhitaṃ āsayaṃ paviṭṭhabhamaro viya suparisuddhaṃ uyyānaṃ paviṭṭharājā viya ca sakalampi divasabhāgaṃ antosamāpattiyaṃyeva hoti.

vsm1.4:125.5.verse: Vivekapāmojjakarena cetasā, Rājāva suddhantagato tahiṃ rame’’ti.

vsm1.4:126.1.verse: Tasmā ciraṭṭhitikāmena paribandhakadhamme visodhetvā jhānaṃ samāpajjitabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:127.2.verse: Tassa dve vaḍḍhanābhūmiyo upacāraṃ vā appanaṃ vā.

vsm1.4:127.3.verse: Upacāraṃ patvāpi hi taṃ vaḍḍhetuṃ vaṭṭati appanaṃ patvāpi.

vsm1.4:127.8.verse: yathā nāma kassako kasitabbaṭṭhānaṃ naṅgalena paricchinditvā paricchedabbhantare kasati, yathā vā pana bhikkhū sīmaṃ bandhantā paṭhamaṃ nimittāni sallakkhetvā pacchā bandhanti, evameva tassa yathāladdhassa nimittassa anukkamena ekaṅguladvaṅgulativaṅgulacaturaṅgulamattaṃ manasā paricchinditvā yathāparicchedaṃ vaḍḍhetabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:127.11.verse: gāmanigamajanapadarajjasamuddasīmānañca paricchedavasena vaḍḍhayantena cakkavāḷaparicchedena vā tato vāpi uttari paricchinditvā vaḍḍhetabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:128.1.verse: Yathā hi haṃsapotakā pakkhānaṃ uṭṭhitakālato paṭṭhāya parittaṃ parittaṃ padesaṃ uppatantā paricayaṃ katvā

vsm1.4:128.2.verse: anukkamena candimasūriyasantikaṃ gacchanti, evameva bhikkhu vuttanayena nimittaṃ paricchinditvā vaḍḍhento yāva cakkavāḷaparicchedā tato vā uttari vaḍḍheti.

vsm1.4:129.1.verse: Athassa taṃ nimittaṃ vaḍḍhitavaḍḍhitaṭṭhāne pathaviyā ukkūlavikūlanadīviduggapabbatavisamesu

vsm1.4:129.3.verse: Tasmiṃ pana nimitte pattapaṭhamajjhānena ādikammikena samāpajjanabahulena bhavitabbaṃ, na paccavekkhaṇabahulena.

vsm1.4:129.4.verse: Paccavekkhaṇabahulassa hi jhānaṅgāni thūlāni dubbalāni hutvā upaṭṭhahanti.

vsm1.4:129.5.verse: Athassa tāni evaṃ upaṭṭhitattā upari ussukkanāya paccayataṃ āpajjanti.

vsm1.4:129.6.verse: So appaguṇe jhāne ussukkamāno pattapaṭhamajjhānā ca parihāyati, na ca sakkoti dutiyaṃ pāpuṇituṃ.

vsm1.4:130.2.verse: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.

vsm1.4:130.3.verse: Tassā evamassa ‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ agatapubbañceva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ, akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ, apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyya’nti.

vsm1.4:130.4.verse: Sā purimaṃ pādaṃ na supatiṭṭhitaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā pacchimaṃ pādaṃ uddhareyya,

vsm1.4:130.5.verse: sā na ceva agatapubbaṃ disaṃ gaccheyya, na ca akhāditapubbāni tiṇāni khādeyya, na ca apītapubbāni pānīyāni piveyya.

vsm1.4:130.6.verse: Yasmiñcassā padese ṭhitāya evamassa ‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ agatapubbañceva…pe… piveyya’nti. Tañca padesaṃ na sotthinā paccāgaccheyya.

vsm1.4:130.7.verse: Taṃ kissa hetu? Tathā hi sā, bhikkhave, gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ,

vsm1.4:130.8.verse: evameva kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco bhikkhu bālo abyatto akhettaññū akusalo vivicceva kāmehi…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.

vsm1.4:130.9.verse: So taṃ nimittaṃ nāsevati, na bhāveti, na bahulīkaroti, na svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti,

vsm1.4:130.10.verse: tassa evaṃ hoti ‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā…pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyya’nti.

vsm1.4:130.11.verse: So na sakkoti vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā…pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.

vsm1.4:130.12.verse: Tassevaṃ hoti ‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ vivicceva kāmehi…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyya’nti.

vsm1.4:130.13.verse: So na sakkoti vivicceva kāmehi…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ubhato bhaṭṭho ubhato parihīno, seyyathāpi sā gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate caritu’’nti (a. ni. 9.35).

vsm1.4:131.1.verse: Tasmānena tasmiṃyeva tāva paṭhamajjhāne pañcahākārehi ciṇṇavasinā bhavitabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:131.2.verse: Tatrimā pañca vasiyo āvajjanavasī, samāpajjanavasī, adhiṭṭhānavasī,

vsm1.4:131.4.verse: Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ yatthicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvadicchakaṃ āvajjeti,

vsm1.4:131.6.verse: Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ yatthicchakaṃ…pe… samāpajjati, samāpajjanāya dandhāyitattaṃ natthīti samāpajjanavasī.

vsm1.4:132.1.verse: Ayaṃ panettha atthappakāsanā, paṭhamajjhānato vuṭṭhāya paṭhamaṃ vitakkaṃ āvajjayato bhavaṅgaṃ upacchinditvā

vsm1.4:132.2.verse: uppannāvajjanānantaraṃ vitakkārammaṇāneva cattāri pañca vā javanāni javanti.

vsm1.4:132.3.verse: Tato dve bhavaṅgāni, tato puna vicārārammaṇaṃ āvajjanaṃ,

vsm1.4:132.4.verse: vuttanayāneva javanānīti evaṃ pañcasu jhānaṅgesu yadā nirantaraṃ cittaṃ pesetuṃ sakkoti, athassa āvajjanavasī siddhā hoti.

vsm1.4:132.5.verse: Ayaṃ pana matthakappattā vasī bhagavato yamakapāṭihāriye labbhati,

vsm1.4:132.7.verse: Ito paraṃ sīghatarā āvajjanavasī nāma natthi.

vsm1.4:134.1.verse: Accharāmattaṃ vā dasaccharāmattaṃ vā khaṇaṃ ṭhapetuṃ

vsm1.4:134.3.verse: Tatheva lahuṃ vuṭṭhātuṃ samatthatā vuṭṭhānavasī nāma.

vsm1.4:135.3.verse: tiṃsamattānaṃ iddhimantasahassānaṃ majjhe nisinno therassa yāguṃ paṭiggāhayamānaṃ upaṭṭhākanāgarājānaṃ gahessāmīti

vsm1.4:135.4.verse: ākāsato pakkhandantaṃ supaṇṇarājānaṃ disvā tāvadeva pabbataṃ nimminitvā nāgarājānaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā tattha pāvisi.

vsm1.4:135.6.verse: Mahāthero āha – ‘‘sace, āvuso, buddharakkhito nābhavissa, sabbeva gārayhā assāmā’’ti.

vsm1.4:137.1.verse: Imāsu pana pañcasu vasīsu ciṇṇavasinā paguṇapaṭhamajjhānato vuṭṭhāya

vsm1.4:137.2.verse: ‘‘ayaṃ samāpatti āsannanīvaraṇapaccatthikā, vitakkavicārānaṃ oḷārikattā aṅgadubbalā’’ti ca

vsm1.4:137.3.verse: tattha dosaṃ disvā dutiyajjhānaṃ santato manasikatvā

vsm1.4:137.4.verse: paṭhamajjhāne nikantiṃ pariyādāya dutiyādhigamāya yogo kātabbo.

vsm1.4:138.1.verse: Athassa yadā paṭhamajjhānā vuṭṭhāya satassa sampajānassa jhānaṅgāni paccavekkhato

vsm1.4:138.2.verse: vitakkavicārā oḷārikato upaṭṭhahanti, pītisukhañceva cittekaggatā ca santato upaṭṭhāti,

vsm1.4:138.4.verse: tadeva nimittaṃ ‘‘pathavī pathavī’’ti punappunaṃ manasikaroto ‘‘idāni dutiyajjhānaṃ uppajjissatī’’ti

vsm1.4:138.5.verse: bhavaṅgaṃ upacchinditvā tadeva pathavīkasiṇaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā manodvārāvajjanaṃ uppajjati.

vsm1.4:138.6.verse: Tato tasmiṃyevārammaṇe cattāri pañca vā javanāni javanti,

vsm1.4:139.2.verse: ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

vsm1.4:139.4.verse: tividhakalyāṇaṃ dasalakkhaṇasampannaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ adhigataṃ hoti pathavīkasiṇaṃ.

vsm1.4:140.1.verse: Tattha vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamāti vitakkassa ca vicārassa cāti

vsm1.4:140.2.verse: imesaṃ dvinnaṃ vūpasamā samatikkamā, dutiyajjhānakkhaṇe apātubhāvāti vuttaṃ hoti.

vsm1.4:140.3.verse: Tattha kiñcāpi dutiyajjhāne sabbepi paṭhamajjhānadhammā na santi.

vsm1.4:140.4.verse: Aññeyeva hi paṭhamajjhāne phassādayo, aññe idha.

vsm1.4:140.5.verse: Oḷārikassa pana oḷārikassa aṅgassa samatikkamā paṭhamajjhānato paresaṃ dutiyajjhānādīnaṃ adhigamo hotīti dīpanatthaṃ ‘‘vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā’’ti evaṃ vuttanti veditabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:141.3.verse: Yasmā ca niyakajjhattamadhippetaṃ, tasmā attani jātaṃ attano santāne nibbattanti ayamettha attho.

vsm1.4:142.5.verse: vitakkavicārakkhobhavūpasamanena ca cetaso sampasādayati, tasmāpi sampasādananti vuttaṃ.

vsm1.4:142.6.verse: Imasmiñca atthavikappe sampasādanaṃ cetasoti evaṃ padasambandho veditabbo.

vsm1.4:142.7.verse: Purimasmiṃ pana atthavikappe cetasoti etaṃ ekodibhāvena saddhiṃ yojetabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:143.2.verse: vitakkavicārehi anajjhārūḷhattā aggo seṭṭho hutvā udetīti attho.

vsm1.4:143.4.verse: Vitakkavicāravirahato vā eko asahāyo hutvā itipi vattuṃ vaṭṭati.

vsm1.4:143.5.verse: Atha vā sampayuttadhamme udāyatīti udi, uṭṭhāpetīti attho.

vsm1.4:143.6.verse: Seṭṭhaṭṭhena eko ca so udi cāti ekodi,

vsm1.4:143.8.verse: Iti imaṃ ekodiṃ bhāveti vaḍḍhetīti idaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ ekodibhāvaṃ.

vsm1.4:143.9.verse: So panāyaṃ ekodi yasmā cetaso, na sattassa, na jīvassa, tasmā etaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvanti vuttaṃ.

vsm1.4:144.1.verse: Nanu cāyaṃ saddhā paṭhamajjhānepi atthi, ayañca ekodināmako samādhi,

vsm1.4:144.2.verse: atha kasmā idameva ‘‘sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvañcā’’ti vuttanti.

vsm1.4:144.3.verse: Vuccate, aduñhi paṭhamajjhānaṃ vitakkavicārakkhobhena vīcitaraṅgasamākulamiva jalaṃ na suppasannaṃ hoti,

vsm1.4:144.5.verse: Na suppasannattāyeva cettha samādhipi na suṭṭhu pākaṭo,

vsm1.4:144.7.verse: Imasmiṃ pana jhāne vitakkavicārapalibodhābhāvena laddhokāsā balavatī saddhā,

vsm1.4:145.1.verse: Vibhaṅge pana ‘‘sampasādananti yā saddhā saddahanā okappanā abhippasādo.

vsm1.4:145.2.verse: Cetaso ekodibhāvanti yā cittassa ṭhiti…pe… sammāsamādhī’’ti ettakameva vuttaṃ.

vsm1.4:145.3.verse: Evaṃ vuttena pana tena saddhiṃ ayamatthavaṇṇanā yathā na virujjhati,

vsm1.4:145.4.verse: aññadatthu saṃsandati ceva sameti ca, evaṃ veditabbā.

vsm1.4:146.4.verse: Vibhaṅgepi vuttaṃ ‘‘iti ayañca vitakko ayañca vicāro santā honti samitā vūpasantā

vsm1.4:146.7.verse: sositā visositā byantikatā, tena vuccati avitakkaṃ avicāra’’nti (vibha. 576).

vsm1.4:146.8.verse: Etthāha ‘‘nanu ca ‘vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā’ti imināpi ayamattho siddho,

vsm1.4:146.10.verse: Vuccate, evametaṃ siddhovāyamattho, na panetaṃ tadatthadīpakaṃ.

vsm1.4:146.11.verse: Nanu avocumha ‘‘oḷārikassa pana oḷārikassa aṅgassa samatikkamā paṭhamajjhānato paresaṃ dutiyajjhānādīnaṃ samadhigamo hotīti dassanatthaṃ vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamāti evaṃ vutta’’nti.

vsm1.4:147.1.verse: Apica vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā idaṃ sampasādanaṃ, na kilesakālussiyassa.

vsm1.4:147.2.verse: Vitakkavicārānañca vūpasamā ekodibhāvaṃ, na upacārajjhānamiva nīvaraṇappahānā, paṭhamajjhānamiva ca na aṅgapātubhāvāti

vsm1.4:147.4.verse: Tathā vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā idaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ, na tatiyacatutthajjhānāni viya cakkhuviññāṇādīni viya ca abhāvāti

vsm1.4:148.1.verse: Samādhijanti paṭhamajjhānasamādhito sampayuttasamādhito vā jātanti attho.

vsm1.4:148.3.verse: atha kho ayameva samādhi ‘‘samādhī’’ti vattabbataṃ arahati vitakkavicārakkhobhavirahena ativiya acalattā, suppasannattā ca,

vsm1.4:149.3.verse: Yathā ca paṭhamajjhānassa upacārakkhaṇe nīvaraṇāni pahīyanti,

vsm1.4:149.5.verse: Appanākkhaṇeyeva ca panetaṃ vinā tehi uppajjati.

vsm1.4:150.1.verse: Pīti sukhaṃ cittekaggatāti imesaṃ pana tiṇṇaṃ uppattivasena tivaṅgasamannāgatatā veditabbā.

vsm1.4:150.2.verse: Tasmā yaṃ vibhaṅge ‘‘jhānanti sampasādo pīti sukhaṃ cittassa ekaggatā’’ti (vibha. 580) vuttaṃ,

vsm1.4:150.3.verse: taṃ saparikkhāraṃ jhānaṃ dassetuṃ pariyāyena vuttaṃ.

vsm1.4:150.5.verse: upanijjhānalakkhaṇappattānaṃ aṅgānaṃ vasena tivaṅgikameva etaṃ hoti.

vsm1.4:150.6.verse: Yathāha – ‘‘katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye tivaṅgikaṃ jhānaṃ hoti,

vsm1.4:150.7.verse: pīti sukhaṃ cittassa ekaggatā’’ti (dha. sa. 161; vibha. 628).

vsm1.4:180.1.verse: Evamadhigate pana tasmiṃpi vuttanayeneva pañcahākārehi ciṇṇavasinā hutvā paguṇatatiyajjhānato vuṭṭhāya

vsm1.4:180.2.verse: ‘‘ayaṃ samāpatti āsannapītipaccatthikā, ‘yadeva tattha sukhamiti cetaso ābhogo, etenetaṃ oḷārikaṃ akkhāyatī’ti (dī. ni. 1.96)

vsm1.4:180.3.verse: evaṃ vuttassa sukhassa oḷārikattā aṅgadubbalā’’ti ca

vsm1.4:180.4.verse: tattha dosaṃ disvā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ santato manasikatvā

vsm1.4:180.5.verse: tatiyajjhāne nikantiṃ pariyādāya catutthādhigamāya yogo kātabbo.

vsm1.4:181.1.verse: Athassa yadā tatiyajjhānato vuṭṭhāya satassa sampajānassa jhānaṅgāni paccavekkhato

vsm1.4:181.2.verse: cetasikasomanassasaṅkhātaṃ sukhaṃ oḷārikato upaṭṭhāti, upekkhāvedanā ceva cittekaggatā ca santato upaṭṭhāti, tadāssa oḷārikaṅgappahānāya santaaṅgapaṭilābhāya ca

vsm1.4:181.3.verse: tadeva nimittaṃ ‘‘pathavī pathavī’’ti punappunaṃ manasikaroto ‘‘idāni catutthaṃ jhānaṃ uppajjissatī’’ti

vsm1.4:181.4.verse: bhavaṅgaṃ upacchinditvā tadeva pathavīkasiṇaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā manodvārāvajjanaṃ uppajjati.

vsm1.4:181.5.verse: Tato tasmiṃyevārammaṇe cattāri pañca vā javanāni uppajjanti,

vsm1.4:182.1.verse: Ayaṃ pana viseso, yasmā sukhavedanā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya āsevanapaccayena paccayo na hoti,

vsm1.4:183.1.verse: Ettāvatā cesa sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā

vsm1.4:183.3.verse: adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati (dī. ni. 1.232; dha. sa. 165).

vsm1.4:183.5.verse: tividhakalyāṇaṃ dasalakkhaṇasampannaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ adhigataṃ hoti pathavīkasiṇaṃ.

vsm1.4:184.1.verse: Tattha sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānāti kāyikasukhassa ca kāyikadukkhassa ca pahānā.

vsm1.4:184.2.verse: Pubbevāti tañca kho pubbeva, na catutthajjhānakkhaṇe.

vsm1.4:184.3.verse: Somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāti cetasikasukhassa ca cetasikadukkhassa cāti imesampi dvinnaṃ

vsm1.4:184.4.verse: pubbeva atthaṅgamā, pahānā icceva vuttaṃ hoti.

vsm1.4:185.6.verse: indriyavibhaṅge pana indriyānaṃ uddesakkameneva idhāpi vuttānaṃ sukhadukkhasomanassadomanassānaṃ pahānaṃ veditabbaṃ.

vsm1.4:186.1.verse: Yadi panetāni tassa tassa jhānassa upacārakkhaṇeyeva pahīyanti,

vsm1.4:186.2.verse: atha kasmā ‘‘kattha cuppannaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati,

vsm1.4:186.3.verse: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehipi…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

vsm1.4:186.5.verse: Kattha cuppannaṃ domanassindriyaṃ sukhindriyaṃ somanassindriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati,

vsm1.4:186.6.verse: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā…pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,

vsm1.4:186.7.verse: ettha cuppannaṃ somanassindriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.510) evaṃ jhānesveva nirodho vuttoti?

vsm1.4:186.9.verse: Atisayanirodho hi nesaṃ paṭhamajjhānādīsu, na nirodhoyeva.

vsm1.4:187.3.verse: visamāsanupatāpena vā siyā uppatti, na tveva antoappanāyaṃ.

vsm1.4:187.4.verse: Upacāre vā niruddhampetaṃ na suṭṭhu niruddhaṃ hoti, paṭipakkhena avihatattā.

vsm1.4:187.5.verse: Antoappanāyaṃ pana pītipharaṇena sabbo kāyo sukhokkanto hoti,

vsm1.4:187.6.verse: sukhokkantakāyassa ca suṭṭhu niruddhaṃ hoti dukkhindriyaṃ, paṭipakkhena vihatattā.

vsm1.4:188.2.verse: yasmā etaṃ vitakkavicārapaccayepi kāyakilamathe cittupaghāte ca sati uppajjati.

vsm1.4:188.4.verse: Yattha pana uppajjati, tattha vitakkavicārabhāve, appahīnā eva ca dutiyajjhānupacāre vitakkavicārāti

vsm1.4:188.5.verse: tatthassa siyā uppatti, na tveva dutiyajjhāne, pahīnapaccayattā.

vsm1.4:189.4.verse: Tatiyajjhāne hi sukhassa paccayabhūtā pīti sabbaso niruddhāti.

vsm1.4:189.6.verse: āsannattā appanāppattāya upekkhāya abhāvena sammā anatikkantattā ca siyā uppatti,

vsm1.4:189.8.verse: Tasmā eva ca etthuppannaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhatīti

vsm1.4:190.1.verse: Etthāha ‘‘athevaṃ tassa tassa jhānassupacāre pahīnāpi etā vedanā idha kasmā samāhaṭā’’ti?

vsm1.4:190.3.verse: Yā hi ayaṃ adukkhamasukhanti ettha adukkhamasukhā vedanā vuttā,

vsm1.4:190.4.verse: sā sukhumā duviññeyyā na sakkā sukhena gahetuṃ,

vsm1.4:190.5.verse: tasmā yathā nāma duṭṭhassa yathā vā tathā vā upasaṅkamitvā gahetuṃ asakkuṇeyyassa goṇassa

vsm1.4:190.6.verse: sukhaggahaṇatthaṃ gopo ekasmiṃ vaje sabbā gāvo samāharati,

vsm1.4:190.8.verse: ‘‘ayaṃ so gaṇhatha na’’nti tampi gāhayati, evameva bhagavā sukhaggahaṇatthaṃ sabbā etā samāhari.

vsm1.4:190.9.verse: Evañhi samāhaṭā etā dassetvā yaṃ neva sukhaṃ na dukkhaṃ na somanassaṃ na domanassaṃ,

vsm1.4:190.10.verse: ayaṃ adukkhamasukhā vedanāti sakkā hoti esā gāhayituṃ.

vsm1.4:191.1.verse: Apica adukkhamasukhāya cetovimuttiyā paccayadassanatthañcāpi etā vuttāti veditabbā.

vsm1.4:191.3.verse: Yathāha – ‘‘cattāro kho, āvuso, paccayā adukkhamasukhāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā.

vsm1.4:191.4.verse: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā…pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

vsm1.4:191.5.verse: Ime khvāvuso, cattāro paccayā adukkhamasukhāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā’’ti (ma. ni. 1.458).

vsm1.4:192.1.verse: Yathā vā aññattha pahīnāpi sakkāyadiṭṭhiādayo tatiyamaggassa vaṇṇabhaṇanatthaṃ tattha pahīnāti vuttā,

vsm1.4:192.2.verse: evaṃ vaṇṇabhaṇanatthampetassa jhānassetā idha vuttātipi veditabbā.

vsm1.4:192.5.verse: Etāsu hi sukhaṃ somanassassa paccayo, somanassaṃ rāgassa.

vsm1.4:192.7.verse: Sukhādighātena cassa sappaccayā rāgadosā hatāti atidūre hontīti.

vsm1.4:194.2.verse: Imasmiñhi jhāne suparisuddhā sati, yā ca tassā satiyā pārisuddhi, sā upekkhāya katā, na aññena.

vsm1.4:194.4.verse: Vibhaṅgepi vuttaṃ ‘‘ayaṃ sati imāya upekkhāya visadā hoti parisuddhā pariyodātā.

vsm1.4:194.6.verse: Yāya ca upekkhāya ettha satiyā pārisuddhi hoti, sā atthato tatramajjhattatātiveditabbā.

vsm1.4:194.7.verse: Na kevalañcettha tāya satiyeva parisuddhā, apica kho sabbepi sampayuttadhammā,

vsm1.4:195.1.verse: Tattha kiñcāpi ayaṃ upekkhā heṭṭhāpi tīsu jhānesu vijjati.

vsm1.4:195.2.verse: Yathā pana divā sūriyappabhābhibhavā sommabhāvena ca attano upakārakattena vā sabhāgāya rattiyā alābhā divā vijjamānāpi candalekhā aparisuddhā hoti apariyodātā,

vsm1.4:195.3.verse: evamayampi tatramajjhattupekkhācandalekhā vitakkādipaccanīkadhammatejābhibhavā sabhāgāya ca upekkhāvedanārattiyā appaṭilābhā vijjamānāpi paṭhamādijjhānabhedesu aparisuddhā hoti.

vsm1.4:195.5.verse: divā aparisuddhacandalekhāya pabhā viya sahajātāpi satiādayo aparisuddhāva honti.

vsm1.4:195.7.verse: Idha pana vitakkādipaccanīkadhammatejābhibhavābhāvā sabhāgāya ca upekkhāvedanārattiyā paṭilābhā ayaṃ tatramajjhattupekkhācandalekhā ativiya parisuddhā.

vsm1.4:195.9.verse: parisuddhacandalekhāya pabhā viya sahajātāpi satiādayo parisuddhā honti pariyodātā.

vsm1.4:197.3.verse: Tañca pana somanassaṃ ekavīthiyaṃ purimajavanesuyeva pahīyati.

vsm1.4:197.5.verse: Upekkhāvedanā cittassekaggatāti imesaṃ pana dvinnaṃ uppattivasena duvaṅgasamannāgatatā veditabbā.

vsm1.4:198.2.verse: ‘‘ayaṃ samāpatti āsannanīvaraṇapaccatthikā, vitakkassa oḷārikattā aṅgadubbalā’’ti ca

vsm1.4:198.3.verse: tattha dosaṃ disvā dutiyajjhānaṃ santato manasikaritvā

vsm1.4:198.4.verse: paṭhamajjhāne nikantiṃ pariyādāya dutiyādhigamāya yogo kātabbo.

vsm1.4:199.1.verse: Athassa yadā paṭhamajjhānā vuṭṭhāya satassa sampajānassa

vsm1.4:199.2.verse: jhānaṅgāni paccavekkhato vitakkamattaṃ oḷārikato upaṭṭhāti, vicārādayo santato.

vsm1.4:199.4.verse: tadeva nimittaṃ ‘‘pathavī pathavī’’ti punappunaṃ manasikaroto vuttanayeneva dutiyajjhānaṃ uppajjati.

vsm1.4:200.1.verse: Evamadhigate pana tasmimpi vuttanayeneva pañcahākārehi ciṇṇavasinā hutvā paguṇadutiyajjhānato vuṭṭhāya

vsm1.4:200.2.verse: ‘‘ayaṃ samāpatti āsannavitakkapaccatthikā, vicārassa oḷārikattā aṅgadubbalā’’ti ca

vsm1.4:200.3.verse: tattha dosaṃ disvā tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ santato manasikaritvā

vsm1.4:200.4.verse: dutiyajjhāne nikantiṃ pariyādāya tatiyādhigamāya yogo kātabbo.

vsm1.4:201.1.verse: Athassa yadā dutiyajjhānato vuṭṭhāya satassa sampajānassa

vsm1.4:201.2.verse: jhānaṅgāni paccavekkhato vicāramattaṃ oḷārikato upaṭṭhāti, pītiādīni santato.

vsm1.4:201.4.verse: tadeva nimittaṃ ‘‘pathavī pathavī’’ti punappunaṃ manasikaroto vuttanayeneva tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ uppajjati.

vsm1.4:201.6.verse: catukkanayassa dutiyajjhāne viya pītiādīni tīṇi samannāgataṅgāni.

vsm1.4:202.2.verse: taṃ dvidhā bhinditvā pañcakanaye dutiyañceva tatiyañca hoti.

vsm1.4:202.3.verse: Yāni ca tattha tatiyacatutthāni, tāni ca catutthapañcamāni honti.

vsm1.4:202.5.verse: Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge Samādhibhāvanādhikāre Pathavīkasiṇaniddeso nāma Catuttho paricchedo.

vsm1.5:1.3.verse: Yatheva hi pathavīkasiṇaṃ, evaṃ āpokasiṇampi bhāvetukāmena

vsm1.5:1.4.verse: sukhanisinnena āpasmiṃ nimittaṃ gaṇhitabbaṃ, kate vā akate vāti

vsm1.5:1.7.verse: Ito parañhi ettakampi avatvā visesamattameva vakkhāma.

vsm1.5:2.2.verse: akate āpasmiṃ pokkharaṇiyā vā taḷāke vā loṇiyaṃ vā samudde vā nimittaṃ uppajjati

vsm1.5:2.4.verse: Tassa kirāyasmato lābhasakkāraṃ pahāya vivittavāsaṃ vasissāmīti

vsm1.5:2.6.verse: antarā mahāsamuddaṃ olokayato tappaṭibhāgaṃ kasiṇanimittaṃ udapādi.

vsm1.5:3.3.verse: yaṃ pana bhūmiṃ asampattameva ākāse suddhavatthena gahitaṃ udakaṃ, aññaṃ vā tathārūpaṃ vippasannaṃ anāvilaṃ, tena pattaṃ vā kuṇḍikaṃ vā samatittikaṃ pūretvā

vsm1.5:3.4.verse: vihārapaccante vuttappakāre paṭicchanne okāse ṭhapetvā sukhanisinnena

vsm1.5:4.1.verse: Tassevaṃ bhāvayato anukkamena vuttanayeneva nimittadvayaṃ uppajjati.

vsm1.5:4.2.verse: Idha pana uggahanimittaṃ calamānaṃ viya upaṭṭhāti,

vsm1.5:4.6.verse: Paṭibhāganimittaṃ pana nipparipphandaṃ ākāse ṭhapitamaṇitālavaṇṭaṃ viya maṇimayādāsamaṇḍalamiva ca hutvā upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.5:4.7.verse: So tassa saha upaṭṭhāneneva upacārajjhānaṃ, vuttanayeneva catukkapañcakajjhānāni ca pāpuṇātīti.

vsm1.5:5.3.verse: akate nimittaṃ gaṇhantassa dīpasikhāya vā uddhane vā pattapacanaṭṭhāne vā davadāhe vā yattha katthaci aggijālaṃ olokentassa nimittaṃ uppajjati

vsm1.5:5.5.verse: Tassa hāyasmato dhammassavanadivase uposathāgāraṃ paviṭṭhassa dīpasikhaṃ olokentasseva nimittaṃ uppajji.

vsm1.5:6.3.verse: siniddhāni sāradārūni phāletvā sukkhāpetvā ghaṭikaṃ ghaṭikaṃ katvā

vsm1.5:6.4.verse: patirūpaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ vā maṇḍapaṃ vā gantvā pattapacanākārena rāsiṃ katvā ālimpetvā

vsm1.5:6.5.verse: kaṭasārake vā camme vā paṭe vā vidatthicaturaṅgulappamāṇaṃ chiddaṃ kātabbaṃ.

vsm1.5:6.7.verse: heṭṭhā tiṇakaṭṭhaṃ vā upari dhūmasikhaṃ vā amanasikaritvā

vsm1.5:7.1.verse: nīlanti vā pītanti vātiādivasena vaṇṇo na paccavekkhitabbo,

vsm1.5:8.1.verse: Tassevaṃ bhāvayato anukkamena vuttanayeneva nimittadvayaṃ uppajjati.

vsm1.5:8.2.verse: Tattha uggahanimittaṃ jālaṃ chijjitvā chijjitvā patanasadisaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.5:8.4.verse: alātakhaṇḍaṃ vā aṅgārapiṇḍo vā chārikā vā dhūmo vā upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.5:8.5.verse: Paṭibhāganimittaṃ niccalaṃ ākāse ṭhapitarattakambalakkhaṇḍaṃ viya suvaṇṇatālavaṇṭaṃ viya kañcanatthambho viya ca upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.5:8.6.verse: So tassa saha upaṭṭhāneneva upacārajjhānaṃ, vuttanayeneva catukkapañcakajjhānāni ca pāpuṇātīti.

vsm1.5:9.2.verse: Tañca kho diṭṭhavasena vā phuṭṭhavasena vā.

vsm1.5:9.6.verse: veḷaggaṃ vā…pe… rukkhaggaṃ vā kesaggaṃ vā eritaṃ sameritaṃ upalakkheti,

vsm1.5:10.1.verse: Tasmā samasīsaṭṭhitaṃ ghanapattaṃ ucchuṃ vā veḷuṃ vā rukkhaṃ vā

vsm1.5:10.4.verse: ‘‘ayaṃ vāto etasmiṃ ṭhāne paharatī’’ti satiṃ ṭhapetvā,

vsm1.5:10.5.verse: yaṃ vā panassa vātapānantarikāya vā bhittichiddena vā pavisitvā vāto kāyappadesaṃ paharati, tattha satiṃ ṭhapetvā

vsm1.5:11.1.verse: Idha uggahanimittavaḍḍhanato otāritamattassa pāyāsassa usumavaṭṭisadisaṃ calaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.5:12.1.verse: Tadanantaraṃ pana nīlakasiṇaṃ uggaṇhanto nīlakasmiṃ nimittaṃ gaṇhāti

vsm1.5:12.2.verse: pupphasmiṃ vā vatthasmiṃ vā vaṇṇadhātuyā vāti vacanato

vsm1.5:12.4.verse: tathārūpaṃ mālāgacchaṃ vā pūjāṭhānesu pupphasantharaṃ vā nīlavatthamaṇīnaṃ vā aññataraṃ disvāva nimittaṃ uppajjati.

vsm1.5:13.2.verse: yathā kesaraṃ vā vaṇṭaṃ vā na paññāyati, evaṃ caṅgoṭakaṃ vā karaṇḍapaṭalaṃ vā pattehiyeva samatittikaṃ pūretvā santharitabbaṃ.

vsm1.5:13.3.verse: Nīlavaṇṇena vā vatthena bhaṇḍikaṃ bandhitvā pūretabbaṃ.

vsm1.5:13.5.verse: Kaṃsanīlapalāsanīlaañjananīlānaṃ vā aññatarena dhātunā pathavīkasiṇe vuttanayena saṃhārimaṃ vā bhittiyaṃyeva vā kasiṇamaṇḍalaṃ katvā

vsm1.5:13.7.verse: Tato pathavīkasiṇe vuttanayena ‘‘nīlaṃ nīla’’nti manasikāro pavattetabbo.

vsm1.5:14.3.verse: Paṭibhāganimittaṃ kasiṇamaṇḍalato muñcitvā ākāse maṇitālavaṇṭasadisaṃ upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.5:15.2.verse: Vuttañhetaṃ pītakasiṇaṃ uggaṇhanto pītakasmiṃ nimittaṃ gaṇhāti

vsm1.5:15.3.verse: pupphasmiṃ vā vatthasmiṃ vā vaṇṇadhātuyā vāti.

vsm1.5:15.5.verse: tathārūpaṃ mālāgacchaṃ vā pupphasantharaṃ vā pītavatthadhātūnaṃ vā aññataraṃ disvāva nimittaṃ uppajjati

vsm1.5:15.7.verse: Tassa kirāyasmato cittalapabbate pattaṅgapupphehi kataṃ āsanapūjaṃ passato

vsm1.5:16.1.verse: Itarena kaṇikārapupphādinā vā pītavatthena vā dhātunā vā nīlakasiṇe vuttanayeneva kasiṇaṃ katvā

vsm1.5:17.2.verse: Vuttañhetaṃ lohitakasiṇaṃ uggaṇhanto lohitakasmiṃ nimittaṃ gaṇhāti

vsm1.5:17.3.verse: pupphasmiṃ vā vatthasmiṃ vā vaṇṇadhātuyā vāti.

vsm1.5:17.5.verse: tathārūpaṃ bandhujīvakādimālāgacchaṃ vā pupphasantharaṃ vā lohitakavatthamaṇidhātūnaṃ vā aññataraṃ disvāva nimittaṃ uppajjati.

vsm1.5:18.1.verse: Itarena jayasumanabandhujīvakarattakoraṇḍakādipupphehi vā rattavatthena vā dhātunā vā nīlakasiṇe vuttanayeneva kasiṇaṃ katvā

vsm1.5:19.1.verse: Odātakasiṇepi odātakasiṇaṃ uggaṇhanto odātasmiṃ nimittaṃ gaṇhāti

vsm1.5:19.2.verse: pupphasmiṃ vā vatthasmiṃ vā vaṇṇadhātuyā vāti vacanato

vsm1.5:19.4.verse: tathārūpaṃ mālāgacchaṃ vā vassikasumanādipupphasantharaṃ vā kumudapadumarāsiṃ vā odātavatthadhātūnaṃ vā aññataraṃ disvāva nimittaṃ uppajjati,

vsm1.5:20.1.verse: Itarena vuttappakārehi odātapupphehi vā odātavatthena vā dhātunā vā nīlakasiṇe vuttanayeneva kasiṇaṃ katvā

vsm1.5:21.1.verse: Ālokakasiṇe pana ālokakasiṇaṃ uggaṇhanto ālokasmiṃ nimittaṃ gaṇhāti

vsm1.5:21.2.verse: bhittichidde vā tāḷacchidde vā vātapānantarikāya vāti vacanato

vsm1.5:21.4.verse: yaṃ bhittichiddādīnaṃ aññatarena sūriyāloko vā candāloko vā pavisitvā bhittiyaṃ vā bhūmiyaṃ vā maṇḍalaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti,

vsm1.5:21.5.verse: ghanapaṇṇarukkhasākhantarena vā ghanasākhāmaṇḍapantarena vā nikkhamitvā bhūmiyameva maṇḍalaṃ samuṭṭhāpeti, taṃ disvāva nimittaṃ uppajjati.

vsm1.5:22.4.verse: ghaṭamukhaṃ pidahitvā ghaṭe chiddaṃ katvā bhittimukhaṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.5:22.5.verse: Tena chiddena dīpāloko nikkhamitvā bhittiyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ karoti,

vsm1.5:23.1.verse: Idha uggahanimittaṃ bhittiyaṃ vā bhūmiyaṃ vā uṭṭhitamaṇḍalasadisameva hoti.

vsm1.5:24.1.verse: Paricchinnākāsakasiṇepi ākāsakasiṇaṃ uggaṇhanto ākāsasmiṃ nimittaṃ gaṇhāti

vsm1.5:24.2.verse: bhittichidde vā tāḷacchidde vā vātapānantarikāya vāti vacanato

vsm1.5:25.1.verse: Itarena succhannamaṇḍape vā cammakaṭasārakādīnaṃ vā aññatarasmiṃ vidatthicaturaṅgulappamāṇaṃ chiddaṃ katvā

vsm1.5:25.2.verse: tadeva vā bhittichiddādibhedaṃ chiddaṃ ‘‘ākāso ākāso’’ti bhāvetabbaṃ.

vsm1.5:26.1.verse: Idha uggahanimittaṃ saddhiṃ bhittipariyantādīhi chiddasadisameva hoti,

vsm1.5:27.2.verse:
Evaṃ tāni ca tesañca,
Bhāvanānayamimaṃ viditvāna;
Tesveva ayaṃ bhiyyo,
Pakiṇṇakakathāpi viññeyyā.

vsm1.5:28.1.verse: Imesu hi pathavīkasiṇavasena ekopi hutvā bahudhā hotītiādibhāvo,

vsm1.5:28.2.verse: ākāse vā udake vā pathaviṃ nimminitvā padasā gamanaṃ, ṭhānanisajjādikappanaṃ vā,

vsm1.5:30.2.verse: tejasā tejopariyādānaṃ, yadeva so icchati tassa ḍahanasamatthatā,

vsm1.5:35.3.verse: dibbena cakkhunā rūpadassanatthāya ālokakaraṇanti evamādīni ijjhanti.

vsm1.5:36.3.verse: dibbena cakkhunā rūpadassanatthaṃ ālokakaraṇanti evamādīni ijjhanti.

vsm1.5:38.1.verse: Sabbāneva uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇanti imaṃ pabhedaṃ labhanti.

vsm1.5:39.4.verse: Ekacco hi uddhameva kasiṇaṃ vaḍḍheti, ekacco adho, ekacco samantato.

vsm1.5:39.5.verse: Tena tena vā kāraṇena evaṃ pasāreti.

vsm1.5:39.8.verse: Advayanti idaṃ pana ekassa aññabhāvānupagamanatthaṃ vuttaṃ.

vsm1.5:39.9.verse: Yathā hi udakaṃ paviṭṭhassa sabbadisāsu udakameva hoti, na aññaṃ,

vsm1.5:39.15.verse: Na ayamassa ādi idaṃ majjhanti pamāṇaṃ gaṇhātīti.

vsm1.5:40.1.verse: Ye ca te sattā kammāvaraṇena vā samannāgatā kilesāvaraṇena vā samannāgatā vipākāvaraṇena vā samannāgatā

vsm1.5:40.3.verse: abhabbā niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattanti vuttā, tesamekassāpekakasiṇepi bhāvanā na ijjhati.

vsm1.5:41.2.verse: Kilesāvaraṇena samannāgatāti niyatamicchādiṭṭhikā ceva ubhatobyañjanakapaṇḍakā ca.

vsm1.5:41.8.verse: kusalesu dhammesu niyāmasaṅkhātaṃ sammattasaṅkhātañca ariyamaggaṃ okkamituṃ abhabbāti attho.

vsm1.5:42.1.verse: Na kevalañca kasiṇeyeva, aññesupi kammaṭṭhānesu etesamekassapi bhāvanā na ijjhati.

vsm1.5:42.4.verse: saddhammassavanasappurisūpanissayādīhi saddhañca chandañca paññañca vaḍḍhetvā kammaṭṭhānānuyoge yogo karaṇīyoti.

vsm1.5:42.5.verse: Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge Samādhibhāvanādhikāre Sesakasiṇaniddeso nāma Pañcamo paricchedo.

vsm1.6:1.3.verse: vikkhittakaṃ, hatavikkhittakaṃ, lohitakaṃ, puḷavakaṃ, aṭṭhikanti dasasu aviññāṇakāsubhesu

vsm1.6:1.4.verse: bhastā viya vāyunā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā yathānukkamaṃ samuggatena sūnabhāvena uddhumātattā uddhumātaṃ,

vsm1.6:5.1.verse: Ito ca etto ca vividhākārena soṇasiṅgālādīhi khāditanti vikkhāyitaṃ,

vsm1.6:6.4.verse: Aññena hatthaṃ aññena pādaṃ aññena sīsanti evaṃ tato tato khittassa chavasarīrassetamadhivacanaṃ.

vsm1.6:7.2.verse: Kākapadākārena aṅgapaccaṅgesu satthena hanitvā vuttanayena vikkhittassa chavasarīrassetamadhivacanaṃ.

vsm1.6:8.1.verse: Lohitaṃ kirati vikkhipati ito cito ca paggharatīti lohitakaṃ.

vsm1.6:9.1.verse: Puḷavā vuccanti kimayo, puḷave kiratīti puḷavakaṃ.

vsm1.6:11.1.verse: Imāni ca pana uddhumātakādīni nissāya uppannanimittānampi

vsm1.6:12.1.verse: Tattha uddhumātakasarīre uddhumātakanimittaṃ uppādetvā uddhumātakasaṅkhātaṃ jhānaṃ bhāvetukāmena yoginā

vsm1.6:13.1.verse: Evaṃ viharantena ca asukasmiṃ nāma gāmadvāre vā aṭavimukhe vā panthe vā

vsm1.6:13.2.verse: pabbatapāde vā rukkhamūle vā susāne vā uddhumātakasarīraṃ nikkhittanti kathentānaṃ vacanaṃ sutvāpi

vsm1.6:13.3.verse: na tāvadeva atitthena pakkhandantena viya gantabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:14.2.verse: Asubhaṃ hi nāmetaṃ vāḷamigādhiṭṭhitampi amanussādhiṭṭhitampi hoti,

vsm1.6:14.4.verse: Gamanamaggo vā panettha gāmadvārena vā nahānatitthena vā kedārakoṭiyā vā hoti,

vsm1.6:14.7.verse: Purisassa hi itthisarīraṃ itthiyā ca purisasarīraṃ visabhāgaṃ,

vsm1.6:14.10.verse: Sace pana ‘‘nayidaṃ mādisassa bhāriya’’nti attānaṃ takkayati, evaṃ takkayamānena gantabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:15.1.verse: Gacchantena ca saṅghattherassa vā aññatarassa vā abhiññātassa bhikkhuno kathetvā gantabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:16.2.verse: Sace hissa susāne amanussasīhabyagghādīnaṃ rūpasaddādianiṭṭhārammaṇābhibhūtassa aṅgapaccaṅgāni vā pavedhenti, bhuttaṃ vā na parisaṇṭhāti,

vsm1.6:16.4.verse: athassa so vihāre pattacīvaraṃ surakkhitaṃ karissati.

vsm1.6:16.5.verse: Dahare vā sāmaṇere vā pahiṇitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ paṭijaggissati.

vsm1.6:17.1.verse: Apica susānaṃ nāma nirāsaṅkaṭṭhānanti maññamānā katakammāpi akatakammāpi corā samosaranti.

vsm1.6:17.2.verse: Te manussehi anubaddhā bhikkhussa samīpe bhaṇḍakaṃ chaḍḍetvāpi palāyanti.

vsm1.6:17.3.verse: Manussā ‘‘sahoḍḍhaṃ coraṃ addasāmā’’ti bhikkhuṃ gahetvā viheṭhenti.

vsm1.6:17.4.verse: Athassa so ‘‘mā imaṃ viheṭhayittha, mamāyaṃ kathetvā iminā nāma kammena gato’’ti te manusse saññāpetvā

vsm1.6:18.5.verse: adhano vā pana nidhiṭṭhānaṃ pītisomanassajāto gacchati,

vsm1.6:18.6.verse: evaṃ pītisomanassaṃ uppādetvā aṭṭhakathāsu vuttena vidhinā gantabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:19.8.verse: Yasmiṃ padese uddhumātakaṃ asubhanimittaṃ nikkhittaṃ hoti,

vsm1.6:19.9.verse: tasmiṃ padese pāsāṇaṃ vā vammikaṃ vā rukkhaṃ vā gacchaṃ vā lataṃ vā sanimittaṃ karoti,

vsm1.6:19.13.verse: vaṇṇatopi liṅgatopi saṇṭhānatopi disatopi okāsatopi paricchedatopi sandhito vivarato ninnato thalato samantato. So taṃ nimittaṃ suggahitaṃ karoti, sūpadhāritaṃ upadhāreti, suvavatthitaṃ vavatthapeti.

vsm1.6:20.1.verse: So taṃ nimittaṃ suggahitaṃ katvā sūpadhāritaṃ upadhāretvā suvavatthitaṃ vavatthapetvā

vsm1.6:22.1.verse: “So ānisaṃsadassāvī ratanasaññī hutvā cittīkāraṃ upaṭṭhapetvā sampiyāyamāno

vsm1.6:22.4.verse: So vivicceva kāmehi…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

vsm1.6:23.1.verse: Tasmā yo cittasaññattatthāya sivathikadassanaṃ gacchati, so ghaṇḍiṃ paharitvā gaṇaṃ sannipātetvāpi gacchatu.

vsm1.6:23.5.verse: susāne soṇādiparissayavinodanatthaṃ kattaradaṇḍaṃ vā yaṭṭhiṃ vā gahetvā,

vsm1.6:23.7.verse: manacchaṭṭhānañca indriyānaṃ antogatabhāvasampādanato abahigatamanena hutvā gantabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:24.1.verse: Vihārato nikkhamanteneva asukadisāya asukadvārena nikkhantomhīti dvāraṃ sallakkhetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:24.2.verse: Tato yena maggena gacchati, so maggo vavatthapetabbo,

vsm1.6:24.3.verse: ayaṃ maggo pācinadisābhimukho vā gacchati, pacchimauttaradakkhiṇadisābhimukho vā

vsm1.6:24.5.verse: Imasmiṃ pana ṭhāne vāmato gacchati, imasmiṃ ṭhāne dakkhiṇato,

vsm1.6:24.6.verse: imasmiṃ cassa ṭhāne pāsāṇo, imasmiṃ vammiko, imasmiṃ rukkho, imasmiṃ gaccho, imasmiṃ latāti.

vsm1.6:25.2.verse: Paṭivātaṃ gacchantassa hi kuṇapagandho ghānaṃ paharitvā

vsm1.6:25.5.verse: vippaṭisāraṃ vā janeyya ‘‘īdisaṃ nāma kuṇapaṭṭhānaṃ āgatomhī’’ti.

vsm1.6:25.7.verse: Sace anuvātamaggena na sakkā hoti gantuṃ,

vsm1.6:25.8.verse: antarā pabbato vā papāto vā pāsāṇo vā vati vā kaṇṭakaṭṭhānaṃ vā udakaṃ vā cikkhallaṃ vā hoti,

vsm1.6:26.1.verse: Evaṃ gatena pana na tāva asubhanimittaṃ oloketabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:26.3.verse: Ekasmiṃ hi disābhāge ṭhitassa ārammaṇañca na vibhūtaṃ hutvā khāyati, cittañca na kammaniyaṃ hoti.

vsm1.6:26.4.verse: Tasmā taṃ vajjetvā yattha ṭhitassa ārammaṇañca vibhūtaṃ hutvā khāyati, cittañca kammaniyaṃ hoti, tattha ṭhātabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:26.6.verse: Paṭivāte ṭhitassa hi kuṇapagandhena ubbāḷhassa cittaṃ vidhāvati.

vsm1.6:26.7.verse: Anuvāte ṭhitassa sace tattha adhivatthā amanussā honti, te kujjhitvā anatthaṃ karonti.

vsm1.6:27.1.verse: Evaṃ tiṭṭhamānenāpi nātidūre nāccāsanne nānupādaṃ nānusīsaṃ ṭhātabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:27.2.verse: Atidūre ṭhitassa hi ārammaṇaṃ avibhūtaṃ hoti.

vsm1.6:27.4.verse: Anupādaṃ vā anusīsaṃ vā ṭhitassa sabbaṃ asubhaṃ samaṃ na paññāyati.

vsm1.6:27.5.verse: Tasmā nātidūre nāccāsanne olokentassa phāsukaṭṭhāne sarīravemajjhabhāge ṭhātabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:28.1.verse: Evaṃ ṭhitena ‘‘tasmiṃ padese pāsāṇaṃ vā…pe… lataṃ vā sanimittaṃ karotī’’ti evaṃ vuttāni samantā nimittāni upalakkhetabbāni.

vsm1.6:29.2.verse: sace tassa nimittassa samantā cakkhupathe pāsāṇo hoti,

vsm1.6:29.3.verse: so ‘‘ayaṃ pāsāṇo ucco vā nīco vā khuddako vā mahanto vā tambo vā kāḷo vā seto vā dīgho vā parimaṇḍalo vā’’ti vavatthapetabbo.

vsm1.6:29.4.verse: Tato ‘‘imasmiṃ nāma okāse ayaṃ pāsāṇo idaṃ asubhanimittaṃ,

vsm1.6:30.2.verse: sopi ‘‘ucco vā nīco vā khuddako vā mahanto vā tambo vā kāḷo vā seto vā dīgho vā parimaṇḍalo vā’’ti vavatthapetabbo.

vsm1.6:30.3.verse: Tato ‘‘imasmiṃ nāma okāse ayaṃ vammiko idaṃ asubhanimitta’’nti sallakkhetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:31.2.verse: sopi ‘‘assattho vā nigrodho vā kacchako vā kapītano vā

vsm1.6:31.3.verse: ucco vā nīco vā khuddako vā mahanto vā tambo vā kāḷo vā seto vā’’ti vavatthapetabbo.

vsm1.6:31.4.verse: Tato ‘‘imasmiṃ nāma okāse ayaṃ rukkho idaṃ asubhanimitta’’nti sallakkhetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:32.2.verse: sopi ‘‘sindivā karamando vā kaṇavīro vā kuraṇḍako vā

vsm1.6:32.3.verse: ucco vā nīco vā khuddako vā mahanto vā’’ti vavatthapetabbo.

vsm1.6:32.4.verse: Tato ‘‘imasmiṃ nāma okāse ayaṃ gaccho idaṃ asubhanimitta’’nti sallakkhetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:33.2.verse: sāpi ‘‘lābu vā kumbhaṇḍī vā sāmā vā kāḷavalli vā pūtilatā vā’’ti vavatthapetabbā.

vsm1.6:33.3.verse: Tato ‘‘imasmiṃ nāma okāse ayaṃ latā idaṃ asubhanimittaṃ,

vsm1.6:34.1.verse: Yaṃ pana vuttaṃ sanimittaṃ karoti sārammaṇaṃ karotīti, taṃ idheva antogadhaṃ.

vsm1.6:34.2.verse: Punappunaṃ vavatthapento hi sanimittaṃ karoti nāma.

vsm1.6:34.4.verse: idaṃ asubhanimittaṃ ayaṃ pāsāṇoti evaṃ dve dve samāsetvā samāsetvā vavatthapento sārammaṇaṃ karoti nāma.

vsm1.6:35.2.verse: sabhāvabhāvato vavatthapetīti vuttattā yvāssa sabhāvabhāvo anaññasādhāraṇo attaniyo uddhumātakabhāvo, tena manasikātabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:35.3.verse: Vaṇitaṃ uddhumātakanti evaṃ sabhāvena sarasena vavatthapetabbanti attho.

vsm1.6:35.6.verse: disatopi okāsatopi paricchedatopīti chabbidhena nimittaṃ gahetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:36.1.verse: Tena hi yoginā idaṃ sarīraṃ kāḷassa vā odātassa vā maṅguracchavino vāti vaṇṇato vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:37.1.verse: Liṅgato pana itthiliṅgaṃ vā purisaliṅgaṃ vāti avavatthapetvā

vsm1.6:37.2.verse: paṭhamavaye vā majjhimavaye vā pacchimavaye vā ṭhitassa idaṃ sarīranti vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:38.2.verse: idamassa sīsasaṇṭhānaṃ, idaṃ gīvāsaṇṭhānaṃ, idaṃ hatthasaṇṭhānaṃ,

vsm1.6:38.4.verse: idaṃ kaṭisaṇṭhānaṃ, idaṃ ūrusaṇṭhānaṃ, idaṃ jaṅghāsaṇṭhānaṃ, idaṃ pādasaṇṭhānanti vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:39.2.verse: imasmiṃ sarīre dve disā nābhiyā adho heṭṭhimadisā

vsm1.6:39.4.verse: Atha vā ahaṃ imissā disāya ṭhito asubhanimittaṃ imissāti vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:40.2.verse: imasmiṃ nāma okāse hatthā, imasmiṃ pādā, imasmiṃ sīsaṃ, imasmiṃ majjhimakāyo ṭhitoti vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:40.3.verse: Atha vā ahaṃ imasmiṃ okāse ṭhito asubhanimittaṃ imasminti vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:41.2.verse: idaṃ sarīraṃ adho pādatalena upari kesamatthakena tiriyaṃ tacena paricchinnaṃ,

vsm1.6:41.7.verse: Yattakaṃ vā pana ṭhānaṃ gaṇhati, tattakameva idaṃ īdisaṃ uddhumātakanti paricchinditabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:42.1.verse: Purisassa pana itthisarīraṃ itthiyā vā purisasarīraṃ na vaṭṭati.

vsm1.6:42.4.verse: ‘‘Ugghāṭitāpi hi itthī purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’’ti (a. ni. 5.55) majjhimaṭṭhakathāyaṃ vuttaṃ.

vsm1.6:42.5.verse: Tasmā sabhāgasarīreyeva evaṃ chabbidhena nimittaṃ gaṇhitabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:43.1.verse: Yo pana purimabuddhānaṃ santike āsevitakammaṭṭhāno parihatadhutaṅgo

vsm1.6:43.6.verse: No ce evaṃ upaṭṭhāti, athevaṃ chabbidhena nimittaṃ gaṇhato upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.6:44.2.verse: tena sandhito vivarato ninnato thalato samantatoti punapi pañcavidhena nimittaṃ gahetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:45.5.verse: eko gīvasandhi, eko kaṭisandhīti evaṃ cuddasamahāsandhivasena sandhito vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:46.2.verse: vivaraṃ nāma hatthantaraṃ pādantaraṃ udarantaraṃ kaṇṇantaranti

vsm1.6:46.4.verse: Akkhīnampi nimmīlitabhāvo vā ummīlitabhāvo vā mukhassa ca pihitabhāvo vā vivaṭabhāvo vā vavatthapetabbo.

vsm1.6:47.2.verse: yaṃ sarīre ninnaṭṭhānaṃ akkhikūpo vā antomukhaṃ vā galavāṭako vā, taṃ vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:47.3.verse: Atha vā ahaṃ ninne ṭhito sarīraṃ unnateti vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:48.1.verse: Thalatoti yaṃ sarīre unnataṭṭhānaṃ jaṇṇukaṃ vā uro vā nalāṭaṃ vā, taṃ vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:48.2.verse: Atha vā ahaṃ thale ṭhito sarīraṃ ninneti vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:49.3.verse: yaṃ ṭhānaṃ vibhūtaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhāti, tattha ‘‘uddhumātakaṃ uddhumātaka’’nti cittaṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:50.1.verse: Idāni ‘‘so taṃ nimittaṃ suggahitaṃ karotī’’tiādīsu ayaṃ vinicchayakathā –

vsm1.6:50.2.verse: Tena yoginā tasmiṃ sarīre yathāvuttanimittaggāhavasena suṭṭhu nimittaṃ gaṇhitabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:50.4.verse: Evaṃ punappunaṃ karontena sādhukaṃ upadhāretabbañceva vavatthapetabbañca.

vsm1.6:50.5.verse: Sarīrato nātidūre nāccāsanne padese ṭhitena vā nisinnena vā cakkhuṃ ummīletvā oloketvā nimittaṃ gaṇhitabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:51.1.verse: Evaṃ punappunaṃ karontassa uggahanimittaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti.

vsm1.6:51.3.verse: Yadā ummīletvā olokentassa nimmīletvā āvajjentassa ca ekasadisaṃ hutvā āpāthamāgacchati,
