vsm1.6:52.1.verse: So taṃ nimittaṃ evaṃ suggahitaṃ katvā sūpadhāritaṃ upadhāretvā suvavatthitaṃ vavatthapetvā

vsm1.6:52.2.verse: sace tattheva bhāvanāpariyosānaṃ pattuṃ na sakkoti,

vsm1.6:52.4.verse: tadeva kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasikarontena sūpaṭṭhitaṃ satiṃ katvā

vsm1.6:52.5.verse: antogatehi indriyehi abahigatena mānasena attano senāsanameva gantabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:53.2.verse: yena maggena nikkhantosmi, ayaṃ maggo pācīnadisābhimukho vā gacchati, pacchimauttaradakkhiṇadisābhimukho vā gacchati,

vsm1.6:53.4.verse: Imasmiṃ pana ṭhāne vāmato gacchati, imasmiṃ dakkhiṇato,

vsm1.6:53.5.verse: imasmiṃ cassa ṭhāne pāsāṇo, imasmiṃ vammiko, imasmiṃ rukkho, imasmiṃ gaccho, imasmiṃ latāti

vsm1.6:55.1.verse: Sace pana tassaṃ disāyaṃ sobbho vā papāto vā rukkho vā vati vā kalalaṃ vā hoti,

vsm1.6:55.4.verse: Taṃ disaṃ anapalokentenāpi okāsānurūpe ṭhāne caṅkamitabbañceva nisīditabbañca.

vsm1.6:56.4.verse: samantā nimittupalakkhaṇaṃ katvā nimittaggahaṇatthaṃ cakkhuṃ ummīletvā

vsm1.6:56.5.verse: olokentasseva taṃ matasarīraṃ uṭṭhahitvā ṭhitaṃ viya

vsm1.6:56.6.verse: ajjhottharamānaṃ viya anubandhamānaṃ viya ca hutvā upaṭṭhāti,

vsm1.6:56.10.verse: Pāḷiyaṃ hi vibhattaaṭṭhatiṃsārammaṇesu aññaṃ evarūpaṃ bheravārammaṇaṃ nāma natthi.

vsm1.6:56.11.verse: Imasmiṃ hi kammaṭṭhāne jhānavibbhantako nāma hoti.

vsm1.6:57.4.verse: Sace hi so ‘‘etassa samīpe ṭhito pāsāṇo vā latā vā āgaccheyya, sarīrampi āgaccheyya.

vsm1.6:57.5.verse: Yathā pana so pāsāṇo vā latā vā nāgacchati, evaṃ sarīrampi nāgacchati.

vsm1.6:57.6.verse: Ayaṃ pana tuyhaṃ upaṭṭhānākāro saññajo saññāsambhavo,

vsm1.6:57.9.verse: tāsaṃ vinodetvā hāsaṃ uppādetvā tasmiṃ nimitte cittaṃ sañcarāpetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:58.1.verse: Ekādasavidhena pana nimittaggāhaṃ sampādento kammaṭṭhānaṃ upanibandhati.

vsm1.6:58.2.verse: Tassa hi cakkhūni ummīletvā olokanapaccayā uggahanimittaṃ uppajjati.

vsm1.6:58.5.verse: Appanāyaṃ ṭhatvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhento arahattaṃ sacchikaroti.

vsm1.6:59.2.verse: yā gatamaggassa ca āgatamaggassa ca paccavekkhaṇā vuttā,

vsm1.6:60.1.verse: Sace hi imaṃ bhikkhuṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā āgacchantaṃ antarāmagge

vsm1.6:60.2.verse: keci ajja, bhante, katimīti divasaṃ vā pucchanti,

vsm1.6:60.5.verse: ahaṃ kammaṭṭhānikoti tuṇhībhūtena gantuṃ na vaṭṭati.

vsm1.6:60.7.verse: Sace na jānāti, na jānāmīti vattabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:60.12.verse: Jānantena ekadesena kathetumpi vaṭṭati, paṭisanthāropi kātabbo.

vsm1.6:60.13.verse: Āgantukaṃ pana bhikkhuṃ disvā āgantukapaṭisanthāro kātabbova.

vsm1.6:61.1.verse: Tassa tāni pūrentassāpi taṃ taruṇanimittaṃ nassati,

vsm1.6:61.3.verse: amanussehi vā vāḷamigehi vā adhiṭṭhitattā susānampi gantuṃ na sakkā hoti,

vsm1.6:61.5.verse: Uddhumātakaṃ hi ekameva vā dve vā divase ṭhatvā vinīlakādibhāvaṃ gacchati.

vsm1.6:61.6.verse: Sabbakammaṭṭhānesu etena samaṃ dullabhaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ nāma natthi.

vsm1.6:62.2.verse: tena bhikkhunā rattiṭṭhāne vā divāṭhāne vā nisīditvā …

vsm1.6:62.3.verse: evaṃ yāva pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā nisinnaṭṭhānaṃ, tāva gatāgatamaggo paccavekkhitabbo:

vsm1.6:62.4.verse: ahaṃ iminā nāma dvārena vihārā nikkhamitvā

vsm1.6:62.8.verse: Tassa asukasmiṃ ṭhāne pāsāṇo, asukasmiṃ vammikarukkhagacchalatānamaññataraṃ.

vsm1.6:62.9.verse: Sohaṃ tena maggena gantvā asukasmiṃ nāma ṭhāne asubhaṃ addasaṃ.

vsm1.6:62.14.verse: evarūpena nāma maggena idañcidañca karonto āgantvā

vsm1.6:63.1.verse: Tassevaṃ paccavekkhato taṃ nimittaṃ pākaṭaṃ hoti, purato nikkhittaṃ viya upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.6:64.1.verse: Idāni ānisaṃsadassāvī ratanasaññī hutvā cittīkāraṃ upaṭṭhapetvā sampiyāyamāno tasmiṃ ārammaṇe cittaṃ upanibandhatīti ettha

vsm1.6:64.4.verse: ‘‘addhā imāya paṭipadāya jarāmaraṇamhā parimuccissāmī’’ti evaṃ ānisaṃsadassāvinā bhavitabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:65.1.verse: Yathā pana duggato puriso mahagghaṃ maṇiratanaṃ labhitvā

vsm1.6:65.2.verse: dullabhaṃ vata me laddhanti tasmiṃ ratanasaññī hutvā gāravaṃ janetvā vipulena pemena sampiyāyamāno taṃ rakkheyya,

vsm1.6:65.3.verse: evameva … tasmiṃ ratanasaññinā hutvā cittīkāraṃ upaṭṭhapetvā sampiyāyamānena taṃ nimittaṃ rakkhitabbaṃ:

vsm1.6:65.4.verse: ‘‘dullabhaṃ me idaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ laddhaṃ duggatassa mahagghamaṇiratanasadisaṃ.

vsm1.6:65.5.verse: Catudhātukammaṭṭhāniko hi attano cattāro mahābhūte pariggaṇhāti,

vsm1.6:65.9.verse: ‘Idaṃ pana ekameva vā dve vā divase tiṭṭhati, tato paraṃ vinīlakādibhāvaṃ pāpuṇātī’ti

vsm1.6:65.13.verse: Punappunaṃ taṃ nimittaṃ āvajjitabbaṃ, manasikātabbaṃ. Takkāhataṃ vitakkāhataṃ kātabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:66.3.verse: uggahanimittaṃ virūpaṃ bībhacchaṃ bheravadassanaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.6:66.4.verse: Paṭibhāganimittaṃ pana yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjitvā nipanno thūlaṅgapaccaṅgapuriso viya.

vsm1.6:67.2.verse: bahiddhā kāmānaṃ amanasikārā vikkhambhanavasena kāmacchando pahīyati.

vsm1.6:67.3.verse: Anunayappahāneneva cassa lohitappahānena pubbo viya byāpādopi pahīyati.

vsm1.6:67.6.verse: adhigatavisesassa paccakkhatāya paṭipattidesake satthari paṭipattiyaṃ paṭipattiphale ca vicikicchā pahīyati,

vsm1.6:67.8.verse: Tasmiññeva ca nimitte cetaso abhiniropanalakkhaṇo vitakko,

vsm1.6:68.2.verse: Ito paraṃ yāva paṭhamajjhānassa appanā ceva vasippatti ca, tāva sabbaṃ pathavīkasiṇe vuttanayeneva veditabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:69.2.verse: yaṃ taṃ ‘‘uddhumātakaṃ asubhanimittaṃ uggaṇhanto eko adutiyo gacchati upaṭṭhitāya satiyā’’tiādinā nayena gamanaṃ ādiṃ katvā lakkhaṇaṃ vuttaṃ,

vsm1.6:69.3.verse: taṃ sabbaṃ ‘‘vinīlakaṃ asubhanimittaṃ uggaṇhanto, vipubbakaṃ asubhanimittaṃ uggaṇhanto’’ti evaṃ tassa tassa vasena tattha tattha uddhumātakapadamattaṃ parivattetvā vuttanayeneva savinicchayādhippāyaṃ veditabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:72.1.verse: Vicchiddakaṃ yuddhamaṇḍale vā corāṭaviyaṃ vā susāne vā yattha rājāno core chindāpenti.

vsm1.6:72.2.verse: Araññe vā pana sīhabyagghehi chinnapurisaṭṭhāne labbhati.

vsm1.6:72.3.verse: Tasmā tathārūpaṃ ṭhānaṃ gantvā sace nānādisāyaṃ patitampi ekāvajjanena āpāthamāgacchati iccetaṃ kusalaṃ.

vsm1.6:72.4.verse: No ce āgacchati, sayaṃ hatthena na parāmasitabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:72.6.verse: Tasmā ārāmikena vā samaṇuddesena vā aññena vā kenaci ekaṭṭhāne kāretabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:72.8.verse: kattarayaṭṭhiyā vā daṇḍakena vā ekaṅgulantaraṃ katvā upanāmetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:72.10.verse: Tattha uggahanimittaṃ majjhe chiddaṃ viya upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.6:73.2.verse: Uggahanimittaṃ panettha tahiṃ tahiṃ khāyitasadisameva upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.6:74.1.verse: Vikkhittakampi vicchiddake vuttanayeneva aṅgulaṅgulantaraṃ kāretvā vā katvā vā

vsm1.6:75.2.verse: Tasmā tattha gantvā vuttanayeneva aṅgulaṅgulantaraṃ kāretvā vā katvā vā

vsm1.6:75.4.verse: Uggahanimittaṃ panettha paññāyamānaṃ pahāramukhaṃ viya hoti.

vsm1.6:76.1.verse: Lohitakaṃ yuddhamaṇḍalādīsu laddhappahārānaṃ hatthapādādīsu vā chinnesu bhinnagaṇḍapīḷakādīnaṃ vā mukhato paggharamānakāle labbhati.

vsm1.6:76.2.verse: Tasmā taṃ disvā ‘‘lohitakapaṭikkūlaṃ lohitakapaṭikkūla’’nti manasikāro pavattetabbo.

vsm1.6:76.3.verse: Ettha uggahanimittaṃ vātappahatā viya rattapaṭākā calamānākāraṃ upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.6:77.1.verse: Puḷavakaṃ dvīhatīhaccayena kuṇapassa navahi vaṇamukhehi kimirāsipaggharaṇakāle hoti.

vsm1.6:77.2.verse: Apica taṃ soṇasiṅgālamanussagomahiṃsahatthiassaajagarādīnaṃ sarīrappamāṇameva hutvā sālibhattarāsi viya tiṭṭhati.

vsm1.6:77.3.verse: Tesu yattha katthaci ‘‘puḷavakapaṭikkūlaṃ puḷavakapaṭikkūla’’nti manasikāro pavattetabbo.

vsm1.6:77.4.verse: Cūḷapiṇḍapātikatissattherassa hi kāḷadīghavāpiyā anto hatthikuṇape nimittaṃ upaṭṭhāsi.

vsm1.6:77.6.verse: Paṭibhāganimittaṃ sālibhattapiṇḍo viya sannisinnaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.6:78.1.verse: Aṭṭhikaṃ ‘‘seyyathāpi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhisaṅkhalikaṃ samaṃsalohitaṃ nahārusambandha’’ntiādinā (ma. ni. 3.154) nayena nānappakārato vuttaṃ.

vsm1.6:78.2.verse: Tattha yattha taṃ nikkhittaṃ hoti, tattha purimanayeneva gantvā

vsm1.6:78.3.verse: samantā pāsāṇādīnaṃ vasena sanimittaṃ sārammaṇaṃ katvā
Taṃ pana vaṇṇato setanti olokentassa na upaṭṭhāti,

vsm1.6:79.5.verse: Tassa tassa aṭṭhino pariyantavasena paricchedato vavatthapetvā

vsm1.6:79.6.verse: yadevettha pākaṭaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhāti, taṃ gahetvā appanā pāpuṇitabbā.

vsm1.6:79.7.verse: Tassa tassa aṭṭhino ninnaṭṭhānathalaṭṭhānavasena pana ninnato ca thalato ca vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:79.11.verse: Dvinnaṃ pana aṭṭhikānaṃ ghaṭitaghaṭitaṭṭhānavasena sandhito vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:79.13.verse: Sabbattheva pana ñāṇaṃ cāretvā imasmiṃ ṭhāne idamaṭṭhīti samantato vavatthapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:79.14.verse: Evampi nimitte anupaṭṭhahante nalāṭaṭṭhimhi cittaṃ saṇṭhapetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:79.16.verse: evaṃ idaṃ ekādasavidhena nimittaggahaṇaṃ ito purimesu puḷavakādīsupi yujjamānavasena sallakkhetabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:80.1.verse: Idañca pana kammaṭṭhānaṃ sakalāyapi aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikāya ekasmimpi aṭṭhike sampajjati.

vsm1.6:80.2.verse: Tasmā tesu yatthakatthaci ekādasavidhena nimittaṃ uggahetvā

vsm1.6:80.4.verse: Idha uggahanimittampi paṭibhāganimittampi ekasadisameva hotīti vuttaṃ,

vsm1.6:80.8.verse: Ekaṭṭhikepi ca uggahanimittena bībhacchena bhayānakena bhavitabbaṃ.

vsm1.6:81.1.verse: Imasmiṃ hi okāse yaṃ aṭṭhakathāsu vuttaṃ, taṃ dvāraṃ datvāva vuttaṃ.

vsm1.6:81.2.verse: Tathā hi tattha ‘‘catūsu brahmavihāresu dasasu ca asubhesu paṭibhāganimittaṃ natthi.

vsm1.6:81.4.verse: Dasasu ca asubhesu nibbikappaṃ katvā paṭikkūlabhāveyeva diṭṭhe nimittaṃ nāma hotī’’ti

vsm1.6:81.7.verse: Uggahanimittaṃ virūpaṃ bībhacchaṃ bhayānakaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhātī’’tiādi vuttaṃ.

vsm1.6:81.10.verse: Apica mahātissattherassa dantaṭṭhikamattāvalokanena sakalitthisarīrassa aṭṭhisaṅghātabhāvena upaṭṭhānādīni cettha nidassanānīti.

vsm1.6:82.1.verse:
Iti asubhāni subhaguṇo, dasasatalocanena thutakitti;
Yāni avoca dasabalo, ekekajjhānahetunīti.

vsm1.6:82.2.verse:
Evaṃ tāni ca tesañca, bhāvanānayamimaṃ viditvāna;
Tesveva ayaṃ bhiyyo, pakiṇṇakakathāpi viññeyyā.

vsm1.6:84.4.verse: Iti yādisaṃ yādisaṃ sakkā hoti laddhuṃ, tādise tādise uddhumātakapaṭikkūlaṃ vinīlakapaṭikkūlanti evaṃ nimittaṃ gaṇhitabbamevāti

vsm1.6:85.1.verse: Visesato cettha uddhumātakaṃ sarīrasaṇṭhānavipattippakāsanato saṇṭhānarāgino sappāyaṃ.

vsm1.6:85.3.verse: Vipubbakaṃ kāyavaṇapaṭibaddhassa duggandhabhāvassa pakāsanato mālāgandhādivasena samuṭṭhāpitasarīragandharāgino sappāyaṃ.

vsm1.6:85.5.verse: Vikkhāyitakaṃ maṃsupacayasampattivināsappakāsanato thanādīsu sarīrappadesesu maṃsupacayarāgino sappāyaṃ.

vsm1.6:85.9.verse: Puḷavakaṃ kāyassa anekakimikulasādhāraṇabhāvappakāsanato kāye mamattarāgino sappāyaṃ.

vsm1.6:85.11.verse: evaṃ rāgacaritabhedavasenāpi dasadhā asubhappabhedo vuttoti veditabbo.

vsm1.6:86.2.verse: seyyathāpi nāma aparisaṇṭhitajalāya sīghasotāya nadiyā arittabaleneva nāvā tiṭṭhati,

vsm1.6:86.4.verse: evameva dubbalattā ārammaṇassa vitakkabaleneva cittaṃ ekaggaṃ hutvā tiṭṭhati,

vsm1.6:87.2.verse: ‘‘addhā imāya paṭipadāya jarāmaraṇamhā parimuccissāmī’’ti evamānisaṃsadassāvitāya ceva

vsm1.6:87.4.verse: ‘‘bahuṃ dāni vetanaṃ labhissāmī’’ti ānisaṃsadassāvino pupphachaḍḍakassa gūtharāsimhi viya,

vsm1.6:88.1.verse: Dasavidhampi cetaṃ asubhaṃ lakkhaṇato ekameva hoti.

vsm1.6:88.3.verse: Tadetaṃ iminā lakkhaṇena na kevalaṃ matasarīre,

vsm1.6:88.5.verse: hatthikkhandhagataṃ rājānaṃ olokentassa saṅgharakkhitattherūpaṭṭhākasāmaṇerassa viya ca jīvamānakasarīrepi upaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.6:88.6.verse: Yatheva hi matasarīraṃ, evaṃ jīvamānakampi asubhameva.

vsm1.6:88.7.verse: Asubhalakkhaṇaṃ panettha āgantukena alaṅkārena paṭicchannattā na paññāyati.

vsm1.6:89.1.verse: Pakatiyā pana idaṃ sarīraṃ nāma atirekatisataaṭṭhikasamussayaṃ asītisatasandhisaṅghaṭitaṃ

vsm1.6:89.7.verse: Yassa ubhohi akkhīhi akkhigūthako paggharati, kaṇṇabilehi kaṇṇagūthako,

vsm1.6:89.9.verse: adhodvārehi uccārapassāvā, navanavutiyā lomakūpasahassehi asucisedayūso paggharati.

vsm1.6:89.12.verse: yathājātova pharusavippakiṇṇakeso hutvā gāmena gāmaṃ vicaranto rājāpi pupphachaḍḍakacaṇḍālādīsu aññataropi samasarīrapaṭikkūlatāya nibbiseso hoti,

vsm1.6:89.13.verse: evaṃ asuciduggandhajegucchapaṭikkūlatāya rañño vā caṇḍālassa vā sarīre vemattaṃ nāma natthi.

vsm1.6:90.6.verse: Tato iminā āgantukena alaṅkārena paṭicchannattā tadassa yāthāvasarasaṃ asubhalakkhaṇaṃ asañjānantā purisā itthīsu, itthiyo ca purisesu ratiṃ karonti.

vsm1.6:90.7.verse: Paramatthato panettha rajjitabbakayuttaṭṭhānaṃ nāma aṇumattampi natthi.

vsm1.6:91.1.verse: Tathā hi kesalomanakhadantakheḷasiṅghāṇikauccārapassāvādīsu ekakoṭṭhāsampi sarīrato bahi patitaṃ

vsm1.6:91.6.verse: avijjandhakārapariyonaddhā attasineharāgarattā ‘‘iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ niccaṃ sukhaṃ attā’’ti gaṇhanti.

vsm1.6:91.8.verse: aṭaviyaṃ kiṃsukarukkhaṃ disvā rukkhato apatitapupphaṃ ‘‘ayaṃ maṃsapesī’’ti vihaññamānena jarasiṅgālena samānataṃ āpajjanti. Tasmā –

vsm1.6:92.1.verse:
Yathāpi pupphitaṃ disvā, siṅgālo kiṃsukaṃ vane;
Maṃsarukkho mayā laddho, iti gantvāna vegasā.

vsm1.6:92.2.verse:
Patitaṃ patitaṃ pupphaṃ, ḍaṃsitvā atilolupo;
Nayidaṃ maṃsaṃ aduṃ maṃsaṃ, yaṃ rukkhasminti gaṇhati.

vsm1.6:92.3.verse:
Koṭṭhāsaṃ patitaṃyeva, asubhanti tathā budho;
Aggahetvāna gaṇheyya, sarīraṭṭhampi naṃ tathā.

vsm1.6:92.4.verse:
Imañhi subhato kāyaṃ, gahetvā tattha mucchitā;
Bālā karontā pāpāni, dukkhā na parimuccare.

vsm1.6:92.5.verse:
Tasmā passeyya medhāvī, jīvato vā matassa vā;
Sabhāvaṃ pūtikāyassa, subhabhāvena vajjitaṃ.

vsm1.6:93.2.verse:
Duggandho asuci kāyo, kuṇapo ukkarūpamo;
Nindito cakkhubhūtehi, kāyo bālābhinandito.

vsm1.6:93.3.verse:
Allacammapaṭicchanno, navadvāro mahāvaṇo;
Samantato paggharati, asuci pūtigandhiyo.

vsm1.6:93.4.verse:
Sace imassa kāyassa, anto bāhirako siyā;
Daṇḍaṃ nūna gahetvāna, kāke soṇe nivārayeti.

vsm1.6:94.1.verse:
Tasmā dabbajātikena bhikkhunā jīvamānasarīraṃ vā hotu
Matasarīraṃ vā yattha yattha asubhākāro paññāyati, tattha tattheva nimittaṃ gahetvā

vsm1.6:94.3.verse:
Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge
Samādhibhāvanādhikāre
Asubhakammaṭṭhānaniddeso nāma
Chaṭṭho paricchedo.

vsm1.7:1.3.verse: pavattitabbaṭṭhānamhiyeva vā pavattattā saddhāpabbajitassa kulaputtassa anurūpā satītipi anussati,

vsm1.7:1.15.verse: devatā sakkhiṭṭhāne ṭhapetvā attano saddhādiguṇārammaṇāya satiyā etamadhivacanaṃ.

vsm1.7:1.18.verse: Kesādibhedaṃ rūpakāyaṃ gatā, kāye vā gatāti kāyagatā,

vsm1.7:1.19.verse: kāyagatā ca sā sati cāti kāyagatasatīti vattabbe

vsm1.7:2.1.verse: Iti imāsu dasasu anussatīsu buddhānussatiṃ tāva bhāvetukāmena aveccappasādasamannāgatena yoginā

vsm1.7:2.3.verse: ‘‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’’ti (a. ni. 6.10) evaṃ buddhassa bhagavato guṇā anussaritabbā.

vsm1.7:3.2.verse: so bhagavā itipi arahaṃ, itipi sammāsambuddho…pe… itipi bhagavāti anussarati.

vsm1.7:3.3.verse: Iminā ca iminā ca kāraṇenāti vuttaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:4.1.verse: Tattha ārakattā arīnaṃ arānañca hatattā paccayādīnaṃ arahattā pāpakaraṇe rahābhāvāti imehi tāva kāraṇehi so bhagavā arahanti anussarati.

vsm1.7:5.1.verse: Ārakā hi so sabbakilesehi suvidūravidūre ṭhito

vsm1.7:5.4.verse: So tato ārakā nāma, yassa yenāsamaṅgitā;

vsm1.7:5.5.verse: Asamaṅgī ca dosehi, nātho tenārahaṃ matoti.

vsm1.7:6.1.verse: Te cānena kilesārayo maggena hatāti arīnaṃ hatattāpi arahaṃ.

vsm1.7:7.4.verse: tassānena bodhimaṇḍe vīriyapādehi sīlapathaviyaṃ patiṭṭhāya saddhāhatthena kammakkhayakaraṃ ñāṇapharasuṃ gahetvā sabbe arā hatāti

vsm1.7:8.1.verse: Atha vā saṃsāracakkanti anamataggaṃ saṃsāravaṭṭaṃ vuccati.

vsm1.7:8.4.verse: Sesā dasa dhammā arā, avijjāmūlakattā jarāmaraṇapariyantattā ca,

vsm1.7:9.2.verse: Kāmabhave ca avijjā kāmabhave saṅkhārānaṃ paccayo hoti,

vsm1.7:9.3.verse: rūpabhave avijjā rūpabhave saṅkhārānaṃ paccayo hoti,

vsm1.7:9.4.verse: arūpabhave avijjā arūpabhave saṅkhārānaṃ paccayo hoti.

vsm1.7:10.1.verse: Kāmabhave saṅkhārā kāmabhave paṭisandhiviññāṇassa paccayā honti,

vsm1.7:11.1.verse: Kāmabhave paṭisandhiviññāṇaṃ kāmabhave nāmarūpassa paccayo hoti,

vsm1.7:12.1.verse: Kāmabhave nāmarūpaṃ kāmabhave saḷāyatanassa paccayo hoti,

vsm1.7:12.2.verse: rūpabhave nāmarūpaṃ rūpabhave tiṇṇaṃ āyatanānaṃ paccayo hoti,

vsm1.7:12.3.verse: arūpabhave nāmaṃ arūpabhave ekassa āyatanassa paccayo hoti.

vsm1.7:13.1.verse: Kāmabhave saḷāyatanaṃ kāmabhave chabbidhassa phassassa paccayo hoti,

vsm1.7:13.2.verse: rūpabhave tīṇi āyatanāni rūpabhave tiṇṇaṃ phassānaṃ paccayā honti,

vsm1.7:13.3.verse: arūpabhave ekaṃ āyatanaṃ arūpabhave ekassa phassassa paccayo hoti.

vsm1.7:14.1.verse: Kāmabhave cha phassā kāmabhave channaṃ vedanānaṃ paccayā honti,

vsm1.7:14.3.verse: arūpabhave eko tattheva ekissā vedanāya paccayo hoti.

vsm1.7:15.1.verse: Kāmabhave cha vedanā kāmabhave channaṃ taṇhākāyānaṃ paccayā honti,

vsm1.7:15.3.verse: arūpabhave ekā vedanā arūpabhave ekassa taṇhākāyassa paccayo hoti.

vsm1.7:15.4.verse: Tattha tattha sā sā taṇhā tassa tassa upādānassa,

vsm1.7:16.4.verse: kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati,

vsm1.7:17.1.verse: Aparo saggasampattiṃ anubhavissāmīti tatheva sucaritaṃ carati,

vsm1.7:17.3.verse: Tatthassa upapattihetubhūtaṃ kammaṃ kammabhavoti so eva nayo.

vsm1.7:18.2.verse: kāmupādānapaccayāeva mettaṃ bhāveti, karuṇaṃ, muditaṃ, upekkhaṃ bhāveti,

vsm1.7:18.4.verse: Tatthassa nibbattihetubhūtaṃ kammaṃ kammabhavoti so eva nayo.

vsm1.7:20.1.verse: Evaṃ ayaṃ avijjā hetu, saṅkhārā hetusamuppannā, ubhopete hetusamuppannāti paccayapariggahe paññā dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇaṃ.

vsm1.7:20.2.verse: Atītampi addhānaṃ anāgatampi addhānaṃ avijjā hetu, saṅkhārā hetusamuppannā, ubhopete hetusamuppannāti paccayapariggahe paññā dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇanti

vsm1.7:21.5.verse: Purimasaṅkhepo cettha atīto addhā, dve majjhimā paccuppanno, jātijarāmaraṇaṃ anāgato.

vsm1.7:22.1.verse: Iti bhagavā etaṃ catusaṅkhepaṃ tiyaddhaṃ vīsatākāraṃ tisandhiṃ paṭiccasamuppādaṃ sabbākārato jānāti passati aññāti paṭivijjhati.

vsm1.7:22.5.verse: Iminā dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇena bhagavā te dhamme yathābhūtaṃ ñatvā

vsm1.7:22.7.verse: vuttappakārassa imassa saṃsāracakkassa are hani vihani viddhaṃsesi.

vsm1.7:23.2.verse: Teneva ca uppanne tathāgate yekeci mahesakkhā devamanussā, na te aññattha pūjaṃ karonti.

vsm1.7:23.3.verse: Tathā hi brahmā sahampati sinerumattena ratanadāmena tathāgataṃ pūjesi.

vsm1.7:23.4.verse: Yathābalañca aññe devā manussā ca bimbisārakosalarājādayo.

vsm1.7:23.8.verse: Ko pana vādo aññesaṃ pūjāvisesānanti paccayādīnaṃ arahattāpi arahaṃ.

vsm1.7:23.9.verse:
Pūjāvisesaṃ saha paccayehi,
Yasmā ayaṃ arahati lokanātho;

vsm1.7:23.10.verse:
Atthānurūpaṃ arahanti loke,
Tasmā jino arahati nāmametaṃ.

vsm1.7:24.1.verse: Yathā ca loke yekeci paṇḍitamānino bālā asilokabhayena raho pāpaṃ karonti, evamesa na kadāci karotīti

vsm1.7:24.3.verse: Yasmā natthi raho nāma, pāpakammesu tādino;

vsm1.7:25.2.verse: Ārakattā hatattā ca, kilesārīna so muni;

vsm1.7:25.4.verse: Na raho karoti pāpāni, arahaṃ tena vuccatīti.

vsm1.7:26.1.verse: Sammā sāmañca sabbadhammānaṃ buddhattā pana sammāsambuddho.

vsm1.7:26.2.verse: Tathāhi esa sabbadhamme sammā sāmañca buddho,

vsm1.7:26.10.verse: Pahātabbaṃ pahīnaṃ me, tasmā buddhosmi brāhmaṇāti. (ma. ni. 2.399; su. ni. 563)

vsm1.7:36.2.verse: So hi bhagavā sabhāvato samudayato nirodhato nirodhūpāyatoti sabbathā lokaṃ avedi aññāsi paṭivijjhi.

vsm1.7:36.3.verse: Yathāha – ‘‘yattha kho, āvuso, na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati,

vsm1.7:36.4.verse: nāhaṃ taṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ daṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyanti vadāmi,

vsm1.7:36.5.verse: na cāhaṃ, āvuso, apatvāva lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmi.

vsm1.7:36.6.verse: Api cāhaṃ, āvuso, imasmiññeva byāmamatte kaḷevare sasaññimhi samanake

vsm1.7:36.7.verse: lokañca paññapemi lokasamudayañca lokanirodhañca lokanirodhagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ.

vsm1.7:36.9.verse: Na ca apatvā lokantaṃ, dukkhā atthi pamocanaṃ.

vsm1.7:36.10.verse:
Tasmā have lokavidū sumedho,
Lokantagū vūsitabrahmacariyo;

vsm1.7:36.11.verse:
Lokassa antaṃ samitāvi ñatvā,
Nāsīsati lokamimaṃ parañcāti. (saṃ. ni. 1.107; a. ni. 4.45)

vsm1.7:37.1.verse: Apica tayo lokā saṅkhāraloko sattaloko okāsalokoti.

vsm1.7:37.2.verse: Tattha eko loko sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikāti (paṭi. ma. 1.112) āgataṭṭhāne

vsm1.7:37.4.verse: Sassato lokoti vā asassato lokoti vāti (dī. ni. 1.421) āgataṭṭhāne sattaloko.

vsm1.7:37.5.verse: Yāvatā candimasūriyā pariharanti, disā bhanti virocamānā;

vsm1.7:37.6.verse: Tāva sahassadhā loko, ettha te vattatī vasoti. (ma. ni. 1.503)

vsm1.7:38.1.verse: Tathā hissa ‘‘eko loko sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā. Dve lokā nāmañca rūpañca.

vsm1.7:38.2.verse: Tayo lokā tisso vedanā. Cattāro lokā cattāro āhārā.

vsm1.7:38.3.verse: Pañca lokā pañcupādānakkhandhā. Cha lokā cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni.

vsm1.7:38.4.verse: Satta lokā satta viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo. Aṭṭha lokā aṭṭha lokadhammā.

vsm1.7:38.5.verse: Nava lokā nava sattāvāsā. Dasa lokā dasāyatanāni.

vsm1.7:38.6.verse: Dvādasa lokā dvādasāyatanāni. Aṭṭhārasa lokā aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.112)

vsm1.7:39.1.verse: Yasmā panesa sabbesampi sattānaṃ āsayaṃ jānāti, anusayaṃ jānāti, caritaṃ jānāti, adhimuttiṃ jānāti,

vsm1.7:39.3.verse: svākāre dvākāre, suviññāpaye duviññāpaye, bhabbe abhabbe satte jānāti.

vsm1.7:40.2.verse: Tathā hesa ekaṃ cakkavāḷaṃ āyāmato ca vitthārato ca yojanānaṃ dvādasasatasahassāni catutiṃsasatāni ca paññāsañca yojanāni.

vsm1.7:40.5.verse: Dasa ceva sahassāni, aḍḍhuḍḍhāni satāni ca.

vsm1.7:42.2.verse:
Caturāsīti sahassāni, ajjhogāḷho mahaṇṇave;
Accuggato tāvadeva, sineru pabbatuttamo.

vsm1.7:42.3.verse:
Tato upaḍḍhupaḍḍhena, pamāṇena yathākkamaṃ;
Ajjhogāḷhuggatā dibbā, nānāratanacittitā.

vsm1.7:42.4.verse:
Yugandharo īsadharo, karavīko sudassano;
Nemindharo vinatako, assakaṇṇo giri brahā.

vsm1.7:42.5.verse:
Ete satta mahāselā, sinerussa samantato;
Mahārājānamāvāsā, devayakkhanisevitā.

vsm1.7:43.1.verse:
Dveasīti sahassāni, ajjhogāḷho mahaṇṇave;
Accuggato tāvadeva, cakkavāḷasiluccayo;

vsm1.7:43.8.verse:
Pāṭalī simbalī jambū, devānaṃ pāricchattako;
Kadambo kapparukkho ca, sirīsena bhavati sattamanti.

vsm1.7:44.9.verse: Taṃ sabbampi ekaṃ cakkavāḷaṃ ekā lokadhātu.

vsm1.7:44.12.verse: bhagavā anantena buddhañāṇena avedi aññāsi paṭivijjhi.

vsm1.7:46.1.verse: Attanā pana guṇehi visiṭṭhatarassa kassaci abhāvato

vsm1.7:46.8.verse: Yathāha – ‘‘na kho panāhaṃ samanupassāmi sadevake loke samārake…pe…

vsm1.7:46.12.verse: ‘‘na me ācariyo atthī’’tiādikā (ma. ni. 1.285; mahāva. 11) gāthāyo ca vitthāretabbā.

vsm1.7:47.3.verse: Tattha purisadammāti adantā dametuṃ yuttā tiracchānapurisāpi manussapurisāpi amanussapurisāpi.

vsm1.7:47.4.verse: Tathā hi bhagavatā tiracchānapurisāpi apalālo nāgarājā, cūḷodaro, mahodaro,

vsm1.7:47.5.verse: aggisikho, dhūmasikho, aravāḷo nāgarājā, dhanapālako hatthīti evamādayo

vsm1.7:47.6.verse: damitā nibbisā katā saraṇesu ca sīlesu ca patiṭṭhāpitā,

vsm1.7:47.10.verse: ‘‘Ahaṃ kho, kesi, purisadamme saṇhenapi vinemi, pharusenapi vinemi, saṇhapharusenapi vinemī’’ti (a. ni. 4.11) idañcettha suttaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.

vsm1.7:48.1.verse: Apica bhagavā visuddhasīlādīnaṃ paṭhamajjhānādīni sotāpannādīnañca uttari maggapaṭipadaṃ ācikkhanto dantepi dametiyeva.

vsm1.7:48.2.verse: Atha vā anuttaro purisadammasārathīti ekamevidaṃ atthapadaṃ.

vsm1.7:48.4.verse: yathā ekapallaṅkeneva nisinnā aṭṭha disā asajjamānā dhāvanti.

vsm1.7:48.6.verse: ‘‘Hatthidamakena, bhikkhave, hatthidammo sārito ekaṃyeva disaṃ dhāvatī’’ti idañcettha suttaṃ (ma. ni. 3.312) vitthāretabbaṃ.

vsm1.7:49.2.verse: Apica satthā viyāti satthā, bhagavā satthavāho.

vsm1.7:49.3.verse: Yathā satthavāho satthe kantāraṃ tāreti corakantāraṃ tāreti

vsm1.7:49.4.verse: vāḷakantāraṃ tāreti dubbhikkhakantāraṃ tāreti nirudakakantāraṃ tāreti

vsm1.7:49.6.verse: evameva bhagavā satthā satthavāho satte kantāraṃ tāreti, jātikantāraṃ tāretītiādinā niddesanayenapettha attho veditabbo.

vsm1.7:50.4.verse: Tepi hi bhagavato dhammassavanena upanissayasampattiṃ patvā

vsm1.7:50.5.verse: tāya eva upanissayasampattiyā dutiye vā tatiye vā attabhāve maggaphalabhāgino honti.

vsm1.7:51.2.verse: Bhagavati kira gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre campānagaravāsīnaṃ dhammaṃ desiyamāne

vsm1.7:51.3.verse: eko maṇḍūko bhagavato sare nimittaṃ aggahesi,

vsm1.7:51.4.verse: taṃ eko vacchapālako daṇḍaṃ olubbha tiṭṭhanto sīse sannirumbhitvā aṭṭhāsi.

vsm1.7:51.5.verse: So tāvadeva kālaṅkatvā tāvatiṃsabhavane dvādasayojanike kanakavimāne nibbatti.

vsm1.7:51.6.verse: Suttappabuddho viya ca tattha accharāsaṅghaparivutaṃ attānaṃ disvā

vsm1.7:51.7.verse: ‘‘are ahampi nāma idha nibbatto, kiṃ nu kho kammamakāsi’’nti āvajjento

vsm1.7:51.8.verse: na aññaṃ kiñci addasa aññatra bhagavato sare nimittaggāhā.

vsm1.7:51.9.verse: So tāvadeva saha vimānena āgantvā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandi.

vsm1.7:51.11.verse:
‘‘Ko me vandati pādāni, iddhiyā yasasā jalaṃ;
Abhikkantena vaṇṇena, sabbā obhāsayaṃ disā’’ti.

vsm1.7:51.16.verse: Devaputtopi sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhāya sitaṃ katvā pakkamīti.

vsm1.7:52.1.verse: Yaṃ pana kiñci atthi ñeyyaṃ nāma, sabbasseva buddhattā vimokkhantikaññāṇavasena buddho.

vsm1.7:52.2.verse: Yasmā vā cattāri saccāni attanāpi bujjhi,

vsm1.7:52.5.verse: Imassa ca panatthassa viññāpanatthaṃ ‘‘bujjhitā saccānīti buddho.

vsm1.7:52.7.verse: evaṃ pavatto sabbopi niddesanayo (mahāni. 192) paṭisambhidānayo (paṭi. ma. 1.162) vā vitthāretabbo.

vsm1.7:53.3.verse:
‘‘Bhagavāti vacanaṃ seṭṭhaṃ, bhagavāti vacanamuttamaṃ;
Garugāravayutto so, bhagavā tena vuccatī’’ti.

vsm1.7:54.3.verse: Adhiccasamuppannaṃ nāma lokiyavohārena yadicchakanti vuttaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:54.4.verse: Tattha vaccho dammo balībaddoti evamādi āvatthikaṃ.

vsm1.7:54.5.verse: Daṇḍī chattī sikhī karīti evamādi liṅgikaṃ.

vsm1.7:55.2.verse: na mahāmāyāya, na suddhodanamahārājena, na asītiyā ñātisahassehi kataṃ,

vsm1.7:55.6.verse: vimokkhantikametaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ bodhiyā mūle saha sabbaññutaññāṇassa paṭilābhā sacchikā paññatti yadidaṃ bhagavā’’ti (mahāni. 84).

vsm1.7:56.1.verse: Yaṃguṇanemittikañcetaṃ nāmaṃ, tesaṃ guṇānaṃ pakāsanatthaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ vadanti –

vsm1.7:56.2.verse:
‘‘Bhagī bhajī bhāgi vibhattavā iti,
Akāsi bhagganti garūti bhāgyavā;
Bahūhi ñāyehi subhāvitattano,
Bhavantago so bhagavāti vuccatī’’ti.

vsm1.7:56.3.verse: Niddese (mahāni. 84) vuttanayeneva cettha tesaṃ tesaṃ padānaṃ attho daṭṭhabbo.

vsm1.7:57.2.verse:
Bhāgyavā bhaggavā yutto, bhagehi ca vibhattavā;
Bhattavā vantagamano, bhavesu bhagavā tatoti.

vsm1.7:58.3.verse: yasmā lokiyalokuttarasukhābhinibbattakaṃ dānasīlādipārappattaṃ bhāgyamassa atthi, tasmā bhāgyavāti vattabbe bhagavāti vuccatīti ñātabbaṃ.

vsm1.7:59.6.verse: saṅkhepato vā pañca kilesakhandhaabhisaṅkhāradevaputtamaccumāre abhañji. Tasmā bhaggattā etesaṃ parissayānaṃ bhaggavāti vattabbe bhagavāti vuccati.

vsm1.7:59.9.verse: Bhaggāssa pāpakā dhammā, bhagavā tena vuccatī’’ti.

vsm1.7:60.1.verse: Bhāgyavatāya cassa satapuññalakkhaṇadharassa rūpakāyasampatti dīpitā hoti.

vsm1.7:61.2.verse: bhagā assa santīti iminā atthena bhagavāti vuccati.

vsm1.7:61.3.verse: Yasmā ca loke issariyadhammayasasirikāmapayattesu chasu dhammesu bhagasaddo pavattati,

vsm1.7:61.9.verse: Yaṃ yaṃ etena icchitaṃ patthitaṃ attahitaṃ parahitaṃ vā, tassa tassa tatheva abhinipphannattā icchitatthanibbattisaññito kāmo.

vsm1.7:62.7.verse: vibhajitvā vivaritvā desitavāti vuttaṃ hoti. Tasmā vibhattavāti vattabbe bhagavāti vuccati.

vsm1.7:63.4.verse: aññe ca lokiyalokuttare uttarimanussadhamme bhaji sevi bahulaṃ akāsi, tasmā bhattavāti vattabbe bhagavāti vuccati.

vsm1.7:64.1.verse: Yasmā pana tīsu bhavesu taṇhāsaṅkhātaṃ gamanaṃ anena vantaṃ, tasmā bhavesu vantagamanoti vattabbe

vsm1.7:64.2.verse: bhavasaddato bhakāraṃ gamanasaddato gakāraṃ vantasaddato vakārañca dīghaṃ katvā ādāya bhagavāti vuccati

vsm1.7:64.3.verse: yathā loke mehanassa khassa mālāti vattabbe mekhalāti.

vsm1.7:65.1.verse: Tassevaṃ iminā ca iminā ca kāraṇena so bhagavā arahaṃ…pe… iminā ca iminā ca kāraṇena bhagavāti buddhaguṇe anussarato

vsm1.7:65.2.verse: neva tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,

vsm1.7:65.3.verse: na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:65.4.verse: Ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tathāgatamārabbha (a. ni. 6.10).

vsm1.7:66.11.verse: Tadetaṃ buddhaguṇānussaraṇavasena uppannattā buddhānussaticceva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.

vsm1.7:67.1.verse: Imañca pana buddhānussatiṃ anuyutto bhikkhu satthari sagāravo hoti sappatisso,

vsm1.7:67.11.verse: sammukhā satthāraṃ passato viya hirottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhāti.

vsm1.7:68.2.verse: ‘‘svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī’’ti (a. ni. 6.10) evaṃ pariyattidhammassa ceva navavidhassa ca lokuttaradhammassa guṇā anussaritabbā.

vsm1.7:69.1.verse: Svākkhātoti imasmiṃ hi pade pariyattidhammopi saṅgahaṃ gacchati,

vsm1.7:69.6.verse: Yañhi bhagavā ekagāthampi deseti, sā samantabhaddakattā dhammassa paṭhamapādena ādikalyāṇā,

vsm1.7:69.16.verse: veneyyānaṃ anurūpato atthassa aviparītatāya ca hetudāharaṇayuttato ca majjhekalyāṇaṃ,

vsm1.7:70.1.verse: Sakalopi sāsanadhammo attano atthabhūtena sīlena ādikalyāṇo,

vsm1.7:70.10.verse: Taṃ sutvā tathatthāya paṭipannena adhigantabbāya abhisambodhiyā vā ādikalyāṇo,

vsm1.7:71.1.verse: Suyyamāno cesa nīvaraṇavikkhambhanato savanenapi kalyāṇameva āvahatīti ādikalyāṇo,

vsm1.7:72.1.verse: Yaṃ panesa bhagavā dhammaṃ desento sāsanabrahmacariyaṃ maggabrahmacariyañca pakāseti nānānayehi dīpeti,

vsm1.7:73.8.verse: Yathā hi aññatitthiyānaṃ dhammassa attho vipallāsamāpajjati,

vsm1.7:73.11.verse: Tena te durakkhātadhammāyeva honti, na tathā bhagavato dhammassa attho vipallāsamāpajjati.

vsm1.7:73.12.verse: Ime dhammā antarāyikā, ime dhammā niyyānikāti evaṃ vuttadhammānaṃ tathābhāvānatikkamanatoti.

vsm1.7:74.1.verse: Lokuttaradhammo pana nibbānānurūpāya paṭipattiyā paṭipadānurūpassa ca nibbānassa akkhātattā svākkhāto.

vsm1.7:74.2.verse: Yathāha – ‘‘supaññattā kho pana tena bhagavatā sāvakānaṃ nibbānagāminī paṭipadā saṃsandati nibbānañca paṭipadā ca.

vsm1.7:74.3.verse: Seyyathāpi nāma gaṅgodakaṃ yamunodakena saṃsandati sameti,

vsm1.7:74.4.verse: evameva supaññattā (dī. ni. 2.296) tena bhagavatā sāvakānaṃ nibbānagāminī paṭipadā saṃsandati nibbānañca paṭipadā cā’’ti.

vsm1.7:75.1.verse: Ariyamaggo cettha antadvayaṃ anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadābhūtova

vsm1.7:76.1.verse: Sandiṭṭhikoti ettha pana ariyamaggo tāva attano santāne rāgādīnaṃ abhāvaṃ karontena ariyapuggalena sāmaṃ daṭṭhabboti sandiṭṭhiko.

vsm1.7:76.2.verse: Yathāha –‘‘ratto kho, brāhmaṇa, rāgena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto

vsm1.7:76.3.verse: attabyābādhāyapi ceteti, parabyābādhāyapi ceteti, ubhayabyābādhāyapi ceteti.

vsm1.7:76.5.verse: Rāge pahīne neva attabyābādhāya ceteti, na parabyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti,

vsm1.7:76.7.verse: Evampi kho, brāhmaṇa, sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hotī’’ti(a. ni. 3.54).

vsm1.7:77.1.verse: Apica navavidhopi lokuttaradhammo yena yena adhigato hoti, tena tena parasaddhāya gantabbataṃ hitvā paccavekkhaṇañāṇena sayaṃ daṭṭhabboti sandiṭṭhiko.

vsm1.7:78.6.verse: Tasmā yathā rathena jayatīti rathiko, evaṃ navavidhopi lokuttaradhammo sandiṭṭhiyā jayatīti sandiṭṭhiko.

vsm1.7:80.1.verse: Attano phaladānaṃ sandhāya nāssa kāloti akālo.

vsm1.7:80.3.verse: Na pañcāhasattāhādibhedaṃ kālaṃ khepetvā phalaṃ deti,

vsm1.7:80.4.verse: attano pana pavattisamanantarameva phaladoti vuttaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:81.1.verse: Atha vā attano phaladāne pakaṭṭho kālo patto assāti kāliko.

vsm1.7:81.4.verse: Ayaṃ pana samanantaraphalattā na kālikoti akāliko.

vsm1.7:82.1.verse: ‘‘Ehi passa imaṃ dhamma’’nti evaṃ pavattaṃ ehipassavidhiṃ arahatīti ehipassiko.

vsm1.7:82.4.verse: Rittamuṭṭhiyaṃ hi hiraññaṃ vā suvaṇṇaṃ vā atthīti vatvāpi ‘‘ehi passa ima’’nti na sakkā vattuṃ.

vsm1.7:82.7.verse: Vijjamānampi ca gūthaṃ vā muttaṃ vā

vsm1.7:82.8.verse: manuññabhāvappakāsanena cittasampahaṃsanatthaṃ ‘‘ehi passa ima’’nti na sakkā vattuṃ.

vsm1.7:82.9.verse: Apica kho pana tiṇehi vā paṇṇehi vā paṭicchādetabbameva hoti.

vsm1.7:82.12.verse: Ayaṃ pana navavidhopi lokuttaradhammo sabhāvatova vijjamāno

vsm1.7:82.15.verse: Tasmā vijjamānattā parisuddhattā ca ehipassavidhiṃ arahatīti ehipassiko.

vsm1.7:83.3.verse: ādittaṃ celaṃ vā sīsaṃ vā ajjhupekkhitvāpi bhāvanāvasena attano citte upanayanaṃ arahatīti opanayiko. Opanayikova opaneyyiko.

vsm1.7:83.5.verse: Asaṅkhate pana attano cittena upanayanaṃ arahatīti opaneyyiko.

vsm1.7:84.1.verse: Atha vā nibbānaṃ upanetīti ariyamaggo upaneyyo.

vsm1.7:85.2.verse: sabbehipi ugghaṭitaññūādīhi viññūhi attani attani veditabbo

vsm1.7:85.3.verse: ‘‘bhāvito me maggo, adhigataṃ phalaṃ, sacchikato nirodho’’ti.

vsm1.7:85.4.verse: Na hi upajjhāyena bhāvitena maggena saddhivihārikassa kilesā pahīyanti,

vsm1.7:85.7.verse: Tasmā na esa parassa sīse ābharaṇaṃ viya daṭṭhabbo,

vsm1.7:86.6.verse: Yo ca ehipassiko, so nāma opaneyyiko hotīti.

vsm1.7:87.2.verse: neva tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:87.3.verse: Na dosa…pe… na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:87.4.verse: Ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti dhammaṃ ārabbhāti (a. ni. 6.10)

vsm1.7:87.9.verse: Tadetaṃ dhammaguṇānussaraṇavasena uppannattā dhammānussaticceva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.

vsm1.7:88.2.verse: evaṃ opaneyyikassa dhammassa desetāraṃ imināpaṅgena samannāgataṃ satthāraṃ neva atītaṃse samanupassāmi,

vsm1.7:88.4.verse: evaṃ dhammaguṇadassaneneva satthari sagāravo hoti sappatisso.

vsm1.7:89.7.verse: esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo, pāhuneyyo, dakkhiṇeyyo, añjalikaraṇīyo,

vsm1.7:89.8.verse: anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā’’ti (a. ni. 6.10) evaṃ ariyasaṅghaguṇā anussaritabbā.

vsm1.7:90.2.verse: sammāpaṭipadaṃ anivattipaṭipadaṃ anulomapaṭipadaṃ apaccanīkapaṭipadaṃ dhammānudhammapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannoti vuttaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:90.6.verse: Yasmā pana sā sammāpaṭipadā uju avaṅkā akuṭilā ajimhā,

vsm1.7:90.7.verse: ariyo ca ñāyotipi vuccati, anucchavikattā ca sāmīcītipi saṅkhaṃ gatā.

vsm1.7:91.1.verse: Ettha ca ye maggaṭṭhā, te sammāpaṭipattisamaṅgitāya suppaṭipannā.

vsm1.7:91.2.verse: Ye phalaṭṭhā, te sammāpaṭipadāya adhigantabbassa adhigatattā atītaṃ paṭipadaṃ sandhāya suppaṭipannāti veditabbā.

vsm1.7:92.4.verse: kāyavacīmanovaṅkakuṭilajimhadosappahānāya paṭipannattā ca ujuppaṭipannattā ca ujuppaṭipanno.

vsm1.7:92.5.verse: Ñāyo vuccati nibbānaṃ. Tadatthāya paṭipannattā ñāyappaṭipanno.

vsm1.7:92.6.verse: Yathā paṭipannā sāmīcippaṭipannārahā honti, tathā paṭipannattā sāmīcippaṭipanno.

vsm1.7:93.8.verse: Ettha ca purisoti vā puggaloti vā ekatthāni etāni padāni.

vsm1.7:93.12.verse: pāṭiekkato aṭṭha purisapuggalā, esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho,

vsm1.7:94.5.verse: Taṃ āhunaṃ paṭiggahetuṃ yutto tassa mahapphalakaraṇatoti āhuneyyo.

vsm1.7:95.1.verse: Atha vā dūratopi āgantvā sabbasāpateyyampi ettha hunitabbanti āhavanīyo.

vsm1.7:95.3.verse: Yo cāyaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ āhavanīyo nāma aggi,

vsm1.7:95.5.verse: Sace hutassa mahapphalatāya āhavanīyo, saṅghova āhavanīyo.

vsm1.7:95.8.verse: ‘‘Yo ca vassasataṃ jantu, aggiṃ paricare vane;

vsm1.7:95.10.verse: Sāyeva pūjanā seyyo, yañce vassasataṃ huta’’nti. (dha. pa. 107);

vsm1.7:95.12.verse: idha āhuneyyoti iminā padena atthato ekaṃ.

vsm1.7:96.2.verse: disāvidisato āgatānaṃ piyamanāpānaṃ ñātimittānamatthāya sakkārena paṭiyattaṃ āgantukadānaṃ.

vsm1.7:96.3.verse: Tampi ṭhapetvā te tathārūpe pāhunake saṅghasseva dātuṃ yuttaṃ, saṅghova taṃ paṭiggahetuṃ yutto.

vsm1.7:96.5.verse: Tathā hesa ekabuddhantare ca dissati, abbokiṇṇañca piyamanāpattakarehi dhammehi samannāgatoti.

vsm1.7:96.6.verse: Evaṃ pāhunamassa dātuṃ yuttaṃ pāhunañca paṭiggahetuṃ yuttoti pāhuneyyo.

vsm1.7:96.9.verse: tasmā sabbapaṭhamaṃ ānetvā ettha hunitabbanti pāhavanīyo.

vsm1.7:97.1.verse: Dakkhiṇāti pana paralokaṃ saddahitvā dātabbadānaṃ vuccati.

vsm1.7:97.3.verse: dakkhiṇāya vā hito yasmā naṃ mahapphalakaraṇatāya visodhetīti

vsm1.7:98.1.verse: Ubho hatthe sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhapetvā sabbalokena kayiramānaṃ añjalikammaṃ arahatīti añjalikaraṇīyo.

vsm1.7:98.2.verse: Anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti sabbalokassa asadisaṃ puññavirūhanaṭṭhānaṃ.

vsm1.7:98.3.verse: Yathā hi rañño vā amaccassa vā sālīnaṃ vā yavānaṃ vā virūhanaṭṭhānaṃ

vsm1.7:98.6.verse: Saṅghaṃ nissāya hi lokassa nānappakārahitasukhasaṃvattanikāni puññāni virūhanti.

vsm1.7:99.2.verse: neva tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:99.3.verse: Na dosa…pe… na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:99.4.verse: Ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti saṅghaṃ ārabbhāti (a. ni. 6.10)

vsm1.7:99.9.verse: Tadetaṃ saṅghaguṇānussaraṇavasena uppannattā saṅghānussaticceva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.

vsm1.7:100.1.verse: Imañca pana saṅghānussatiṃ anuyutto bhikkhu saṅghe sagāravo hoti sappatisso.

vsm1.7:100.11.verse: sammukhā saṅghaṃ passato viya hirottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhāti,

vsm1.7:101.2.verse: ‘‘aho vata me sīlāni akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni

vsm1.7:101.3.verse: bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikānī’’ti (a. ni. 6.10) evaṃ akhaṇḍatādiguṇavasena attano sīlāni anussaritabbāni.

vsm1.7:101.4.verse: Tāni ca gahaṭṭhena gahaṭṭhasīlāni, pabbajitena pabbajitasīlāni.

vsm1.7:102.2.verse: yesaṃ ādimhi vā ante vā ekampi na bhinnaṃ,

vsm1.7:102.3.verse: tāni pariyante chinnasāṭako viya na khaṇḍānīti akhaṇḍāni.

vsm1.7:102.4.verse: Yesaṃ vemajjhe ekampi na bhinnaṃ, tāni majjhe vinividdhasāṭako viya na chiddānīti acchiddāni.

vsm1.7:102.5.verse: Yesaṃ paṭipāṭiyā dve vā tīṇi vā na bhinnāni,

vsm1.7:102.6.verse: tāni piṭṭhiyā vā kucchiyā vā uṭṭhitena dīghavaṭṭādisaṇṭhānena visabhāgavaṇṇena kāḷarattādīnaṃ aññatarasarīravaṇṇā gāvī viya

vsm1.7:102.9.verse: tāni visabhāgabinduvicitrā gāvī viya na kammāsānīti akammāsāni.

vsm1.7:103.1.verse: Avisesena vā sabbānipi sattavidhena methunasaṃyogena kodhupanāhādīhi ca pāpadhammehi anupahatattā akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni.

vsm1.7:104.4.verse: kenaci vā ayaṃ te sīlesu dosoti evaṃ parāmaṭṭhuṃ asakkuṇeyyatāya aparāmaṭṭhāni.

vsm1.7:104.6.verse: atha vā pana maggasamādhiṃ phalasamādhiñcāpi saṃvattentīti samādhisaṃvattanikāni.

vsm1.7:105.2.verse: nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:105.3.verse: Na dosa…pe… na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:105.4.verse: Ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, sīlaṃ ārabbhāti

vsm1.7:105.9.verse: Tadetaṃ sīlaguṇānussaraṇavasena uppannattā sīlānussaticceva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.

vsm1.7:106.1.verse: Imañca pana sīlānussatiṃ anuyutto bhikkhu sikkhāya sagāravo hoti

vsm1.7:106.9.verse:
Tasmā have appamādaṃ, kayirātha sumedhaso;
Evaṃ mahānubhāvāya, sīlānussatiyā sadāti.

vsm1.7:107.4.verse: ito dāni pabhuti sati paṭiggāhake antamaso ekālopamattampi dānaṃ adatvā na bhuñjissāmīti samādānaṃ katvā

vsm1.7:107.5.verse: taṃdivasaṃ guṇavisiṭṭhesu paṭiggāhakesu yathāsatti yathābalaṃ dānaṃ datvā

vsm1.7:107.9.verse: yohaṃ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitāya pajāya vigatamalamaccherena cetasā viharāmi

vsm1.7:107.10.verse: muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato’’ti evaṃ vigatamalamaccheratādiguṇavasena attano cāgo anussaritabbo.

vsm1.7:108.1.verse: Tattha lābhā vata meti mayhaṃ vata lābhā,

vsm1.7:108.2.verse: ye ime ‘‘āyuṃ kho pana datvā āyussa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā’’ iti (a. ni. 5.37) ca,

vsm1.7:108.3.verse: ‘‘dadaṃ piyo hoti bhajanti naṃ bahū’’ iti (a. ni. 5.34) ca,

vsm1.7:108.4.verse: ‘‘dadamāno piyo hoti, sataṃ dhammaṃ anukkamaṃ’’ iti (a. ni. 5.35) ca evamādīhi nayehi bhagavatā dāyakassa lābhā saṃvaṇṇitā, te mayhaṃ avassaṃ bhāginoti adhippāyo.

vsm1.7:109.1.verse: Suladdhaṃ vata meti yaṃ mayā idaṃ sāsanaṃ manussattaṃ vā laddhaṃ, taṃ suladdhaṃ vata me.

vsm1.7:110.3.verse: Tasmā attano sampattīnaṃ parasādhāraṇabhāvamasahanalakkhaṇena cittassa pabhassarabhāvadūsakānaṃ kaṇhadhammānaṃ aññatarena maccheramalena abhibhūtesu sattesūti ayamettha attho.

vsm1.7:111.1.verse: Vigatamalamaccherenāti aññesampi rāgadosādimalānañceva maccherassa ca vigatattā vigatamalamaccherena.

vsm1.7:111.2.verse: Cetasā viharāmīti yathāvuttappakāracitto hutvā vasāmīti attho.

vsm1.7:111.3.verse: Suttesu pana mahānāmasakkassa sotāpannassa sato nissayavihāraṃ pucchato nissayavihāravasena desitattā agāraṃ ajjhāvasāmīti vuttaṃ.

vsm1.7:112.3.verse: Sakkaccaṃ sahatthā deyyadhammaṃ dātuṃ sadā dhotahatthoyevāti vuttaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:112.6.verse: Yācayogoti yaṃ yaṃ pare yācanti, tassa tassa dānato yācanayogoti attho.

vsm1.7:112.7.verse: Yājayogotipi pāṭho. Yajanasaṅkhātena yājena yuttoti attho.

vsm1.7:112.8.verse: Dānasaṃvibhāgaratoti dāne ca saṃvibhāge ca rato.

vsm1.7:112.9.verse: Ahañhi dānañca demi, attanā paribhuñjitabbatopi ca saṃvibhāgaṃ karomi, ettheva casmi ubhaye ratoti evaṃ anussaratīti attho.

vsm1.7:113.2.verse: neva tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:113.3.verse: Na dosa…pe… na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:113.4.verse: Ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti cāgaṃ ārabbhāti (a. ni. 5.10)

vsm1.7:113.9.verse: Tadetaṃ cāgaguṇānussaraṇavasena uppannattā cāgānussaticceva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.

vsm1.7:114.1.verse: Imañca pana cāgānussatiṃ anuyutto bhikkhu bhiyyoso mattāya cāgādhimutto hoti,

vsm1.7:114.7.verse:
Tasmā have appamādaṃ, kayirātha sumedhaso;
Evaṃ mahānubhāvāya, cāgānussatiyā sadāti.

vsm1.7:115.2.verse: ariyamaggavasena samudāgatehi saddhādīhi guṇehi samannāgatena bhavitabbaṃ.

vsm1.7:115.4.verse: ‘‘santi devā cātumahārājikā, santi devā tāvatiṃsā, yāmā, tusitā, nimmānaratino, paranimmitavasavattino,

vsm1.7:115.5.verse: santi devā brahmakāyikā, santi devā tatuttari,

vsm1.7:115.6.verse: yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati.

vsm1.7:115.7.verse: Yathārūpena sīlena. Yathārūpena sutena. Yathārūpena cāgena.

vsm1.7:115.8.verse: Yathārūpāya paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatī’’ti (a. ni. 6.10) evaṃ devatā sakkhiṭṭhāne ṭhapetvā attano saddhādiguṇā anussaritabbā.

vsm1.7:116.1.verse: Sutte pana yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañca devatānaṃ saddhañca sīlañca sutañca cāgañca paññañca anussarati,

vsm1.7:116.2.verse: nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hotīti vuttaṃ.

vsm1.7:116.4.verse: atha kho taṃ sakkhiṭṭhāne ṭhapetabbadevatānaṃ attano saddhādīhi samānaguṇadīpanatthaṃ vuttanti veditabbaṃ.

vsm1.7:116.5.verse: Aṭṭhakathāyañhi devatā sakkhiṭṭhāne ṭhapetvā attano guṇe anussaratīti daḷhaṃ katvā vuttaṃ.

vsm1.7:117.2.verse: aparabhāge attano saṃvijjamāne saddhādiguṇe anussarato cassa

vsm1.7:117.3.verse: neva tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.

vsm1.7:117.4.verse: Na dosa…pe… na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,

vsm1.7:117.5.verse: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti devatā ārabbhāti (a. ni. 6.10)

vsm1.7:117.9.verse: Tadetaṃ devatānaṃ guṇasadisasaddhādiguṇānussaraṇavasena devatānussaticceva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.

vsm1.7:118.1.verse: Imañca pana devatānussatiṃ anuyutto bhikkhu devatānaṃ piyo hoti manāpo,

vsm1.7:118.5.verse:
Tasmā have appamādaṃ, kayirātha sumedhaso;
Evaṃ mahānubhāvāya, devatānussatiyā sadāti.

vsm1.7:119.1.verse: Yaṃ pana etāsaṃ vitthāradesanāyaṃ ‘‘ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tathāgataṃ ārabbhā’’tiādīni vatvā

vsm1.7:119.2.verse: ‘‘ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ,

vsm1.7:119.3.verse: labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pamuditassa pīti jāyatī’’ti (a. ni. 6.10) vuttaṃ,

vsm1.7:119.4.verse: tattha itipi so bhagavātiādīnaṃ atthaṃ nissāya uppannaṃ tuṭṭhiṃ sandhāya labhati atthavedanti vuttaṃ.

vsm1.7:119.5.verse: Pāḷiṃ nissāya uppannaṃ tuṭṭhiṃ sandhāya labhati dhammavedaṃ.

vsm1.7:119.6.verse: Ubhayavasena labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjanti vuttanti veditabbaṃ.

vsm1.7:120.3.verse: devatāguṇasadise vā devatābhāvanipphādake guṇe ārabbha pavattacittavasena vuttanti veditabbaṃ.

vsm1.7:121.1.verse: Imā pana cha anussatiyo ariyasāvakānaññeva ijjhanti.

vsm1.7:122.1.verse: Mahānāmasutte (a. ni. 6.10) ca sotāpannassa nissayavihāraṃ puṭṭhena bhagavatā sotāpannassa nissayavihāradassanatthameva etā vitthārato kathitā.

vsm1.7:123.2.verse: ‘‘idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati, itipi so bhagavā…pe…

vsm1.7:123.3.verse: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.

vsm1.7:123.5.verse: Idampi kho, bhikkhave, ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visujjhantī’’ti (a. ni. 6.25) evaṃ ariyasāvakassa anussativasena cittaṃ visodhetvā uttari paramatthavisuddhiadhigamatthāya kathitā.

vsm1.7:124.3.verse: yāvañcidaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sambādhe okāsādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā…pe… nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya

vsm1.7:124.5.verse: Idhāvuso, ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati…pe… evamidhekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavantī’’ti (a. ni. 6.26) evaṃ ariyasāvakasseva paramatthavisuddhidhammatāya okāsādhigamavasena kathitā.

vsm1.7:125.3.verse: Upakkiliṭṭhassa, visākhe, cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.

vsm1.7:125.4.verse: Kathañca, visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?

vsm1.7:125.5.verse: Idha, visākhe, ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussaratī’’ti (a. ni. 3.71) evaṃ ariyasāvakasseva uposathaṃ upavasato cittavisodhanakammaṭṭhānavasena uposathassa mahapphalabhāvadassanatthaṃ kathitā.

vsm1.7:126.2.verse: ‘‘saddho kho, mahānāma, ārādhako hoti, no assaddho.

vsm1.7:126.3.verse: Āraddhavīriyo, upaṭṭhitasati, samāhito, paññavā, mahānāma, ārādhako hoti, no duppañño.

vsm1.7:126.4.verse: Imesu kho tvaṃ, mahānāma, pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cha dhamme uttari bhāveyyāsi.

vsm1.7:126.5.verse: Idha tvaṃ, mahānāma, tathāgataṃ anussareyyāsi itipi so bhagavā’’ti (a. ni. 11.11) evaṃ ariyasāvakasseva ‘‘tesaṃ no, bhante, nānāvihārena viharataṃ kenassa vihārena viharitabba’’nti pucchato vihāradassanatthaṃ kathitā.

vsm1.7:127.1.verse: Evaṃ santepi parisuddhasīlādiguṇasamannāgatena puthujjanenāpi manasi kātabbā.

vsm1.7:127.2.verse: Anussavavasenāpi hi buddhādīnaṃ guṇe anussarato cittaṃ pasīdatiyeva.

vsm1.7:128.1.verse: So kirāyasmā mārena nimmitaṃ buddharūpaṃ disvā

vsm1.7:128.3.verse: kathaṃ nu kho bhagavā na sobhati,

vsm1.7:128.5.verse: buddhārammaṇaṃ pītiṃ paṭilabhitvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇīti.

vsm1.7:128.6.verse:
Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge
Samādhibhāvanādhikāre
Chaanussatiniddeso nāma
Sattamo paricchedo.
